items.title: IDB head working on $2.5 billion Venezuela loan, faces board pushback, sources say
items.author: Rodrigo Campos, Cassandra Garrison
items.creator: Rodrigo Campos, Cassandra Garrison
items.summary: The head of the Inter-American Development Bank has been working to secure approval for a $2.5 billion loan for Venezuela but has faced pushback from some at the lender's board, two sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
items.body:
The head of the Inter-American Development Bank has been working to secure approval for a $2.5 billion loan for Venezuela but has faced pushback from some at the lender's board, two sources with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
IDB President Ilan Goldfajn has faced concern from the board about pursuing the lending to Caracas without the typical parallel work of other multilateral lenders, even though the board recognizes the benefits of reengaging with Venezuela, one of the sources said.
The IDB stopped making new loans to the South American country in May 2018 after it fell behind on payments.

items.title: Flexible Jacks benefitting from new England role with bat and ball
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Will Jacks has embraced a new position down the batting order that has also seen him take on a more influential role with the ball following career-best One Day International figures of 5-22 in England’s 89-run win over Sri Lanka on Tuesday.
items.body:
Will Jacks has embraced a new position down the batting order that has also seen him take on a more influential role with the ball following career-best One Day International figures of 5-22 in England’s [USN:L6N45E0YW TEXT:"89-run win over Sri Lanka"] on Tuesday.
When Jacks first came into the ODI side in 2023, he mostly batted in the top three and was bowled sparingly, but as England look ahead to the 2027 Cricket World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, his role is evolving.
His first 15 ODIs batting mostly higher up the order saw him average 31.20 with the bat and 45.00 with the ball.
But since dropping down the order to number 6 or 7, in the last 12 matches he has played his batting average has risen to 42.83 and his bowling average dropped to 34.60.
He was a match-winner against Sri Lanka with his five-wicket haul and an unbeaten 46 with the bat, earning praise from captain Harry Brook.
"The way he has come into this role in the middle order and played his part with the ball has been awesome," Brook told Sky Sports.
Jacks could be particularly well suited to the conditions at next year’s World Cup, having played with success for several seasons in South Africa’s SA20, giving him an understanding of white-ball conditions there.
"It is about playing the situation and going into each game with an open mind, see what the situation is and play accordingly," Jacks said.
"What we have been doing really well recently is communicating what the pitch is like and what sort of score we would like. Joe and Harry were saying ... 275-280 would be a good score.
"When I got out there (to bat), I found it quite difficult and thought it might be a bit lower, but in 50-over cricket you have more time than you think and we could catch up a little bit in the end."
Jacks has also previously been used in the opening overs of a bowling innings, but on this occasion came later on.
"Having batted on it, I knew I would play a decent role (with the ball). When I bowl does not matter to me, Harry likes to be flexible," he said.
The second match in the three-game series will be played in Leeds on Thursday.

items.title: Fala de Lula sobre “pobre morrer cortando cana” era crítica à falta de acesso à educação
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Publicações nas redes sociais tiram de contexto uma fala do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para afirmar que ele disse que “pobre tinha que morrer cortando cana”.
items.body:
Publicações nas redes sociais tiram de contexto uma fala do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva para afirmar que ele disse que “pobre tinha que morrer cortando cana”.
As postagens , que circulam no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads, omitem que o trecho fazia parte de uma crítica a uma elite que, segundo Lula, historicamente não investiu em educação para a parcela mais pobre da população brasileira.
"A nossa primeira universidade só foi criada 420 anos depois que Cabral chegou aqui, porque a elite brasileira daquela época não queria educar os indígenas... Eles não se importavam, porque os filhos deles iam estudar na Europa, estudar nos Estados Unidos, e o pobre tinha que morrer cortando cana ou garimpando para eles”, disse Lula.
O vídeo completo do discurso, realizado em Teresina no último dia 9, está disponível no canal do presidente no YouTube .
Lula já fez comentários similares anteriormente, que também foram alvo de desinformação .
VEREDICTO Enganoso. A fala de Lula sobre pobre ter que "morrer cortando cana" faz parte de um discurso mais amplo sobre falta de acesso à educação.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: Wall Street holds near its record after Brent oil briefly falls below US$98 per barrel
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: Oil prices retreated for the fifth straight day Tuesday and Wall Street was poised to open modestly higher as pressure from the bond market eased.
items.body: NEW YORK — The U.S. stock market held near its record high after oil prices eased again. The S&P 500 edged down a fraction of a point and is sitting just 0.4 per cent below its all-time high set last month. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 0.4 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite added 0.5 per cent to its own record. Stocks had been higher in the morning, when the price for a barrel of Brent crude briefly fell below US$98. But oil prices later trimmed their losses, and Brent settled at US$99.25 per barrel. Treasury yields held relatively steady in the bond market, as did stock indexes worldwide. THIS IS A BREAKING NEWS UPDATE. AP’s earlier story follows below. NEW YORK (AP) — The U.S. stock market is inching closer to its record high on Tuesday after oil prices eased again. The S&P 500 rose 0.1 per cent and is sitting just 0.3 per cent below its all-time high set last month. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 135 points, or 0.3 per cent, with about 40 minutes remaining in trading, and the Nasdaq composite was adding 0.5 per cent to its own record. Stocks had been higher in the morning, when the price for a barrel of Brent crude briefly fell below US$98. But oil prices later trimmed their losses, and Brent settled at US$99.25 per barrel, down 1.1 per cent. That’s down from the nearly US$110 that it touched last week, but it’s still much more expensive than the US$72 it was fetching before the war with Iran began. It’s been swinging with uncertainty about when the war will allow crude to freely flow again from the Middle East to customers worldwide. On Wall Street, AutoZone rose 4.3 per cent after the retailer reported a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected, though its revenue fell short. CEO Phil Daniele said the auto parts seller faced “a difficult selling environment” in the first two months of the quarter, but it improved afterward and “we feel we are well positioned for sales growth” in its upcoming fiscal year. At Thor Industries, which sells recreational vehicles, the mood was more muted. CEO Bob Martin said expensive fuel, high interest rates and still-high inflation are stretching its customers’ budgets, and business “never reached the inflection point many in the industry expected” in its latest fiscal year. Its stock rose 4.7 per cent, though, after it delivered a stronger profit for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Such strong profit reports are one of the main reasons the U.S. stock market has reached the brink of its all-time high despite expensive oil and jitters about whether stocks in the artificial-intelligence industry shot too high. Many companies are close to closing the books on their third quarter of the year, which ends with September. And analysts are forecasting companies in the S&P 500 will report overall growth of nearly 29 per cent for the quarter from a year earlier, according to FactSet. If they’re right, it would be the third straight quarter of growth better than 25 per cent for the index. And stock prices tend to follow the track of corporate profits over the long term. On Holding’s stock that trades in the United States jumped 8.9 per cent after the Swiss sneaker and sportswear company unveiled its financial goals for upcoming years. It also approved a plan to buy back up to US$1 billion of its stock through 2029. Such purchases send cash directly to investors and boost the company’s per-share performance. On the losing end of Wall Street were several stocks of companies in the oil and gas industry, which were hurt by the drop in crude prices. ConocoPhillips fell 1.2 per cent. Banks also dropped, continuing their weak run since last week, when the Federal Reserve raised the overnight interest rate that it controls for the first time in three years. When the spread narrows between short-term interest rates and longer ones, banks come under pressure because they make profit off the difference. JPMorgan Chase fell 3.2 per cent and was one of the heaviest weights on the S&P 500. The gap between short- and long-term yields in the bond market did not move much Tuesday, and the 10-year Treasury yield remained at 4.96 per cent, where it was late Monday. In stock markets abroad, indexes ticked higher across much of Europe and Asia. London’s FTSE 100 was an outlier and dipped 0.3 per cent. Stocks rose 0.2 per cent in Hong Kong and 0.1 per cent in Shanghai after Alibaba unveiled new artificial intelligence chip technologies, including what it said was China’s most powerful AI chip. That comes just days ahead of a meeting between Chinese and U.S. leaders at which competition to lead on AI technology is expected to be a major theme. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writer Yuri Kageyama contributed to this report.

items.title: In UN farewell, Macron denounces Trump's Gaza diplomacy as spectacle of shame
items.author: John Irish
items.creator: John Irish
items.summary: France's President Emmanuel Macron on Tuesday dismissed US President Donald Trump's claims of having secured peace in Gaza, saying not a single humanitarian corridor had been reopened in the enclave despite the proclaimed peace.
items.body:
France's President Emmanuel Macron on Tuesday dismissed US President Donald Trump's claims of having secured peace in Gaza, saying not a single humanitarian corridor had been reopened in the enclave despite the proclaimed peace.
In his final address to the United Nations before leaving office next year, Macron said the world was witnessing a spectacle that should shame everyone, rebuking Trump's portrayal of his Gaza peace plan as a diplomatic triumph.
He spoke at the United Nations General Assembly hours after Trump had from the same rostrum hailed his Gaza peace plan as a diplomatic triumph.
"A year ago, here in this very hall, about a dozen states had recognized Palestine. I hear the cynicism of some people: 'Recognition is just a piece of paper, look at the reality,'" Macron said, banging his fist on the podium in his last speech at the United Nations before stepping down next May.
"But what credibility do we have if we continue to remain inactive in the face of Gaza? Some boast of a supposed peace. But that peace has not reopened humanitarian access for a single second. Are we simply to stand by and watch this spectacle that should shame us all?"
The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
"One year ago, when I addressed the great leaders in this hall, the war in Gaza was still raging brutally," Trump said in his earlier speech. "A few weeks later, we ended the war in Gaza, saving untold thousands of lives."
Macron has faced criticism among some politicians and activists in France that he has done little since recognising a Palestinian state last September.
Despite the criticism, Paris has toughened its stance on settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank, imposing some national sanctions and launching a process to ban products from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
"Look at what is happening in the West Bank, where every day violations are committed. In whose name? Hamas has never operated in the West Bank," Macron said.
"What is happening there is building, day by day, the impossibility of a project that should be based on respect for the legitimate right of the Palestinian people to exist."
France's ties with Israel have been particularly strained over the last year. Macron said those who believed that violating the sovereignty of all of Israel's neighbors would ensure its security were mistaken.
"They are weakening Israel's security, both today and in the future," he said.
'LONG LIVE THE UNITED NATIONS' Seven months from France's next presidential election, Macron was making his last appearance after first taking to the rostrum in 2017.
Often showing a keen eye for the trappings of diplomacy — the grand settings, the symbolism, the personal connections — he has at the same time failed to translate this into lasting strategic gains, analysts say.
However, he has always been a staunch defender of the multilateral system and the United Nations.
Macron warned against a global "return to the law of the jungle", saying countries faced a choice between a world governed by power and coercion and a "civilized international society."
"Our duty, more than ever, is to stand alongside the United Nations. We cannot accept the new order of impunity that some would like to build," he said.
He ended his speech with "Long Live the United Nations!"

items.title: Nasdaq tem fechamento recorde; ações do setor de IA registram alta
items.author: Noel Randewich, Johann Cherian
items.creator: Noel Randewich, Johann Cherian
items.summary: O Nasdaq registrou um fechamento recorde nesta terça-feira, impulsionado pela Micron Technology e outras ações relacionadas à IA, enquanto o S&P 500 ficou um pouco abaixo de sua máxima histórica, com os preços do petróleo oscilando em torno de US$100 por barril.
items.body:
O Nasdaq registrou um fechamento recorde nesta terça-feira, impulsionado pela Micron Technology e outras ações relacionadas à IA, enquanto o S&P 500 ficou um pouco abaixo de sua máxima histórica, com os preços do petróleo oscilando em torno de US$100 por barril.
As ações do setor de chips ampliaram os ganhos recentes, enquanto as ações de software voltadas para o consumidor perderam terreno. Os investidores se concentraram na forte recepção do assistente de IA da Meta, lançado neste mês e capaz de enviar emails e realizar transações em nome do usuário.
O sucesso do assistente de IA, chamado Muse, impulsionou os ganhos das ações de chips relacionadas à IA nos últimos dias. No entanto, alguns temiam que ele pudesse competir com varejistas, corretoras online e outras empresas do setor de consumo. A Amazon (AMZN.O) bloqueou, na segunda-feira, o acesso do assistente para compras em sua plataforma.
“Há muitas ações do setor de tecnologia em baixa hoje devido a receios relacionados ao Muse, de um tipo ou de outro”, disse Jed Ellerbroek, gestor de portfólio da Argent Capital Management. “As pessoas temem que o Muse seja usado para gerenciar seus contratos de seguro, reservar suas viagens e procurar coisas para comprar.”
Os aplicativos de transporte Uber Technologies (UBER.N) e Lyft (LYFT.O) perderam terreno, enquanto a Expedia (EXPE.O) e a Charles Schwab (SCHW.N) também registraram quedas.
As fabricantes de chips de memória Micron (MU.O) e SanDisk (SNDK.O) registraram alta.
De acordo com dados preliminares, o S&P 500 (.SPX) teve variação negativa de 0,01%, fechando em 7.764,27 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganhou 0,45%, para 27.243,24 pontos. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,36%, para 51.863,89 pontos.

[ヒューストン ２２日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、下落した。サウジアラビアが東西パイプラインを再稼働させ、原油供給が拡大したことに加え、ホルムズ海峡を通る船舶の動きが活発化したことが背景。

両指標とも取引時間中に２ドル超下落する場面もあった。

サウジアラビアによる東西パイプラインの操業再開により、西部の紅海沿岸のヤンブー港からの輸出は２２日中に再開する可能性がある。

items.summary: Microsoft on Tuesday said it will give the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency direct, on-site access to its latest quantum computing hardware as part of a new research center the company opened in Maryland alongside the University of Maryland and other industry partners.
items.body:
Microsoft (MSFT.O) on Tuesday said it will give the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency direct, on-site access to its latest quantum computing hardware as part of a new research center the company opened in Maryland alongside the University of Maryland and other industry partners.
The center, located in the university's Discovery District near Washington, D.C., will house a new quantum system that uses [USN:L6N4291A0 TEXT:"Microsoft's Majorana 2 chip"] for independent testing and evaluation by DARPA.
Quantum computers hold the promise of tackling problems that would take conventional machines thousands of years. Of particular [USN:L1N42U0V1 TEXT:"interest to national security experts"] is protecting and cracking encrypted communications.
Microsoft is one of a number of quantum firms being evaluated by DARPA to discover whether any quantum computing approach can yield economically feasible systems by 2033.
Until now, DARPA has evaluated Microsoft's technology remotely, accessing machines in Redmond, Washington, and Europe. The Maryland delivery marks a shift to physical access in a dedicated DARPA space where its experts can load hardware and run it through their own boot sequences.
"This is a big deal for us because it essentially enables DARPA to kick the tires and to sort of figure out how good this machine is and how it's performing," Zulfi Alam, corporate vice president of Microsoft Quantum, said in an interview.
Alam said the arrangement imposes discipline as Microsoft moves from research toward a commercial product. DARPA's key evaluation metric is whether the value of the computation performed by a quantum system outweighs the system's cost.
"It enforces a certain amount of engineering rigor that scientific teams normally do not have," he said, describing DARPA as "a completely trusted organization" with which Microsoft can share both current work and future plans.
Alam said DARPA will start with the Majorana 2 chip, but that the system in Maryland will be built to swap in future chips Microsoft is developing.
Microsoft has said it plans to have commercial quantum systems ready by 2029.

Sept 22 : Microsoft will consider shareholder proposals at its annual meetings through next year, at the request of an activist looking to preserve investor rights as they come under pressure from a contentious U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission rule change proposed last week.
Under an agreement with conservative activist Paul Chesser, seen by Reuters, Microsoft will continue to apply existing thresholds for investors to submit resolutions for a vote, even as the SEC considers changes that critics say would sideline individual investors, religious groups, unions and others who have had a say through the shareholder proposal process for decades. 
The agreement only lasts a year, but could effectively offset efforts by the regulatory agency to shift power away from investors to corporate executives. Chesser said he hopes Microsoft's approach will become a corporate-governance model to assure mom-and-pop investors a voice that can be followed by other companies.
"Microsoft put in writing that the smallest long-term owners of the company will still have a way to be heard next year, no matter what the SEC does," said Chesser, director at the National Legal and Policy Center. "Every other company that claims to value its shareholders should be asked why it won't do the same," he said.

In an e-mailed statement, a Microsoft spokesperson said: "With the Securities and Exchange Commission announcing that its shareholder proposal regulatory framework is under review, we agreed to maintain the current eligibility thresholds for one year, providing Microsoft and its shareholders a clear and predictable process for the next proxy cycle."
Shareholder resolutions on topics like climate change, workforce diversity and executive pay have become the focus of many shareholder meetings in recent years, although many have received diminishing support from major fund firms. 
EARLY EXAMPLE
Microsoft's meeting is set for December 8 and traditionally has been held early in the proxy cycle that runs through June 30 of each year, bringing attention to the company's governance procedures. 
Last week SEC Chair Paul Atkins, an appointee of US President Donald Trump, proposed to end the agency's oversight of the resolutions process and move the function to state officials, which activists saw as a shift that would diminish their influence. The move is part of a broader shift of power away from investors toward managers by the Republican-dominated commission.
The agreement between Chesser and Microsoft, seen by Reuters, says Microsoft will continue to apply previous eligibility requirements for investors to submit resolutions for a vote. Chesser's group has similar resolutions pending with Procter & Gamble and Oracle and may submit more.
P&G's annual meeting is set for October 13. In its proxy statement dated August 28, the company recommended votes against the proposal, among other things calling it premature since the SEC hadn't yet proposed its rulemaking. A P&G representative declined to comment.
Oracle's AGM has not yet been set. A representative did not immediately respond to questions.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Irã apresenta condições para reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz a representante dos EUA, diz mídia estatal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O ministro das Relações Exteriores do Irã, Abbas Araqchi, se reuniu nesta terça-feira com o enviado especial dos Estados Unidos, Steve Witkoff, à margem da Assembleia Geral da ONU, e transmitiu as condições do Irã para reabrir o estratégico Estreito de Ormuz, disse a mídia estatal iraniana.
items.body:
O ministro das Relações Exteriores do Irã, Abbas Araqchi, se reuniu nesta terça-feira com o enviado especial dos Estados Unidos, Steve Witkoff, à margem da Assembleia Geral da ONU, e transmitiu as condições do Irã para reabrir o estratégico Estreito de Ormuz, disse a mídia estatal iraniana.
As condições para a reabertura do estreito incluem o levantamento imediato do bloqueio naval, a liberação imediata dos ativos iranianos congelados e o fim da guerra em todas as frentes de “resistência”, acrescentou a mídia estatal.

[ドバイ　２２日　ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は２２日、国連総会が開かれているニューヨークで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談し、戦略的要衝であるホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けたイランの条件を米国に伝えた。イラン国営メディアが報じた。

items.title: Dólar sube en volátil sesión los inversores evalúan perspectivas sobre inflación
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.summary: El dólar subió el martes en una sesión irregular, oscilando entre ganancias y pérdidas tras haber alcanzado previamente un máximo de dos meses, porque la volatilidad de los precios del petróleo enturbiaba el panorama de la inflación.
items.body:
El dólar subió el martes en una sesión irregular, oscilando entre ganancias y pérdidas tras haber alcanzado previamente un máximo de dos meses, porque la volatilidad de los precios del petróleo enturbiaba el panorama de la inflación.
* Los precios del petróleo bajaron alrededor de un 1%, retrocediendo desde máximos previos, luego de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo a periodistas en las Naciones Unidas que funcionarios estadounidenses habían mantenido una reunión "muy buena" de tres horas el martes con la delegación iraní.
* Los precios del crudo habían caído previamente a un mínimo de dos semanas tras la propuesta de Irán de reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz en un plazo de siete días si Estados Unidos reducía la presión militar, y después de que Teherán y Washington insinuaron la posibilidad de reactivar las negociaciones para poner fin a su conflicto.
* Sin embargo, el optimismo inicial se vio mermado cuando Trump dijo, en un discurso ante la Asamblea General de la ONU, que creía que Estados Unidos llegaría a un acuerdo con Irán tras las elecciones legislativas de principios de noviembre; esto impulsó tanto al precio del petróleo como al dólar.
* El índice dólar , que mide la divisa estadounidense frente a una cesta de monedas, subió un 0,17%, a 100,59 puntos, mientras que el euro cayó un 0,18%, a 1,1441 dólares. Durante la jornada, el índice dólar llegó a subir un 0,29%, a 100,70 puntos, su nivel más alto desde el 30 de julio, aunque también anotó caídas de hasta el 0,11%.
* El conflicto en curso entre Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán ha impulsado los precios del petróleo y avivado la preocupación por la inflación, lo que llevó a varios bancos centrales, incluida la Reserva Federal, a subir las tasas de interés en los últimos días; no obstante, el reciente optimismo sobre un posible acuerdo ha hecho que los precios del crudo vuelvan a situarse por debajo de los 100 dólares por barril.
* Los comentarios de funcionarios de la Fed tras la decisión de política monetaria también han señalado la posibilidad de nuevas alzas si la inflación no se desacelera.
* Frente al yen , el dólar se fortaleció un 0,03%, a 157,41 yenes, en su tercera ganancia diaria consecutiva. La libra esterlina se depreció un 0,23%, a 1,3332 dólares, a su segunda caída diaria seguida y la sexta en los últimos siete días.

items.title: Reino Unido se mantendrá firme sobre Malvinas, dice el primer ministro Burnham a Trump
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, expuso el martes la posición de su país sobre las Islas Malvinas durante una reunión con el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, en la que sostuvo que se mantendría firme ante cualquier amenaza.
items.body:
El primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham, expuso el martes la posición de su país sobre las Islas Malvinas durante una reunión con el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, en la que sostuvo que se mantendría firme ante cualquier amenaza.
En agosto, Trump declaró que estaba revisando la postura neutral de Estados Unidos sobre el archipiélago del Atlántico Sur. Días después, el presidente argentino, Javier Milei, anunció que sancionaría a las compañías petroleras que perforaran en las islas.
"Nuestra postura es clara: nos mantendremos firmes ante cualquier amenaza. Defenderemos el derecho de los habitantes de las Islas Malvinas a la autodeterminación y a seguir siendo británicos", declaró Burnham a periodistas.
"Solo quería que el presidente supiera directamente de mí cuál es la postura británica y él entendió perfectamente lo que le estaba diciendo", agregó.

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル続伸、インフレ見通しにらみ不安定な値動き
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが続伸して取引を終えた。原油価格の乱高下でインフレ見通しが不透明になる中、序盤に２カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、不安定な値動きが続いた。

原油価格は序盤、２週間ぶりの安値まで下落していた。イランが、米国が軍事的圧力を緩和し、イランの港湾封鎖を解除すれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できると述べたことや、イランと米国が紛争終結に向けた交渉再開の可能性を示唆したことが手掛かりとなった。

しかし、トランプ氏が国連総会での演説で、１１月の中間選挙後にイランとの合意に達すると考えていると述べたことで、原油とドルが上昇。序盤の楽観的なムードは後退した。

モネックスＵＳＡのトレーディング部門シニアディレクター、フアン・ペレス氏は「誰にとっても最大の脅威がインフレであることは明らかだが、問題は『なぜこれほどインフレが高いのか』ということだ」と指摘。「全てはイラン紛争が長引き、エスカレートしていることが原因だ」とし、「市場が現在このような状況にあり、ドルに明確な方向感が見られないのはこのためだ」と述べた。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１０月会合での利上げを巡って見方がほぼ二分しており、少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げ確率は５５．４％と、前日の５７．６％から低下している。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１７％高の１００．５９。同指数は一時、７月３０日以来の高値となる０．２９％高の１００．７０を付けたものの、０．１１％下落する場面もあった。

ドルは対円では０．０３％高の１５７．４１円と、３営業日続伸となる勢い。日銀が１８日の金融政策決定会合で利上げを決定したにもかかわらず、円は圧力にさらされている。より慎重なペースを主張した政策委員２人の反対票について、市場は追加利上げの実施が難しくなる可能性を示唆していると受け止めている。

ユーロは０．１８％安の１．１４４１ドル。

英ポンドは０．２３％安の１．３３３２ドルと、２営業日続落の見通しとなった。過去７営業日で６回目の下落となる。

items.body:

Conditions for reopening the strait include immediate lifting of the naval blockade, immediate release of frozen Iranian assets and end of war across all 'resistance' fronts, state media added.

items.summary: 03:45 PM EDT, 09/22/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks advanced late Tuesday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) adding
items.body: 03:45 PM EDT, 09/22/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks advanced late Tuesday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) adding 0.7% and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) rising 1.7%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index added 1.8%. In sector news, President Donald Trump has rejected calls to impose new regulations on the development of AI, saying US authorities will be able to rein in the sector if needed, media outlets reported Tuesday. In corporate news, SpaceX's (SPCX) SpaceXAI Grok Bot AI agent has exceeded 400,000 weekly users nearly a month after launch, Bloomberg reported, citing a company presentation shared at an event in London. Grok Bot hit 418,000 users as of Sept. 14, up 24% from the prior week, the report said. SpaceX shares were up 1.1%. Alibaba (BABA) unveiled its newest AI chip on Tuesday along with updates to its AI models, agent platforms and cloud infrastructure, as the Chinese giant looks to strengthen its position in the AI industry. Its shares rose 0.7%. Amazon-backed (AMZN) Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei will brief the UN Security Council on Wednesday alongside Microsoft-backed (MSFT) OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in a meeting about the future of AI, Bloomberg reported. Amazon shares were down 1%, and Microsoft was shedding 0.5%. Apple (AAPL) is developing a screenless fitness tracker similar to Whoop's wrist device, Bloomberg reported. Apple shares added 0.3%.

items.title: Zelenskiy discute esforços de paz e cessar-fogo no setor energético com Trump
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou nesta terça-feira que discutiu, durante reunião com o presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, um cessar-fogo no setor energético e formas de pôr fim à guerra com a Rússia.
items.body:
O presidente da Ucrânia, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou nesta terça-feira que discutiu, durante reunião com o presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, um cessar-fogo no setor energético e formas de pôr fim à guerra com a Rússia.
Em declarações à imprensa após uma reunião de 40 minutos com Trump e sua equipe, Zelenskiy disse que Kiev está pronta para qualquer formato de trégua energética com a Rússia, mas não houve qualquer discussão para uma interrupção unilateral dos ataques ucranianos a refinarias russas.
Zelenskiy reiterou que está pronto para se encontrar com o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, em uma reunião trilateral com Trump, acrescentando esperar que os EUA encontrem uma maneira de levar Moscou a algum tipo de negociação.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La brasileña Suzano aumentará los precios de la pulpa de celulosa 50 dólares por tonelada métrica en octubre en Europa y América, y 20 dólares por tonelada en Asia, informó la empresa el martes, confirmando una noticia previa de Reuters.
items.body:
La brasileña Suzano (SUZB3.SA) aumentará los precios de la pulpa de celulosa 50 dólares por tonelada métrica en octubre en Europa y América, y 20 dólares por tonelada en Asia, informó la empresa el martes, confirmando una noticia previa de Reuters.
El aumento en Europa situará los precios en 1.360 dólares por tonelada.
La subida de precios de Suzano para Asia sigue a otro aumento este mes, el primero desde abril.
Las acciones de Suzano subían alrededor de un 2,4% por la tarde, una de las principales alzas entre los valores del índice bursátil de referencia de Brasil, el Bovespa (.BVSP) , que ganaba aproximadamente un 0,4%.

items.title: Britain will stand firm over Falklands, UK PM Burnham tells Trump
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham set out Britain's position on the Falkland Islands during a meeting with US President Donald Trump on Tuesday, saying he would stand firm in the face of any threats.
items.body:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham set out Britain's position on the Falkland Islands during a meeting with US President Donald Trump on Tuesday, saying he would stand firm in the face of any threats.
In August, Trump said he was reviewing the United States' neutral position on the remote archipelago in the South Atlantic. Days later Argentine President Javier Milei said he would sanction oil companies drilling in the islands.
"The clear position is: we will stand firm in the face of any threats. We will defend the right of the Falkland Islanders to self-determination and to remain British," Burnham told reporters.
"I just wanted the president to know directly from me, that's the clear British position, and he very much understood what I was saying."

items.title: Pirates reinstate Kirby Yates from IL, DFA Camilo Doval
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates swapped one former All-Star closer for another Tuesday when Kirby Yates was activated from the injured list and fellow right-hander Camilo Doval was designated for assignment.
items.body:
The Pittsburgh Pirates swapped one former All-Star closer for another Tuesday when Kirby Yates was activated from the injured list and fellow right-hander Camilo Doval was designated for assignment.
Yates, 39, has appeared in a combined 44 games for the Pirates and Los Angeles Angels this season and has three saves while going 2-5 with a 3.40 ERA. The two-time All-Star saved as many as 41 games for the San Diego Padres in 2019 and has 101 career saves over 12 seasons with a 3.36 ERA for eight different clubs.
Yates last pitched on Aug. 30 because of a right shoulder impingement.
Doval, 29, is 3-2 with a 4.30 ERA in 64 combined relief appearances this season for the New York Yankees and Pirates. The one-time All-Star saved as many as 39 games for the San Francisco Giants in 2023 and has 109 career saves over six seasons.
Yates was acquired in an Aug. 3 trade from the Angels, two days after Doval was acquired in a deal from the Yankees.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Report: Bears QB Tyson Bagent in concussion protocol
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Chicago Bears' quarterback concerns deepened Tuesday with starter Caleb Williams dealing with a hamstring injury and backup Tyson Bagent entering concussion protocol, NFL Network reported.
items.body:
The Chicago Bears' quarterback concerns deepened Tuesday with starter Caleb Williams dealing with a hamstring injury and backup Tyson Bagent entering concussion protocol, NFL Network reported.
Williams has not been ruled out to play Monday against the Philadelphia Eagles after he was injured on a fourth-quarter scramble near the goal line this past weekend. He is currently listed as "week-to-week" by head coach Ben Johnson.
If Bagent and Williams are unable to play against the Eagles, Chicago's third-string quarterback is 38-year-old Case Keenum, who has not played in a game since 2023 and has made just four starts since 2020.
Williams, who guided the Bears to the NFC Divisional Round of the playoffs last season, was 15-of-26 passing for 138 yards and an interception Sunday, with 42 rushing yards despite being sacked three times. Bagent took over and went 5-of-9 passing for 54 yards.
Chicago fell 9-3 at home to the Minnesota Vikings and dropped to 1-1 on the season after scoring 59 points in a Week 1 victory over the Carolina Panthers.
--Field Level Media

CHESTER-LE-STREET, England, Sept 22 : Will Jacks took a career best 5-22 and scored an unbeaten 46 to guide England to an 89-run victory over Sri Lanka in the first One Day International at Chester-le-Street on Tuesday.
After electing to bat, England posted 265 all out in 48.1 overs, before Sri Lanka limped their way to 176 all out in 37 overs in reply as the home side continued their good recent run in the format ahead of next year’s Cricket World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.
England have won five of their last six ODI fixtures, a run that also includes two victories over Sri Lanka in Colombo in January.
"It wasn’t the easiest of surfaces but we want to be a team that can adapt to conditions and get a win when they are not in our favour and I thought we did that very well today," England captain Harry Brook told Sky Sports.

"Jacks is an outstanding player and has been for many years now. The way he has come into this role in the middle order and played his part with the ball has been awesome." 
Their innings was given impetus by Brook’s 67 from 69 balls before he holed out at deep cover.
Jacks struck a fine unbeaten 46 from 47 balls, while Joe Root was bowled by debutant leg-spinner Sachindu Colombage for 44 from 52 deliveries.
Colombage, 28, picked up 3-44 in his 10 overs with Jos Buttler (31) another of his victims in a promising debut.  
The wicket was a little slow, which made stroke-play more challenging, as England's last five wickets added 69 runs after 300 had seemed on the cards at one point.
Seamer Asitha Fernando managed some swing and took 3-53 in his 9.1 overs.
Captain Kusal Mendis scored 42 from 60 balls but Sri Lanka could not stem the flow of wickets and, just as they have throughout the tour, struggled to form partnerships.
Dunith Wellalage hit a brisk 45 from 36 deliveries but was one of three wickets for spinner Jacks in a single over to end the game. 
"The bowlers did really well in the first innings, but our middle order was struggling a little when we were batting. We have to try and create something more special in the middle order and had to score more boundaries earlier (in the innings),” Sri Lanka captain Kusal Mendis said.
The second match in the series will be played in Leeds on Thursday, before a final clash at The Oval on Sunday.    

Source: Reuters

items.title: Binance faces US criminal probe over Iran sanctions violations | What we know
items.author: Trisha Bhattacharya
items.summary: US prosecutors are investigating Binance over possible Iran sanctions violations and whether the crypto exchange knowingly allowed prohibited trading. The probe adds to the company’s history of US regulatory scrutiny following its 2023 guilty plea.
items.body: US prosecutors are investigating cryptocurrency exchange Binance over possible violations of US sanctions on Iran and trading activity conducted through its platform, according to a person familiar with the matter, Reuters reported on 22 September.Binance faces US probe over possible Iran sanctions violationsThe investigation is being led by federal prosecutors from the US Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York and the Justice Department’s criminal division in Washington. Bloomberg News first reported the probe, saying investigators are examining whether Binance knowingly allowed trading that breached US sanctions.The US Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of New York and the Justice Department’s criminal division declined to comment on the investigation.Binance, meanwhile, said it maintains a zero-tolerance approach to sanctions violations and is cooperating with authorities.“We fully cooperate with law enforcement, and we remain committed to rooting out and shutting down bad actors,” the company said in a statement to Reuters.Why is Binance facing scrutiny?The latest investigation comes as Washington has intensified its sanctions campaign against Iranian entities and individuals accused of supporting Tehran and its regional proxies.Earlier this month, federal prosecutors in Manhattan also sought the forfeiture of millions of dollars linked to Iranian oil sales that they alleged had been laundered through Binance. The new criminal probe appears to examine a related question: whether the exchange’s systems and controls adequately prevented prohibited Iran-linked trading.Binance has already faced significant US enforcement action over its handling of sanctions and anti-money laundering requirements.In November 2023, the company pleaded guilty to federal charges involving violations of the Bank Secrecy Act, operating as an unregistered money-transmitting business and violating the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.Binance agreed to pay more than $4.3 billion in penalties and forfeiture, while its then-chief executive and founder, Changpeng Zhao, also pleaded guilty to failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering programme.The Justice Department said at the time that Binance knew it had users in comprehensively sanctioned jurisdictions, including Iran, as well as US users.Prosecutors said the exchange failed to prevent transactions between the two groups, resulting in more than $898 million in trades between US users and users ordinarily resident in Iran between January 2018 and May 2022.Zhao stepped down as CEO as part of the 2023 resolution and later served nearly four months in prison. In October 2025, President Donald Trump pardoned Zhao, according to the White House and Reuters.The current investigation does not establish that Binance committed a new sanctions violation. Prosecutors are examining the matter, and no new criminal charges against the exchange have been announced.
items.raw_description: US prosecutors are investigating Binance over possible Iran sanctions violations and whether the crypto exchange knowingly allowed prohibited trading. The probe adds to the company’s history of US regulatory scrutiny following its 2023 guilty plea.

items.title: Ottawa opens up 15% Trans Mountain equity stake to Indigenous groups on pipeline path
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Canadian government is offering Indigenous groups a collective 15 per cent ownership stake in the Trans Mountain pipeline through a low-cost loan.
items.body: OTTAWA — The Canadian government is offering Indigenous groups a collective 15 per cent ownership stake in the Trans Mountain pipeline through a low-cost loan. In a letter to a First Nation along the pipeline’s path and seen by The Canadian Press, a federal Department of Finance official says the equity investment would be equally distributed among participating groups. It says details of the federal government’s offer would be shared during a series of in-person meetings in Vancouver, Victoria, Kamloops and Edmonton planned for late October. The official says the government will provide the affected Indigenous communities with up to $100,000 to support such expenses as travel, office space rental and equipment through March 2028. Ottawa bought the existing Trans Mountain pipeline, its expansion project and related assets for $4.5 billion in 2018. It later committed to exploring Indigenous economic participation in the expansion with 129 Indigenous communities potentially affected by the project. The expansion increased the Trans Mountain system’s capacity from roughly 300,000 barrels per day to about 890,000 barrels per day. --- Brett Bundale, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 22, 2026.

items.title: McDonald's defeats most of Black franchisees' sweeping race bias lawsuit
items.author: Daniel Wiessner
items.creator: Daniel Wiessner
items.summary: A US judge in Chicago has significantly narrowed a sprawling lawsuit accusing McDonald's of pervasive discrimination against Black franchise owners, finding that the case was overstuffed with claims that were vague or untimely.
items.body:
A US judge in Chicago has significantly narrowed a sprawling lawsuit accusing McDonald's of pervasive discrimination against Black franchise owners, finding that the case was overstuffed with claims that were vague or untimely.
US District Judge Steven Seeger in a 125-page decision on Monday said the scope of the lawsuit, which was filed in 2023 by 48 McDonald's franchisees, pushed the bounds of what is allowed under federal litigation rules.
Seeger said the lawsuit's core allegations that McDonald's exhibited a pattern of [USN:L1N3150XV TEXT:"setting up Black franchisees to fail"] could only be brought in a class action, and not by individual plaintiffs aggregating their claims. But even a class action would likely falter, the judge said, because each plaintiff's circumstances were considerably different.
The lawsuit, Seeger wrote, "is reminiscent of the old game of seeing how many people can fit in a phone booth. At some point, you hit a wall, and stuffing anything more into one space becomes completely impracticable."
Seeger also dismissed retaliation claims, finding the plaintiffs had not alleged that they engaged in protected conduct such as filing complaints with government agencies, and said that dozens of fraud and tortious interference claims were time-barred.
A small number of the claims will proceed, primarily focused on whether McDonald's violated franchise agreements by denying the plaintiffs access to benefits such as rent relief that were extended to other franchise owners.
McDonald's, in a statement provided by a spokesperson, said the ruling affirmed the company's position that the lawsuit lacked merit.
“McDonald's provides robust resources to ensure our franchisees can succeed; our success is tied to their success," the company said.
Steve Art, a lawyer for the plaintiffs, declined to comment until his clients had a chance to review the ruling.
Until last year, McDonald's was represented in the case by former US Attorney General Loretta Lynch, who served under Democratic former President Barack Obama, and others at law firm Paul Weiss. McDonald's is now represented by Chicago-based Riley Safer Holmes & Cancila and its managing partner, Patricia Holmes.
Lynch had also represented McDonald's in [USN:L1N30R1VG TEXT:"a lawsuit by the media entrepreneur Byron Allen"] accusing the fast-food chain of intentionally excluding Black-owned media from much of its advertising budget. McDonald's [USN:L1N3SG10D TEXT:"settled the case"] last year on confidential terms, and denied wrongdoing.
There are three lawsuits pending before Seeger that collectively involve 80 franchisees accusing McDonald's of a decades-long pattern of race discrimination. They claim McDonald's deliberately steered Black franchisees to purchase underperforming restaurants in predominantly Black areas with high crime rates while denying them opportunities in affluent, more profitable areas.
McDonald's also offered Black franchise owners less operational support, imposed harsher demands, and obstructed their business expansion efforts, the plaintiffs claim.
Monday's ruling largely tracked a March decision by Seeger in a separate lawsuit brought by a single Black franchisee.
The case is Manning v. McDonald's, US District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, No. 1:23-cv-00210.
For the plaintiffs: Daniel Twetten, Steven Art and Quinn Rallins of Loevy & Loevy
For McDonald's: Patricia Holmes of Riley Safer Holmes & Cancila

items.title: Yankees hold off Rays' celebration with win in doubleheader opener
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Cody Bellinger hit a two-run home run in the fourth inning as the host New York Yankees recorded a 2-0 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays in the opener of a day-night doubleheader on Tuesday.
items.body:
Cody Bellinger hit a two-run home run in the fourth inning as the host New York Yankees recorded a 2-0 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays in the opener of a day-night doubleheader on Tuesday.
With the victory, the Yankees (90-66) prevented the Rays (95-61) from clinching the AL East and moved six games ahead of the Boston Red Sox for the American League's top wild-card spot.
Tampa Bay still has a magic number of two to clinch the fifth divisional title in team history and first since 2021.
New York's Carlos Rodon (7-3) scattered three singles over eight innings as the Yankees finished off the victory in a brisk 2 hours, 2 minutes. Rays right-hander Nick Martinez (15-5) allowed two runs on five hits over six innings with seven strikeouts to take his first loss since July 9.
Rodon allowed singles to Chandler Simpson in the second, Victor Mesa Jr. in the sixth and Jonathan Aranda in the seventh. The left-hander struck out eight in his 100th career win and longest outing since he went eight innings against the Chicago Cubs on July 11, 2025.
Rodon also reached 1,500 strikeouts when he set down Jonny DeLuca on a slider in the eighth.
Martinez retired the first nine Yankees hitters of the game before Ben Rice laced a double to right field to lead off the fourth inning and Bellinger hammered the next pitch to the right-field seats for a 2-0 lead.
It was Bellinger's 17th home run and sixth in his past 26 games.
Bellinger also started a key double play from left field to end the sixth. After Mesa opened the inning with a single, Richie Palacios lofted a fly ball to left with Bellinger making the catch then firing a one-hop throw to first baseman Luis Garcia Jr. to complete the double play.
It was Bellinger's eighth outfield assist of the season.
David Bednar finished New York's 15th shutout by retiring Yandy Diaz for his 35th save.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy says he discussed peace efforts, energy ceasefire with Trump
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that he discussed an energy ceasefire and how to end the war with Russia during his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.
items.body:
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that he discussed an energy ceasefire and how to end the war with Russia during his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.
Talking to the media after a 40-minute meeting with Trump and his team, Zelenskiy said that Kyiv was ready for any format of the energy ceasefire with Russia, but there had been no discussion of Ukraine unilaterally halting its attacks on Russian refineries.
Zelenskiy reiterated that he was ready to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump, adding that he hoped that the U.S. would find a way to bring Moscow to any kind of negotiations.

items.title: Turkey central bank governor says disinflation continues, urges caution
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: ANKARA, Sept 22 (Reuters) - Turkey's central bank governor said on Tuesday that data pointed to continued disinflation despite more challenging supply condi
items.body: ANKARA, Sept 22 (Reuters) - Turkey's central bank governor said on Tuesday that data pointed to continued disinflation despite more challenging supply conditions, while inflation expectations warranted continued caution. In a presentation in New York, Fatih Karahan said supply shocks had materially affected headline inflation and services inflation remained persistent, but the underlying inflation trend had recently decelerated. Economic growth had slowed as domestic demand weakened, with high-frequency indicators pointing to further demand moderation in the third quarter, he said. The governor said external shocks and domestic transmission channels would shape inflation going forward, while international reserve buffers remained strong. (Reporting by Nevzat Devranoglu Editing by Ece Toksabay) ((ece.toksabay@tr.com;))

items.title: Hackers do ShinyHunters dizem ter invadido sistemas do FBI
items.author: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.summary: O grupo de extorsão digital conhecido como “ShinyHunters” anunciou nesta terça-feira ter invadido sistemas da polícia federal dos Estados Unidos, o FBI, alegando ter roubado dados de milhares de funcionários do órgão.
items.body:
O grupo de extorsão digital conhecido como “ShinyHunters” anunciou nesta terça-feira ter invadido sistemas da polícia federal dos Estados Unidos, o FBI, alegando ter roubado dados de milhares de funcionários do órgão.
O FBI não respondeu imediatamente a pedidos de comentários feitos pela Reuters.
O ShinyHunters afirmou em um comunicado publicado em seu site na dark web, e durante um bate-papo online com a Reuters, que teve o FBI como alvo em resposta a um comunicado do órgão de maio deste ano que detalhou os métodos do grupo de hackers e aconselhava os alvos a não pagarem as exigências. O grupo compartilhou o que alegou ser uma captura de tela de um site de vagas do FBI vandalizado e o que descreveu como uma amostra dos dados roubados.
A Reuters não conseguiu verificar a autenticidade da captura de tela, mas uma mensagem publicada no site de vagas do FBI nesta terça-feira informava que o site e o “Portal de Candidatos a Agente Especial” do FBI estavam ambos “indisponíveis no momento”.
A Reuters conseguiu verificar parcialmente a autenticidade de algumas das informações supostamente roubadas do quadro de funcionários do FBI, comparando os nomes e endereços postais com registros de agências de crédito e dados de violações anteriores preservados pela empresa de inteligência da dark web District 4 Labs.
Em pelo menos nove casos, a Reuters encontrou uma correspondência. No entanto, a agência de notícias não conseguiu determinar de onde os dados vieram, nem se eles foram roubados dos sistemas internos do FBI, como alegam os hackers.

items.body: Broad bias, retaliation claims by 48 franchisees are dismissed McDonald's accused of setting up Black-owned locations to fail Claims involving unequal benefits will proceed By Daniel Wiessner Sept 22 (Reuters) - A US judge in Chicago has significantly narrowed a sprawling lawsuit accusing McDonald's of pervasive discrimination against Black franchise owners, finding that the case was overstuffed with claims that were vague or untimely. US District Judge Steven Seeger in a 125-page decision on Monday said the scope of the lawsuit, which was filed in 2023 by 48 McDonald's franchisees, pushed the bounds of what is allowed under federal litigation rules. Seeger said the lawsuit's core allegations that McDonald's exhibited a pattern of setting up Black franchisees to fail could only be brought in a class action, and not by individual plaintiffs aggregating their claims. But even a class action would likely falter, the judge said, because each plaintiff's circumstances were considerably different. The lawsuit, Seeger wrote, "is reminiscent of the old game of seeing how many people can fit in a phone booth. At some point, you hit a wall, and stuffing anything more into one space becomes completely impracticable." Seeger also dismissed retaliation claims, finding the plaintiffs had not alleged that they engaged in protected conduct such as filing complaints with government agencies, and said that dozens of fraud and tortious interference claims were time-barred. A small number of the claims will proceed, primarily focused on whether McDonald's violated franchise agreements by denying the plaintiffs access to benefits such as rent relief that were extended to other franchise owners. McDonald's, in a statement provided by a spokesperson, said the ruling affirmed the company's position that the lawsuit lacked merit. “McDonald's provides robust resources to ensure our franchisees can succeed; our success is tied to their success," the company said. Steve Art, a lawyer for the plaintiffs, declined to comment until his clients had a chance to review the ruling. Until last year, McDonald's was represented in the case by former US Attorney General Loretta Lynch, who served under Democratic former President Barack Obama, and others at law firm Paul Weiss. McDonald's is now represented by Chicago-based Riley Safer Holmes & Cancila and its managing partner, Patricia Holmes. Lynch had also represented McDonald's in a lawsuit by the media entrepreneur Byron Allen accusing the fast-food chain of intentionally excluding Black-owned media from much of its advertising budget. McDonald's settled the case last year on confidential terms, and denied wrongdoing. There are three lawsuits pending before Seeger that collectively involve 80 franchisees accusing McDonald's of a decades-long pattern of race discrimination. They claim McDonald's deliberately steered Black franchisees to purchase underperforming restaurants in predominantly Black areas with high crime rates while denying them opportunities in affluent, more profitable areas. McDonald's also offered Black franchise owners less operational support, imposed harsher demands, and obstructed their business expansion efforts, the plaintiffs claim. Monday's ruling largely tracked a March decision by Seeger in a separate lawsuit brought by a single Black franchisee. The case is Manning v. McDonald's, US District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, No. 1:23-cv-00210. For the plaintiffs: Daniel Twetten, Steven Art and Quinn Rallins of Loevy & Loevy For McDonald's: Patricia Holmes of Riley Safer Holmes & Cancila Read more: McDonald's defeats Black franchisees' $1 billion bias lawsuit, for now McDonald's must face Black ex-executives' claims of harassment, retaliation McDonald's settles Byron Allen's $10 billion lawsuit over ads for Black-owned media Judge dismisses lawsuit against McDonald's by Black franchisees (Reporting by Daniel Wiessner in Albany, New York)

items.title: Minister says he's working with G7 to set up AI safety organization
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Artificial Intelligence Minister Evan Solomon says he has talked to his international counterparts about setting up an organization to tackle AI safety.
items.body: OTTAWA — Artificial Intelligence Minister Evan Solomon says he has talked to his international counterparts about setting up an organization to tackle AI safety. Solomon says he spoke with counterparts at the G7 today about establishing an international “technology stability board.” He says the board would evaluate AI models for testing before they are released. Solomon says the safety of AI is a key government priority and he also spoke with other G20 countries about the issue on Friday. Warnings about the risks AI poses to humans have prompted global alarm in recent weeks. Prime Minister Mark Carney said last week a global “technology stability” body along the lines of the Financial Stability Board would make sense. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Sept. 22, 2026 Anja Karadeglija, The Canadian Press

items.title: Grande furacão Polo ganha força na costa do Pacífico do México
items.author: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raul Cortes
items.creator: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raul Cortes
items.summary: O furacão Polo, que na manhã desta terça-feira atingiu a categoria 5 -- a mais alta possível --, continuou se intensificando na costa do Pacífico do México, representando riscos de inundações potencialmente fatais, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC, na sigla em inglês) dos EUA.
items.body:
O furacão Polo, que na manhã desta terça-feira atingiu a categoria 5 -- a mais alta possível --, continuou se intensificando na costa do Pacífico do México, representando riscos de inundações potencialmente fatais, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC, na sigla em inglês) dos EUA.
Apesar da proximidade e das fortes chuvas que trará, a expectativa é que Polo se desloque lentamente ao largo da costa nos próximos dois dias e mude sua trajetória, afastando-se ainda mais da costa, acrescentou um comunicado do NHC.
“Espera-se uma mudança de rumo para noroeste e oeste-noroeste ainda nesta noite e na quarta-feira”, alertou o NHC. “Na trajetória prevista, o centro do Polo deverá ficar próximo à costa do sudoeste do México nos próximos dias, embora a previsão seja de que ele permaneça no mar.”
Com ventos máximos sustentados próximos a 270 km/h, é provável que haja um fortalecimento adicional até a noite desta terça-feira. Uma aeronave “Hurricane Hunter” da Administração Oceânica e Atmosférica Nacional (NOAA) está a caminho para investigar o Polo, acrescentou o boletim.
O Polo, classificado pelo NHC como “extremamente perigoso”, está atualmente localizado a cerca de 335 km ao sul da cidade turística de Zihuatanejo.
Há expectativa de que as chuvas nos Estados costeiros de Guerrero e Michoacán provoquem inundações e deslizamentos de terra considerados de alto risco, enquanto chuvas menos prejudiciais também são esperadas nas regiões costeiras dos Estados de Oaxaca, Colima e Jalisco, informou o NHC.
Autoridades mexicanas alertaram para a previsão de chuvas intensas nas regiões oeste e sul do país, que podem causar transbordamentos de rios.
A empresa privada de previsão meteorológica AccuWeather observou que o alcance da tempestade pode se estender a destinos turísticos como Acapulco e Puerto Vallarta, enquanto o sul da Baja California Sur, incluindo a região de Los Cabos, também pode enfrentar ondas de tempestade e fortes rajadas de vento até domingo.
Posteriormente, a tempestade poderá seguir mais para o interior e em direção aos EUA, mas será influenciada pela interação com a tempestade tropical Odalys, o que poderá manter o furacão mais distante da costa e limitar a chegada da umidade tropical ao sudoeste dos EUA.
Os ventos fortes e as chuvas do Polo também devem atingir Lázaro Cárdenas e Manzanillo, principais portos do país.
“Até o momento, as informações que temos indicam que não atingirá diretamente a costa; ele contornará... especialmente os Estados de Jalisco, Colima e Michoacán. E peço a todos ao longo da costa do Pacífico que permaneçam muito atentos”, disse a presidente Claudia Sheinbaum durante sua coletiva de imprensa matinal de rotina.
Em 2023, Acapulco sofreu a fúria do furacão Otis, considerado o ciclone tropical mais forte a atingir a costa do Pacífico mexicano. A tempestade, que ocorreu no final de outubro, deixou pelo menos 68 mortes confirmadas, segundo a Procuradoria Geral do Estado de Guerrero, e causou aproximadamente US$16 bilhões em danos, de acordo com estimativas de associações empresariais mexicanas.

items.title: Trump compró y vendió acciones de SpaceX, la empresa de Musk, en julio, según declaración patrimonial
items.author: Courtney Rozen
items.creator: Courtney Rozen
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, compró en julio acciones por un valor de hasta 50.000 dólares y vendió otras por un valor de hasta 15.000 dólares de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según un documento público.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, compró en julio acciones por un valor de hasta 50.000 dólares y vendió otras por un valor de hasta 15.000 dólares de SpaceX, la empresa de Elon Musk, según un documento público.
Trump compró acciones de SpaceX por un valor de entre 15.001 y 50.000 dólares el 10 de julio, según una declaración financiera que firmó el 8 de septiembre. Vendió acciones por un valor de entre 1.001 y 15.000 dólares el 17 de julio, según la misma declaración.
La compra y la venta formaban parte de las más de 1.000 operaciones que el presidente realizó en julio. La Oficina de Ética Gubernamental, el equipo encargado de recopilar las declaraciones de ética de los funcionarios estadounidenses, publicó el formulario en su página web el martes.
Estas últimas operaciones añaden un nuevo vínculo financiero entre el presidente y la empresa de cohetes de Musk, en un momento en que la Administración está tomando decisiones que podrían afectar al futuro de la empresa.
SpaceX fijó el precio de la mayor salida a bolsa de la historia de Estados Unidos el 12 de junio, valorando al proveedor de servicios espaciales, de satélites e inteligencia artificial en 1,77 billones de dólares. Reuters ya había informado de que Trump compró acciones de SpaceX en junio.
El portavoz de Trump no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
Reuters no pudo determinar de inmediato el importe exacto de la inversión de Trump, ya que los funcionarios federales utilizan rangos para declarar el valor de sus activos en sus formularios de declaración patrimonial.
SpaceX es un contratista del ejército estadounidense y, a menudo, solicita autorizaciones a las agencias federales.

items.title: Iraq suspends Iranian flights to Baghdad after US sanctions threat, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iraq ordered its civil aviation authority to suspend Iranian flights to Baghdad airport starting Wednesday, two sources told Reuters, after the United States threatened to sanction any airport that services Iranian carriers.
items.body:
Iraq ordered its civil aviation authority to suspend Iranian flights to Baghdad airport starting Wednesday, two sources told Reuters, after the United States threatened to sanction any airport that services Iranian carriers.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Monday that all Iranian airlines would be shut down on September 23 by the threat of secondary sanctions on air services providers, seven months into the war between the United States and Iran.
The Iraqi government is discussing diverting Iranian Airways flights from Baghdad to Najaf airport, two sources familiar with the matter said. They spoke on condition of anonymity because of the sensitivity of the matter.
The suspension of flights will begin Wednesday midnight.
Iranian news agency Tasnim said earlier, citing the Iranian Civil Aviation Organization, that flights from Tehran to Baghdad and Muscat have been canceled starting Wednesday and that all the remaining international flights including Istanbul will operate according to schedule.
"Iranian travelers are not currently being admitted at the airport in Oman, and consultations regarding this matter are ongoing," a spokesperson for Iran's Civil Aviation Organization told Iran's semi-official ISNA news agency.
[USN:S0N43U00Z TEXT:"Bessent"] told CNBC that when Iranian airlines land at an airport, "you cannot provide them with fuel, you cannot provide them with landing services, you cannot sell them tickets, or you will be knocked out of the dollar system."

items.title: Messagepoint Named a Leader in the 2026 IDC MarketScape for Intelligent Customer Communication Management
items.author: Business Wire
items.summary: Messagepoint today announced that it has been named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Intelligent Customer Communication Management 2026 Vendor Assessment (Doc. #US54131626, September 2026).
items.body: This press release is provided by Business Wire and is published as received. TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Messagepoint today announced that it has been named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Intelligent Customer Communication Management 2026 Vendor Assessment (Doc. #US54131626, September 2026). The IDC MarketScape evaluates vendors serving the worldwide customer communication management (CCM) market. The 2026 assessment examines the strength and maturity of vendors’ AI and automation strategies, their governance and compliance capabilities as AI takes on more work, and their ability to reduce the operational and administrative burden associated with CCM. The IDC MarketScape notes, “Messagepoint has an established business-user authoring legacy, offering a cloud-based environment where non-technical users can create and manage content, targeting rules, and communications without IT involvement. Messagepoint separates content from presentation for easier updates, governance, and personalization. MARCIEAssist™ extends this with agentic AI, letting users describe an outcome or upload a source document and have the AI reason over, execute, and automate the changes, reducing complexity and improving productivity at scale.” Introduced in 2026, MARCIEAssist is the first agentic AI capability purpose-built to automate the work of CCM. Through a natural-language interface, users can ask MARCIEAssist to perform supported work securely across content, rules, data, and templates. The capability interprets the request, develops a plan, seeks approvals and then passes the work for execution by Messagepoint’s deterministic engine. This gives non-technical users a simpler way to create and manage content, targeting rules, and communications, and even undo any changes made, without relying on IT. “AI is now touching nearly every part of the CCM platform, including authoring, personalization, admin, migration, and orchestration,” said Amy Machado, research director at IDC. “Organizations should evaluate not only the breadth of a vendor’s AI capabilities, but also how those capabilities address governance, authorization, auditability, and data protection.” IDC MarketScape also identifies Messagepoint’s integration and API strategy and migration as key strengths. The company’s RESTful APIs and headless architecture allow centrally managed content to support personalized communications across digital channels and enterprise platforms, while Messagepoint Rationalizer leverages AI to accelerate the ingestion, optimization, and migration of content from legacy CCM systems. For supported legacy systems, the solution can preserve and migrate content, data files, business rules, layouts, and styles while identifying opportunities to eliminate duplication and establish reusable content structures. Together these capabilities provide the foundation for applying agentic AI across the work of customer communications management. “We are very pleased to have been named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for Intelligent Customer Communication Management,” said Steve Biancaniello, CEO of Messagepoint. “We began embedding purpose-built AI into our platform in 2018 to help organizations understand, optimize, and migrate complex communications content. MARCIEAssist builds on that foundation by enabling AI agents to take on the work of CCM within the context, governance and controls enterprises require.” Messagepoint Communications Cloud supports the complete customer communications lifecycle, including onboarding, content management, composition, production management, orchestration, digital delivery, and quality assurance. Its cloud-based, AI-powered, API-centric architecture enables organizations to centrally manage governed content and deliver consistent, personalized batch, on-demand and ad hoc communications across print and digital channels. To download a complimentary excerpt from the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Intelligent Customer Communication Management 2026 Vendor Assessment, visit https://www.messagepoint.com/resources/2026-idc-marketscape-for-intelligent-customer-communication-management. About Messagepoint Messagepoint is a leading provider of AI-powered customer communications management software that transforms how complex customer communications are created, managed, and delivered. An award-winning innovator in the CCM market, Messagepoint has pioneered solutions that empower business users to manage highly personalized, regulated communications with greater speed, accuracy, and control. Today, Messagepoint leverages advanced AI, including agentic AI, to simplify the migration, optimization, authoring, management, and orchestration of communications across all channels. Organizations rely on Messagepoint to deliver exceptional customer experiences with greater efficiency, confidence, and compliance. For more information, visit www.messagepoint.com. items.title: 高市首相、国連演説でＩＣＣに言及へ　国際情勢の緊迫化に「三つの柱」提唱
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Tamiyuki Kihara

[２３日 ロイター] - 高市早苗首相は２３日（現地時間２２日）、米ニューヨークの国連本部で開かれている国連総会の一般討論演説に臨む。地政学的対立の先鋭化によって国際情勢が緊迫し、自由な交易やエネルギーの安定供給が脅かされているとし、日本が注力する三つの柱を提唱する。国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）などを例に挙げ、国際裁判所と法の支配の重要性を一貫して支持する日本の姿勢をアピールする。

演説の中で高市氏はまず、世界各地で地政学的競争が激化し、日々罪のない市民が命を失っているとの問題意識を提示。「国際社会が新たな課題を乗り越えて繁栄する上で、今ほど、国連が重要な時代はない」と強調する。

その上で、安倍晋三元首相が提唱した「自由で開かれたインド太平洋（ＦＯＩＰ）」に言及。自由な交易が妨げられ、エネルギーの安定供給やサプライチェーン（供給網）に支障が生じているとし、「自らの運命を自らの手で決めるために必要な『自律性』と『強靱性』を、経済・社会・安全保障という全ての面で各国が身につけていく」ため、三つの柱を提唱する。

一つ目は、エネルギー・重要物資のサプライチェーン強靱化だ。特定の国は名指しせず「国際社会全体で恣意的な輸出規制に対する懸念が強まっている」とし、日本の取り組みを紹介する。

二つ目は平和と安定に向けた連携強化。日本が戦後一貫して核軍縮・不拡散に取り組んできたとし、「『核兵器のない世界』に向けた国際社会の取り組みを主導することは、唯一の戦争被爆国である我が国の使命」と強調する。ロシアと北朝鮮の軍事協力によって「核・ミサイル関連技術の拡散も懸念される」とする一方、北朝鮮による拉致問題の文脈では「互いに実りある関係を作るべく、私には、対話し、具体的に行動する用意がある」と呼びかける。

三つ目に挙げるのは、法の支配に基づく自由で開かれた国際秩序の維持・発展への貢献だ。力や威圧による一方的な現状変更の試みは「世界のどこであっても認めることはできない」と訴える。また、ＩＣＣなどを例示し、「様々な国際裁判所を一貫して支持し、判事を輩出していること」が、法の支配を重視する日本の姿勢の表れだと強調する。米国から制裁対象とされた赤根智子ＩＣＣ所長の名前には触れない見通しだ。イラン情勢も取り上げ、ホルムズ海峡の自由かつ安全な航行は「国際経済全体の安定のためにも極めて重要だ」と指摘する。

高市氏はこの他、気候変動対策の重要性に加え、第二次世界大戦の敗戦国を対象にした「旧敵国条項」の削除を含む国連憲章の見直しや安全保障理事会の変革など、国連改革の必要性を訴える。日本が国連と歩みを重ねる方針は今後も変わらないとし、「国連と共に、インド太平洋を、そして国際社会を、より強靱に豊かにして、平和と繁栄を創る決意だ」と述べる予定だ。

「旧敵国条項」を巡っては、高市氏が昨年１１月、台湾有事について国会で「存立危機事態になり得る」と答弁した後、中国がソーシャルメディア上で同条項は依然有効だと主張。今月にも同様の見解を示している。

渡米前の２１日夜、高市氏は首相公邸で記者団に「きょうもぎりぎりまでペン入れをしていた」と明かした上で、北朝鮮による拉致の問題や気候変動対策の重要性、法の支配の重視などを訴えたいと語っていた。

（鬼原民幸　編集：久保信博）

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

まちまちで取引を終えた。銀行や通信株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は反落した。米イラン協議を巡る状況を見極めたいとして、投資家の間に様子見姿勢が目立った。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．１４％高と続伸した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は１．６３％安。金融大手ＨＳＢＣは１．６％、スタンダード・チャータードは２．３％それぞれ下落。

通信株指数は２．４５％安。通信大手ＢＴは３．８％、ボーダフォンは２．２％、エアテル・アフリカは１．９％いずれも下落した。

日用品のユニリーバ１．２％、酒造大手のディアジオは１．５％それぞれ上昇。利益見通しを引き上げたホームセンター大手キングフィッシャーは１２．４％高だった。

複合企業スミス・グループは７．５％上昇。堅調な業績が確認されたことや、米国におけるアスベスト関連負債の売却手続き開始を発表したことを受け、買われた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

まちまちで取引を終えた。銀行や通信株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は反落した。米イラン協議を巡る状況を見極めたいとして、投資家の間に様子見姿勢が目立った。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．１４％高と続伸した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は１．６３％安。金融大手ＨＳＢＣは１．６％、スタンダード・チャータードは２．３％それぞれ下落。

通信株指数は２．４５％安。通信大手ＢＴは３．８％、ボーダフォンは２．２％、エアテル・アフリカは１．９％いずれも下落した。

日用品のユニリーバ１．２％、酒造大手のディアジオは１．５％それぞれ上昇。利益見通しを引き上げたホームセンター大手キングフィッシャーは１２．４％高だった。

複合企業スミス・グループは７．５％上昇。堅調な業績が確認されたことや、米国におけるアスベスト関連負債の売却手続き開始を発表したことを受け、買われた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

小幅に続伸して取引を終えた。米イラン情勢を巡る外交的な打開への期待感から、買い注文が優勢だった。

トランプ米大統領は国連総会での演説で、イランを経済的に孤立させる姿勢を示す一方、１１月の米中間選挙後にイランと合意に至る可能性があるとの見通しを明らかにした。イランは米国が港湾封鎖を解除するなどすれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できるとの案を示したと伝わった。

原油先物価格は下落した一方、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種石油・ガス株指数は０．２０％上昇した。

小売株指数は３．１１％上昇。利益見通しを引き上げたホームセンター大手キングフィッシャーは１２．４％高だった。テクノロジー株指数は１．５２％値上がりした。

一方、銀行株指数は０．９８％、通信株指数は２．０５％それぞれ下落。モルガン・スタンレーが投資判断を引き下げたスウェーデン通信機器大手エリクソンは３．８％値下がりした。

週内に、米中首脳会談が開かれる予定で、貿易休戦が延長されるとの見方が強まっている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

域内国債利回りが２日連続で低下した。イランがホルムズ海峡再開の可能性を示唆し、米政府がイランとの協議再開の可能性を示したことを受け、原油価格が下落した。

イラン政府高官は２２日、米国が軍事的圧力を緩和し、イランの港湾封鎖を解除すれば、７日以内にホルムズ海峡を再開できるとロイターに述べた。

ルビオ米国務長官はＮＢＣの番組「トゥデー」のインタビューで、ニューヨークでの国連総会に合わせてイラン側と協議することに前向きな姿勢を示した。

これを受け、北海ブレント先物は１％安の１バレル＝１００ドル。取引序盤で一時、２週間ぶり安値となる９７．４０ドルまで下落した。

ラボバンクのシニア金利ストラテジスト、リン・グラハム・テイラー氏は、イラン当局者の発言を受けた原油価格の低下が債券利回りを圧迫していると述べた。

エネルギー価格の下落は、インフレ抑制に向けた追加利上げ観測を背景にここ数週間で急上昇した利回りを世界的に押し下げる要因となっている。市場は、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が年内に計約３５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の追加利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでおり、１８日の４０ｂｐから低下した。 

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ低下の３．４４％。取引序盤で４ｂｐ上昇する場面もあった。

ドイツ２年債利回りは１ｂｐ低下の３．１９％。前日は６ｂｐ低下していた。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は３ｂｐ拡大。一時１０５．６ｂｐと、２０１２年以来の高水準まで拡大した。

items.title: Trump Rejects Push for International Pact to Manage AI Risks
items.summary: Representative Lori Trahan, a Democrat from Florida, said that President Trump is 'not in lockstep' with the American people when it comes to AI guardrails and that the president's claim that AI risks are a 'globalist scheme' is out of touch with what the public is feeling. Trahan, who co-authored a bipartisan bill on AI guardrails, said that she feels action shouldn't wait until the next congress and that congress is 'gambling' with the next AI security incident by sending members home ahead of the midterms. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.body:
[ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター] - バーナム英首相は２２日、国連総会が行われているニューヨークでトランプ米大統領と初めて会談し、一部の外交政策を巡る立場の違いはあるものの、良好な関係を構築できたと述べた。

両首脳は会談でウクライナ情勢のほか、南大西洋にあるフォークランド諸島の地位や通商問題などについて協議した。

トランプ氏は会談後、バーナム首相について「生まれながらのビジネスマンだ」と指摘。バーナム氏は「米国との関係は英国にとって極めて重要で、今後さらに発展させていく」と語った。

トランプ氏は会談後、インド洋のディエゴガルシア島にある米英共同軍事基地の地位を巡る英国の計画を改めて非難。バーナム氏はこの問題の解決を模索する考えを示している。

items.title: Reajuste do Bolsa Família tende a impulsionar atividade econômica, diz Ministério da Fazenda
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A secretária de Política Econômica do Ministério da Fazenda, Débora Freire, disse nesta terça-feira que o reajuste anunciado pelo governo no valor dos benefícios do programa Bolsa Família tende a dar impulso positivo à atividade econômica.
items.body:
A secretária de Política Econômica do Ministério da Fazenda, Débora Freire, disse nesta terça-feira que o reajuste anunciado pelo governo no valor dos benefícios do programa Bolsa Família tende a dar impulso positivo à atividade econômica.
Em entrevista à imprensa, Freire afirmou que nos últimos meses deste ano poderá haver algum efeito de mitigação da desaceleração econômica, enquanto em 2027 o impacto deve ser mais relevante.
“Isso tende a contribuir positivamente para a atividade, mas é um vetor bem-vindo de contribuição dado esse cenário de desaceleração, e não conflita com a política monetária porque estamos em cenário de desaceleração e de flexibilização (dos juros)”, disse.
Segundo ela, as projeções para o desempenho do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) em 2026 e 2027 [USN:L1N45E0QE TEXT:"divulgadas"] nesta terça-feira ainda não incorporam esses efeitos.

items.title: Gen Z: Quiet Quitting Comes to India. AI Will Make It Worse
items.author: Andy Mukherjee
items.creator: Andy Mukherjee
items.summary: Doomsday predictions of artificial intelligence causing massive white-collar job losses haven’t come to pass. At least not yet. There is, however, evidence that AI tools, while helping experts become more productive, are hollowing out the skills that young people acquire early in their careers. This divergence may be showing up as a big jump in “quiet quitting” — a lack of meaningful workplace connection — even in an economy like India’s, where youth are starved of decent employment.
