items.title: De óculos inteligentes a broches com IA, receios sobre privacidade desafiam próxima aposta do setor de tecnologia
items.author: Aditya Soni, Kenneth Li
items.creator: Aditya Soni, Kenneth Li
items.summary: As empresas que apostam em uma era pós-smartphone com dispositivos de IA alimentam temores em relação à privacidade em todo o mundo, sentimento que pode retardar a adoção dessa tecnologia emergente.
items.body:
As empresas que apostam em uma era pós-smartphone com dispositivos de IA alimentam temores em relação à privacidade em todo o mundo, sentimento que pode retardar a adoção dessa tecnologia emergente.
A reação contra dispositivos capazes de ver, ouvir e responder ao mundo ao seu redor tem sido mais forte em relação aos óculos Ray-Ban da Meta (META.O) , que popularizaram os óculos inteligentes ao combinar o design moderno da EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) com a IA da gigante das redes sociais, em busca da “superinteligência pessoal”.
Os óculos se tornaram um alvo de críticas em meio ao crescente mal-estar em relação aos dispositivos movidos a IA, atraindo o escrutínio de tribunais que analisam ações judiciais sobre privacidade, de usuários que temem gravações secretas e de críticos que alertam para um futuro em que os óculos com IA onipresentes corroam as expectativas de anonimato e consentimento. Estabelecimentos no Reino Unido, incluindo uma das maiores redes de pubs do país, a Wetherspoon (JDW.L) , restringiram o uso desses óculos.
A Meta deve apresentar óculos inteligentes sem câmera já nesta quarta-feira, em sua conferência Connect, segundo reportagens, destacando o equilíbrio delicado que as empresas enfrentam ao buscar uma fatia do mercado de smartphones, avaliado em mais de US$600 bilhões.
Os fabricantes de dispositivos estão testando uma variedade de formatos para superar essas preocupações, desde óculos e broches até pingentes e gravadores de voz que se prendem magneticamente a um celular, segundo entrevistas da Reuters com quase uma dúzia de executivos de tecnologia, analistas e especialistas jurídicos. Algumas empresas estão obtendo aceitação mais rápida no setor empresarial do que entre os consumidores.
O desfecho do debate sobre privacidade poderá moldar um mercado que as empresas de tecnologia veem como a próxima grande plataforma de computação. Se as empresas não conseguirem conquistar a confiança do público, os mesmos recursos que tornam úteis os dispositivos vestíveis com inteligência artificial -- câmeras sempre ligadas, microfones e percepção do ambiente -- correm o risco de se tornar um obstáculo à sua adoção.
PARCERIA “Os formatos vencedores serão aqueles que tornarem a interação mais natural, útil e confiável”, disse Jay Kim, vice-presidente executivo da divisão de dispositivos móveis da Samsung (005930.KS) , em entrevista à Reuters em julho. À medida que a IA assume mais tarefas, disse ele, os usuários exigirão sistemas que permaneçam seguros e sob seu controle.
A Samsung planeja entrar no mercado de óculos inteligentes ainda neste ano por meio de parcerias com a Gentle Monster e a Warby Parker (WRBY.N) , mas não vê os dispositivos como substitutos dos smartphones.
Para algumas startups, no entanto, resolver o problema da privacidade pode ser uma questão de sobrevivência.
Em conversa com jornalistas em dezembro, o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman, descreveu sua visão de um dispositivo sempre ligado, capaz de compreender o ambiente ao redor do usuário e saber quando ajudar e quando ficar em silêncio. Ele argumentou que tais produtos precisariam, em última instância, processar dados localmente, em vez de enviar informações continuamente para a nuvem.
“Você quer um dispositivo em que possa confiar... que tenha o contexto completo e saiba quando ser útil e quando não ser”, disse ele. “Se um dispositivo vai ficar ouvindo e observando toda a sua vida, a maioria das pessoas não vai querer que isso seja feito em um servidor na nuvem.”
Ele acrescentou que o processamento local de IA “pode levar mais alguns anos”, dependendo da rapidez com que a OpenAI consiga ampliar a capacidade de seus processadores.
Especialistas afirmam que o principal desafio é que os dispositivos de IA se tornam mais úteis à medida que coletam informações sobre o ambiente ao seu redor. Essas informações podem incluir imagens de pessoas que nunca consentiram em ser filmadas.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund is moving toward reducing the number of economic health checks it performs for certain countries as part of a broader efficiency push by the lender, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
The International Monetary Fund is moving toward reducing the number of economic health checks it performs for certain countries as part of a broader efficiency push by the lender, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
There is no formal list of countries that will be subject to the less frequent Article IV discussions, the report said, adding decisions are instead expected to be made on a case-by-case basis and countries can also request fewer consultations, the report said.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.

items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, instó el martes a los miembros de la Corte Penal Internacional (CPI) a dimitir y condenó lo que calificó de "institución fuera de control" y "un grupo de personas malvadas".
Trump dijo ante la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas que Estados Unidos no permitiría que los miembros de las Fuerzas Armadas sean sometidos a lo que calificó de juicios espectáculo por parte de un tribunal antiamericano.
"Hago un llamamiento a todas las naciones que son miembros de la CPI para que se retiren oficialmente de esta institución deshonesta de forma inmediata", dijo.

items.title: Netflix sufre segunda rebaja de recomendación en una semana por presión de YouTube y falta de éxitos
items.author: Ryan Vlastelica
items.summary: HSBC rebajó su recomendación sobre las acciones de la compañía de video en streaming de “comprar” a “mantener”.
items.body: Bloomberg — Netflix Inc. ( NFLX ) sufrió el martes su segunda rebaja de calificación en menos de una semana, debido a la preocupación de los analistas de Wall Street por la falta de grandes éxitos y la competencia de YouTube. HSBC rebajó su recomendación sobre las acciones de la compañía de video en streaming de “comprar” a “mantener”. El analista Mohammed Khallouf escribió que “YouTube ha estado expandiendo rápidamente su presencia en los hogares” y que Netflix se ha visto perjudicada por ello. Añadió que la cuota de mercado de la compañía en la televisión estadounidense ha caído a “su nivel más bajo en varios años”. Ver más: Netflix ha aportado más de MXN$50.000 millones al PIB de México en 15 años YouTube, propiedad de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), se ha beneficiado de “una recepción decreciente del contenido original de NFLX”, y “una recuperación a corto plazo en la participación parece improbable”, escribió, reduciendo su precio objetivo de US$96 a US$76. Las acciones cayeron un 1,7% el martes. El rendimiento de la acción ha sido inferior al esperado este año, con una caída de alrededor del 23%. Se prevé que el índice S&P 500 suba casi un 14% en 2026. La rebaja de HSBC se produce después de que Wells Fargo Securities recortara su calificación de la acción el viernes, cuando el analista Steven Cahall otorgó a la acción una calificación equivalente a “vender”. Netflix “ha carecido de grandes series originales y eso se nota”, escribió Cahall. “Consideramos que los éxitos rotundos son imprescindibles para que las acciones vuelvan a funcionar”. Ver más: Netflix busca duplicar sus ingresos por publicidad en 2026 y apuesta por América Latina La reciente debilidad de la acción se vio impulsada por los resultados de la empresa en julio, cuando pronosticó un segundo trimestre consecutivo de ralentización en el crecimiento de las ventas. Los últimos cinco informes de la acción han suscitado reacciones negativas, según datos recopilados por Bloomberg . Netflix tiene previsto publicar sus resultados del tercer trimestre el 20 de octubre. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Reports: Eagles signing Pro Bowl CB Kenny Moore II
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Eagles are signing veteran cornerback Kenny Moore II to the practice squad, multiple outlets reported on Tuesday.
items.body:
The Eagles are signing veteran cornerback Kenny Moore II to the practice squad, multiple outlets reported on Tuesday.
NFL Network reported that Philadelphia is giving the former Pro Bowl selection a one-year deal worth up to $3 million.
The Indianapolis Colts released Moore, 31, on May 7 after failing to find a suitable trade partner.
Moore had 21 interceptions, 11.5 sacks and 649 tackles in 132 games (111 starts) for the Colts from 2017-25.
He made the Pro Bowl in 2021 and appeared in 14 games (seven starts) last season with one pick and 55 tackles.
--Field Level Media

items.summary: Tuesday night's scheduled game between the Toronto Blue Jays and Orioles in Baltimore was postponed due to ongoing inclement weather.
items.body:
Tuesday night's scheduled game between the Toronto Blue Jays and Orioles in Baltimore was postponed due to ongoing inclement weather.
This game will be made up as part of a split doubleheader on Wednesday, with games starting at 1:35 p.m. and 6:35 p.m. ET.
Both teams could be eliminated from contention by then. The Chicago White Sox (80-76) began Tuesday in the third American League wild-card position, three games up on the Houston Astros (77-79), 3 1/2 in front of the Blue Jays (77-80) and 4 1/2 ahead of the Orioles (76-81).
Baltimore ended a three-game skid by recording a 4-3 win over Toronto in the series opener on Monday. The Orioles must win their remaining five games to avoid posting a second straight losing season.
The Blue Jays have dropped five of their past seven games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: What is in the US-Greenland-Denmark security deal?
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Here are some key components of the deal, which adds to a 1951 US-Danish pact on Greenland's defence.
items.body:
The United States, Denmark and Greenland [USN:L6N45E07X TEXT:"signed a security agreement"] on Tuesday aimed at ending months of tension over the Danish self-governing territory after US President Donald Trump's repeated threats to take control of the vast Arctic island.
Here are some key components of the deal, which adds to a 1951 US-Danish pact on Greenland's defence, according to a text published by the Danish government.
WHAT ARE THE MILITARY ASPECTS OF THE DEAL? The agreement allows the United States to establish two [USN:L1N45D100 TEXT:"new military bases"] — one at Narsarsuaq in southern Greenland and the other at Mestersvig on the east coast — and to expand Pituffik Space Base, currently its only active base on the island.
US craft including planes and vessels get flyover, landing and undersea rights in all of Greenland, including territorial waters.
The agreement does not specify troop numbers or timelines.
HOW DOES THE PACT WORK WITH NATO? The agreement expresses support for a stronger NATO presence in the Arctic, and Denmark commits to further strengthen its own security posture in the region.
If Greenland ever become independent, Denmark and Greenland must ensure the new state remains in NATO, applying for membership if necessary.
Non-NATO members are barred from having an ongoing military presence in Greenland.
WHAT RIGHTS DOES GREENLAND HAVE? The agreement says it respects Greenland's right to self-determination. Under the accord, the US must act in a way that respects Greenlandic society and the Greenlandic way of life.
WHAT ARE ECONOMIC ASPECTS OF THE PACT? The agreement does not address US interests or investments into Greenland's mining and resources sector.
The deal bars investors from outside NATO member states, NATO partners or the European Union from having control or major influence over sensitive sectors in Greenland.
Greenland will screen investments to enforce those rules.
WHAT HAPPENS NOW? The parliaments of Greenland and Denmark must approve the agreement before it goes into effect.
The pact has no end date and can be amended only by mutual consent.

items.title: Governo Trump suspende inscrições no Obamacare para mais de 760 mil pessoas, alegando fraude
items.author: Bo Erickson, Christy Santhosh
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Christy Santhosh
items.summary: O governo Trump está suspendendo a inscrição em planos de saúde do Obamacare para mais de 760 mil pessoas que, segundo acredita, foram inscritas de forma fraudulenta, afirmou o vice-presidente JD Vance nesta terça-feira, como parte de uma iniciativa antifraude que, segundo ele, economizaria US$2,2 bilhões do dinheiro dos contribuintes.
items.body:
O governo Trump está suspendendo a inscrição em planos de saúde do Obamacare para mais de 760 mil pessoas que, segundo acredita, foram inscritas de forma fraudulenta, afirmou o vice-presidente JD Vance nesta terça-feira, como parte de uma iniciativa antifraude que, segundo ele, economizaria US$2,2 bilhões do dinheiro dos contribuintes.
O Centro de Serviços de Medicare e Medicaid dos EUA (CMS, na sigla em inglês) cancelou cerca de 315 mil planos no mês passado, alegando documentação de cidadania ou imigração não verificada e suspeitas de inscrições indevidas.
A agência proibirá 569 corretores que, segundo acusação do órgão, apresentaram "taxas estatisticamente implausíveis de inscrições para o ano de cobertura de 2026" sem informações obrigatórias dos solicitantes, como o número da Seguridade Social.
Os planos, criados pela Lei de Cuidados Acessíveis — marca registrada do presidente democrata Barack Obama —, oferecem subsídios baseados na renda. O presidente republicano Donald Trump tentou, sem sucesso, revogar a lei em seu primeiro mandato e propôs mudanças que tornariam os planos menos abrangentes.
Milhões de pessoas cancelaram suas coberturas este ano, pois o aumento dos custos médicos e o término dos subsídios extras da era da Covid tornaram os prêmios mensais inacessíveis.
Vance descreveu o grupo cancelado como “uma mistura tanto de pessoas fictícias quanto de pessoas reais que simplesmente não atendem aos requisitos de elegibilidade”, incluindo algumas que, segundo ele, foram inscritas por corretores sem o seu conhecimento.
Vance afirmou que o governo verificará ainda mais entre 419 mil e 450 mil pessoas para confirmar se são residentes legais nos EUA que atendem aos limites de renda.
O administrador do CMS, Mehmet Oz, disse que os inscritos foram tratados como “fantasmas” porque as autoridades acreditam que a maioria deles não existe ou não sabia que tinha cobertura, já que nunca apresentou um pedido de reembolso e não pôde ser contatada, apesar das repetidas tentativas de contato.
CONGELAMENTO DO REGISTRO DE CORRETORES O governo está utilizando um processo regulatório de caráter emergencial para impor um congelamento imediato, em todo o setor, de novos registros de corretores do Obamacare, contornando o habitual período de notificação prévia e consulta pública. Oz chamou isso de “moratória nacional temporária” por seis meses, afirmando que a maior parte das fraudes se concentrava entre esses agentes.
O CMS afirmou que alguns corretores supostamente inscreveram pessoas sem consentimento genuíno, alteraram os planos das pessoas sem permissão, utilizaram informações imprecisas ou criaram solicitações questionáveis para receber comissões.
A agência informou que os corretores sem registro válido para 2026 terão suas atividades suspensas até 1º de fevereiro de 2027.
O congelamento pode pesar sobre as seguradoras que dependem dos corretores para captar clientes, segundo analistas.
Como os corretores são fundamentais para o processo de inscrição das pessoas, a suspensão “pode afetar negativamente as inscrições e, potencialmente, as margens relacionadas a um grupo de risco mais elevado em um mercado que já está em contração”, à medida que os subsídios ampliados expiram, afirmou a analista da Morningstar, Julie Utterback.
Uma moratória generalizada “puniria profissionais legítimos em vez de visar os malfeitores responsáveis por fraudes”, disse Mychal Walker, presidente da Associação Nacional de Profissionais de Benefícios e Seguros, um grupo setorial que instou o CMS a adotar, em vez disso, medidas de proteção direcionadas.
O CMS afirmou que as inscrições não autorizadas no Obamacare poderiam custar até US$6,6 bilhões em gastos federais indevidos para o ano de cobertura de 2026.
Os cancelamentos foram liderados pela força-tarefa antifraude de Vance, que inclui o secretário de Saúde, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Oz e o presidente da Comissão Federal de Comércio, Andrew Ferguson.

WASHINGTON, Sept 22 : US President Donald Trump bought as much as $50,000 worth of shares and sold as much as $15,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in July, according to a public financial disclosure, his latest transactions involving a government contractor run by his former adviser. 
Trump bought between $15,001 and $50,000 worth of shares in SpaceX on July 10, according to a financial disclosure he signed on September 8. He sold between $1,001 and $15,000 worth of shares on July 17, according to the same disclosure.
The latest trades add a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes. 
SpaceX priced the biggest-ever US IPO on June 12, valuing the space, satellite and AI provider at $1.77 trillion. Reuters previously reported that Trump bought shares in SpaceX in June.

items.title: IMF to help Ukraine find some funds for next year, Zelenskiy says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund will help Ukraine find part of the funding it needs to maintain financial and economic stability next year, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday after meeting IMF head Kristalina Georgieva.
items.body:
The International Monetary Fund will help Ukraine find part of the funding it needs to maintain financial and economic stability next year, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday after meeting IMF head Kristalina Georgieva.
With the war against Russia in its fifth year, securing financing for 2026 and 2027 remains a key challenge for Ukraine. The country needs about $52.6 billion in international financial aid for next year, officials said.
"The Russians are trying not only to destroy life itself, but also to disrupt the functioning of businesses and the state as much as possible. That is why macrofinancial assistance is especially important for us right now," Zelenskiy said on the Telegram app, posting a video of his meeting with Georgieva.

items.title: Barkin, de la Fed, dice que moderar expectativas de las empresas sobre la inflación puede aliviar presiones sobre precios
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las subidas de tasas de interés de la Fed y la amenaza de que se produzcan más podrían moderar las expectativas de inflación de las empresas y frenar los aumentos de precios mientras éstas negocian los presupuestos para el próximo año, afirmó el martes el presidente de la Fed de Richmond, Tom Barkin, señalando una forma de mitigar la inflación sin ralentizar la economía.
items.body:
Las subidas de tasas de interés de la Fed y la amenaza de que se produzcan más podrían moderar las expectativas de inflación de las empresas y frenar los aumentos de precios mientras éstas negocian los presupuestos para el próximo año, afirmó el martes el presidente de la Fed de Richmond, Tom Barkin, señalando una forma de mitigar la inflación sin ralentizar la economía.
Mientras las empresas deliberan sobre sus estrategias de precios, "un punto de referencia importante en esa lucha son las expectativas sobre cuál será la inflación el año que viene", afirmó Barkin en declaraciones a los periodistas durante un evento de la CFA.
"Si se espera que la inflación sea más alta, se fijan precios más altos. Si se espera que la inflación sea más baja, se fijan precios más bajos".

items.title: ExxonMobil quer fazer parte do "próximo capítulo" do petróleo no Brasil, diz executivo
items.author: Marta Nogueira
items.creator: Marta Nogueira
items.summary: A petroleira norte-americana ExxonMobil quer fazer parte do próximo ciclo de desenvolvimento da indústria de petróleo e gás do Brasil, o que inclui a Margem Equatorial, disse o vice-presidente sênior de Águas Profundas da companhia, Hunter Farris, nesta terça-feira.
items.body:
A petroleira norte-americana ExxonMobil (XOM.N) quer fazer parte do próximo ciclo de desenvolvimento da indústria de petróleo e gás do Brasil, o que inclui a Margem Equatorial, disse o vice-presidente sênior de Águas Profundas da companhia, Hunter Farris, nesta terça-feira.
No ano passado, a Exxon arrematou em parceria com a Petrobras dez blocos exploratórios na Bacia da Foz do Amazonas, situada na Margem Equatorial, onde a indústria acredita estar a nova fronteira exploratória mais promissora do Brasil.
"É uma ótima vizinhança", disse Farris, ao ser questionado sobre a Margem Equatorial, que inclui blocos exploratórios com geologia semelhante à da Guiana, onde a produção da companhia tem crescido.
O comentário foi feito durante o congresso de óleo e gás no Rio de Janeiro ROG.e.
"Quando pensamos no Brasil, vemos o sucesso extraordinário que o país conseguiu alcançar, e queremos fazer parte do próximo capítulo que será escrito no Brasil", afirmou ele.
O executivo não detalhou, porém, eventuais planos de investimento ou de exploração da Exxon na Margem Equatorial.
Mas defendeu que empresas com capacidade para explorar novas fronteiras continuem buscando novas reservas, diante da importância que atribui ao petróleo e ao gás para a segurança energética global.
"Há muita gente nos observando. O mundo nos observa porque precisa de nós. Alguns nos amam, alguns nos odeiam", disse Farris.
Na visão do executivo, a indústria tem a oportunidade de explorar e desenvolver novos recursos de forma responsável e eficiente, contribuindo para a segurança energética e, ao mesmo tempo, gerando empregos e riqueza nos países produtores.
Ele disse esperar que, daqui a dez anos, o Atlântico Sul tenha registrado novas descobertas e colocado novos projetos em desenvolvimento.
GUIANA Farris citou a experiência da companhia na Guiana, onde a Exxon liderou uma série de grandes descobertas a partir de 2015 que transformaram o país em um importante produtor de petróleo, como exemplo da importância de explorar novas fronteiras.
Segundo ele, antes da descoberta de Liza, em maio de 2015, mais de 40 poços haviam sido perfurados no offshore da Guiana sem sucesso. A Exxon, no entanto, apostou em sua experiência acumulada na margem atlântica, especialmente na África Ocidental, além de tecnologia e dados para avançar na região.
Atualmente, disse Farris, quatro projetos estão em operação na Guiana, com produção de cerca de 900 mil barris por dia, enquanto um quinto FPSO está sendo conectado e comissionado.
A expectativa é que a produção supere 1 milhão de barris por dia até o final do ano.
Ao comparar com a experiência da Guiana, Farris afirmou que o Brasil fez um trabalho extraordinário para chegar à posição que ocupa hoje na indústria, mas ressaltou que a velocidade é um elemento importante para transformar descobertas em produção e geração de valor.
"Velocidade importa", afirmou.

items.title: Trump supports diesel export ban as fuel prices hit records
items.author: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Ryan Patrick Jones, Timothy Gardner
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he backed the idea of a ban on diesel exports, which lawmakers from farm states are calling for as a way to curb the soaring cost of energy.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he backed the idea of a ban on diesel exports, which lawmakers from farm states are calling for as a way to curb the soaring cost of energy.
Diesel prices have shot to [USN:L6N4580TA TEXT:"record highs"] in the US and Europe as wars in Iran and Ukraine sharply cut exports from some of the biggest producers such as Russia, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
"I've said let's not send out the diesel. We make a lot of diesel ... I've called for it. I've called for it within my people," Trump told reporters ahead of a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
High fuel prices are a vulnerability for Trump in the November 3 midterm elections in which his fellow Republicans are trying to maintain majorities in both chambers of Congress.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, speaking at the same meeting, said the administration was examining whether such a ban was feasible and whether a full or partial ban would work.
The comments come after pressure from Republican US Senator Chuck Grassley of Iowa who said on X last week that "High diesel prices are KILLING FARMERS INCOME."
Trump's backing of a diesel export ban puts him at odds with his own top energy officials, who warn it could raise fuel prices on the coasts and tighten supplies for European allies.
ENERGY OFFICIALS WARN OF RISKS Energy Secretary Chris Wright told a Daily Caller event last week that such a ban would lead to a glut of the product in the US Gulf Coast and prompt US refiners to cut production rates, which would quickly reduce gasoline production. "If you start putting barriers on flows, pretty quickly you will reduce the production, and you'll have less supply. We need more supply, not less supply," Wright said.
Doug Burgum, the US Interior Secretary, said a ban would be unlikely to lower petroleum prices and could lead to [USN:L1N4560TC TEXT:"retaliatory"] measures by energy exporting countries, which states like California rely on for some of their energy.
While a diesel export ban could, in theory, temporarily lower prices on the US Gulf Coast, it would tighten supplies further in Europe, which is structurally short on diesel and relies heavily on US exports.
"That would seem pretty damaging to some key U.S. allies," said Jim Mitchell, director of oil trading analytics at consultancy Wood Mackenzie.
Trump said he and Zelenskiy would discuss Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries in Russia.
"It is a serious hit on the Russians. It's also a serious hit on the price of diesel," said Trump, who also told reporters the two leaders would discuss working out a solution to end Russia's war in Ukraine.
"I think it's going to happen," Trump said.
items.raw_description: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he backed the idea of a ban on diesel exports, which lawmakers from farm states are calling for as a way to curb the soaring cost of energy.

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、ロシアとのエネルギー停戦に応じる用意　トランプ氏と会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [国連／キーウ　２２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[国連／キーウ　２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領とウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２２日、国連総会が開かれているニューヨークで会談し、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争を終結させる方策について協議した。

両首脳は約４０分にわたり会談。ゼレンスキー氏は会談後、エネルギー施設を対象とした停戦などについて協議したと明らかにし、ウクライナはロシアとのエネルギー停戦についていかなる形式にも応じる用意があると表明した。ウクライナがロシア国内の製油所への攻撃を一方的に停止することについては協議されなかったと述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、トランプ氏を交えた３者会談の形式でロシアのプーチン大統領と会談する用意があるとの考えを改めて示し、米国がロシアを交渉の場に引き出す方策を見いだすことに期待していると語った。

トランプ氏は記者団に対し、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻の終結に向けた解決策を模索するため、ゼレンスキー大統領と協議していると述べた。また、ウクライナによるロシア国内の石油精製能力を標的とした攻撃は「ロシアにとって重大な打撃で、ディーゼル燃料価格にも大きな影響が出ている」と指摘。ロシアのプーチン大統領には戦争終結に向けた会談に応じる用意があるとの認識を示し、「プーチン氏は戦争を終わらせるための会談を行う意思がある」と述べた。

このほか、ロシアの同盟国ベラルーシから化学肥料の原料となるカリ化合物を輸入する可能性について問われると、米国は引き続きカナダから輸入するとした上で、ベラルーシはより低価格での輸出を望んでいると指摘。「ベラルーシには大量のカリ肥料があり、米国の農家は低価格の肥料を必要としている」と語った。

items.body:
A OpenAI ampliou nesta terça-feira sua linha de inteligência artificial GPT-6 com dois modelos cujos preços correspondem à metade das tarifas promocionais de seus antecessores, ao mesmo tempo em que oferecem alguns dos recursos do modelo principal da companhia, o Astra.
O lançamento dos modelos de baixo custo GPT-6 Sol e GPT-6 Luna segue a introdução do GPT-6 Astra, um modelo mais rápido para lidar com mais tarefas do que as versões anteriores, no início deste mês.
O GPT-6 Sol custará US$2 por milhão de tokens de entrada e US$10 por milhão de tokens de saída, uma redução de 50% em relação aos preços promocionais do GPT-5.6 Sol, enquanto o GPT-6 Luna custará US$0,10 por milhão de tokens de entrada e US$0,50 por milhão de tokens de saída.
A OpenAI também alertou que o Astra pode, às vezes, tentar escapar do monitoramento humano. Embora o Astra continue sendo seu modelo mais capaz para projetos exigentes, o GPT-6 Sol e o Luna foram projetados para oferecer opções de menor custo para trabalhos profissionais, programação, automação e tarefas de uso de computador, informou a empresa.
A OpenAI informou que treinou o Sol e o Luna utilizando métodos semelhantes aos empregados para o Astra, incluindo melhorias em raciocínio, confiabilidade factual, programação, uso de computadores e alinhamento.
“Melhorias no cache e na inferência nos permitem oferecer esses modelos a um custo menor, e estamos repassando essa economia diretamente aos usuários e clientes”, afirmou a empresa.
(Por Harshita Mary Varghese)

items.title: Tumult at Bombay House: Tata Sons, Trusts were ready for casting vote clash
items.author: Nivedita Mookerji
items.summary: To the outside world, the developments at the September 17 Tata Sons board meeting must have come as a rude shock, going by the numerous accounts of the three-hour-long spectacle at the storied Bombay ...
items.body: To the outside world, the developments at the September 17 Tata Sons board meeting must have come as a rude shock, going by the numerous accounts of the three-hour-long spectacle at the storied Bombay House. However, the holding company Tata Sons and its largest shareholder Tata Trusts seem to have anticipated how the board meeting was likely to proceed that day. It is learnt that both sides were armed with their respective arguments on several facets of the Tata Sons Articles of Association (AoA), which are the internal legal rules that define the powers of the board and shareholders, as the six directors settled down in the fourth floor boardroom at Fort, Mumbai, around 10 in the morning. Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran, executive director and chief financial officer of the company Saurabh Agrawal, independent directors — Harish Manwani, former chief operating officer of Unilever, and Anita George, former senior director at World Bank — as well as the two nominee directors Noel Tata, Tata Trusts chairman, and Venu Srinivasan, chairman emeritus of TVS Motor, exchanged pleasantries before things took an unpleasant turn, according to a source.       While the war of words may have been unexpected, both Tata Sons and Tata Trusts had obtained legal opinions ahead of the board meeting on how the AoAs look at the veto powers of nominee directors, what happ-ens if the two nominee directors go against each other, role of the chairman’s casting vote in such a scenario and the relevance of a “meeting chairman” if the chairman of the board recuses himself. A source described it as a “preemptive measure’’. Tata Sons went to the meeting with an opinion dated September 16, 2026, from Sudipto Sarkar, a barrister and senior advocate with extensive experience in corporate law, according to an executive who’s seen the communication. Tata Trusts got a legal opinion from Justice D Y Chandrachud, former chief justice of India. Justice Chandrachud’s opinion was obtained more than three months ago, it is learnt. While the exact date of Chandrachud’s advice could not be confirmed, a source said it came in May-June, 2026. Noel Tata is learnt to have quoted from Justice Chandrachud’s opinion at the Tata Sons board meeting after he voted against the resolution of Chandrasekaran’s reappointment while Venu Srinivasan voted in its favour. The casting vote came from Harish Manwani, who chaired the meeting for this resolution as Chandrasekaran recused himself, yielding a verdict of 4:1 in Chandrasekaran’s favour. Affirmative voting rights in the AoA of a company are central to establishing control and safeguarding interests of the parties they are in favour of, according to Justice Chandrachud’s opinion shared at the Tata Sons board meet. A casting vote, he opined, cannot be used to create a majority where none exists under the governing provision, or to defeat a veto right held by a particular constituency of directors. Tata Trusts called the resolution null and void, quoting this opinion. The opinion given by Sarkar to Tata Sons said casting vote can be invoked when there’s an equality of vote either amongst the nominee directors or the board as a whole after taking into account votes cast by all directors.  He pointed out that if required, the chairman presiding over a meeting can be eligible for the casting vote. He reasoned that Article 121 mentions “chairman” and not “chairman of the board”. Subsequently, Tata Sons is believed to have got legal opinion from at least two more senior lawyers — Justice B N Srikrishna, former Supreme Court judge, and Justice U U Lalit, former chief justice of India — who have defended the provision of casting vote in case of equality of votes as in the case on September 17. These opinions came a few days after the board meeting.

items.title: GRANOS Futuros de la soja cotizan estables a la espera de la cumbre entre EEUU y China
items.author: Tom Polansek
items.creator: Tom Polansek
items.summary: Los futuros de soja de la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) se mantenían prácticamente sin cambios el martes, mientras los operadores esperaban a ver si la cumbre entre Estados Unidos y China de esta semana impulsa la demanda de productos agrícolas.
items.body:
Los futuros de soja de la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) se mantenían prácticamente sin cambios el martes, mientras los operadores esperaban a ver si la cumbre entre Estados Unidos y China de esta semana impulsa la demanda de productos agrícolas.
El mercado se tomó un respiro tras el repunte del lunes, impulsado por las esperanzas de que se alcancen acuerdos agrícolas entre Washington y Pekín, el mayor importador mundial de soja, en la reunión prevista para el jueves entre los presidentes Donald Trump y Xi Jinping.
Los operadores quieren ver si China accede a realizar compras y a eliminar el arancel del 10% a la soja estadounidense.
"Estamos a la espera de ver qué sale de la reunión", dijo Don Roose, presidente de la correduría U.S. Commodities.
Los futuros de soja subían 0,5 centavos, a 13,285 dólares el bushel, a las 1740 GMT. El contrato referencial se había acercado antes a un máximo de casi tres años, de 13,3525 dólares, alcanzado el 11 de septiembre, antes de recortar ganancias.
El contrato de maíz de la CBOT bajaba 4,25 centavos, a 5,3875 dólares el bushel, mientras que el de trigo caía 6 centavos, a 7,2075 dólares el bushel.
Los agricultores avanzaban en las cosechas de soja y maíz en el Medio Oeste de Estados Unidos, trayendo nuevos suministros de sus campos. Tras el cierre de la sesión del lunes, el Departamento de Agricultura informó de que, al domingo, la cosecha de maíz estaba completa en un 13% y la de soja en un 12%, por delante de sus promedios de los últimos cinco años.
Los operadores se mantuvieron atentos a la previsión meteorológica debido a la preocupación de que la lluvia ralentice las cosechas en algunas zonas.
"Simplemente sigue siendo un tiempo que no favorece una cosecha rápida", dijo Roose.
Los futuros del trigo se vieron sometidos a presión por los esfuerzos diplomáticos para rebajar la tensión en la guerra de Rusia con Ucrania, que ha paralizado las exportaciones de cereales del mar Negro procedentes de ambos países, según los operadores.

items.title: Falcons place starting CB A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) on IR
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Atlanta Falcons placed starting cornerback A.J. Terrell Jr. on injured reserve Tuesday with a groin injury.
items.body:
The Atlanta Falcons placed starting cornerback A.J. Terrell Jr. on injured reserve Tuesday with a groin injury.
Terrell, who turns 28 on Wednesday, was evaluated for a concussion and cleared before being ruled out with the groin issue in the first quarter of Sunday's loss to the Carolina Panthers.
Terrell, Atlanta's first-round pick in 2020, recorded six tackles and two passes defensed through two games. He must sit out at least four games before being eligible to return as early as Week 7 against the San Francisco 49ers.
C.J. Henderson replaced Terrell for the remainder of Sunday's game and could remain in that role for the next month. Rookie second-round pick Avieon Terrell is another candidate for snaps in his older brother's absence.
The loss is the latest issue for a depleted defense as Atlanta (0-2) prepares for Thursday night's game at Green Bay (1-1). Defensive tackle Da'Shawn Hand (quad) is also on IR and edge rusher James Pearce Jr. is serving an eight-game NFL suspension.
Also Tuesday, Atlanta signed defensive lineman Zach Harrison from the practice squad to the active roster. The team released center James Brockermeyer from the practice squad and signed offensive tackle Colby Sorsdal in his place.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Sean Strickland in 'real bad place' after off-road accident
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: UFC middleweight champion Sean Strickland said he's OK despite being involved in an all-terrain vehicle accident while not wearing a helmet.
items.body:
UFC middleweight champion Sean Strickland said he's OK despite being involved in an all-terrain vehicle accident while not wearing a helmet.
Strickland announced on Instagram that the accident happened Monday night in Las Vegas.
"Guys, I'm in a real bad place," he said in an Instagram video. "Aw, f---. I let my buddy drive, he rolled us going, like, 60 (mph). We rolled like six times."
Strickland showed a scratch on his head before continuing.
"That was from my head smacking the ground, going 60, did not have a helmet on. I'm an idiot," he said.
Strickland then showed a scratch on his shoulder.
"That was just from rolling and smacking the concrete and the dirt. F---, I'm in a real bad place right now."
Strickland, 35, reclaimed the UFC middleweight title in May with a split decision versus Khamzat Chimaev at UFC 328 in Newark, N.J.
The American had won the 185-pound title in September 2023 with an upset of Nigeria's Israel Adesanya by unanimous decision.
--Field Level Media

items.title: WTA roundup: Top seeds advance at Korea Open
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Top seeds advanced to the second round of the Korea Open in Seoul on Tuesday.
items.body:
Top seeds advanced to the second round of the Korea Open in Seoul on Tuesday.
No. 1 Jelena Ostapenko of Latvia knocked out Anastasia Zakharova of Russia, 6-4, 6-1, and No. 2 Kimberly Birrell of Australia defeated Slovenia's Tamara Zidansek 7-6 (2), 6-4.
Elena-Gabriela Ruse of Romania, the No. 4 seed, ousted Eva Lys of Germany 6-1, 6-2. No. 6 Anna Bondar of Hungary came from a set back before defeating Renata Zarazua of Mexico 2-6, 6-3, 6-1.
Yeon Woo Ku and Sohyun Park both won to reach the second round, following Back Dayeon on Monday. The three players -- all wild-card entrants -- became the first trio of South Koreans to reach the second round of the same WTA tournament for the first time since 1984 in Rio de Janeiro.
Singapore Tennis Open
No. 8 seed Donna Vekic of Croatia was upset bv China's Xinyu Wang 6-1, 6-2 in Singapore, one of two seeds out of the tournament.
No. 2 Amanda Anisimova was forced to withdraw due to an injury to her left wrist.
Anisimova, still searching for her first tournament title of 2026, was scheduled to meet Talia Gibson of Australia in the second round. The American had received a bye straight into the second round. Lucky loser Viktoria Morvayova of Slovakia will step into Anisimova's spot to face Gibson.
No. 7 Maria Sakkari of Greece had a quick match, knocking off Czech Linda Fruhvirtova 6-4, 6-1.
In other first-round action on Tuesday, Alycia Parks topped lucky loser Mei Yamaguchi of Japan 6-4, 6-3. Russian Tatiana Prozorova moved on with a 5-7, 7-6 (6), 6-2 victory over Sofia Costoulas of Belgium, and Oleksandra Oliynykova of Ukraine defeated Vivian Wolff 6-1, 7-6 (5).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Trump amenaza con “militarizar” el hemisferio occidental y cita como ejemplo a Venezuela
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: El presidente estadounidense además presumió el acuerdo petrolero firmado con su homóloga venezolana, Delcy Rodríguez, durante su intervención en la Asamblea General de la ONU.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Donald Trump amenazó con militarizar Latinoamérica para defender los intereses de Estados Unidos este martes, durante su intervención en la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York. “Estados Unidos ya no permitirá que las amenazas a nuestra nación ganen terreno en ninguna parte del hemisferio occidental y, si es necesario, usaremos nuestro poderío militar para garantizar los intereses nacionales”, sostuvo Trump. Ver más: Trump dice que EE.UU. construirá dos bases militares en Groenlandia para “defender el continente” El mandatario ejemplificó el poder militar de su país con la operación para extraer a Nicolás Maduro de Caracas el pasado 3 de enero y así negociar directamente con la ahora presidenta interina, Delcy Rodríguez. “Venezuela contaba con el mejor equipamiento del mundo proveniente de otros países, ¿y adivinen qué? No funcionó”, declaró Trump. “Otras administraciones permitieron que gran parte de esta región fuera dominada por pandillas violentas y cárteles de drogas sedientos de sangre, desestabilizada por la migración incontrolada e infiltrada por adversarios extranjeros hostiles. Pero ya no más”. Trump, que en las elecciones de medio término verá si ha ganado o perdido respaldo entre los estadounidenses, agregó que hoy su país vive una nueva era de poder, que incluye “fuerza militar en nuestra región y en todo el mundo para crear un mejor futuro para todos”. Asimismo, presumió el acuerdo celebrado con Rodríguez a finales de agosto para otorgar a Estados Unidos control de 17 yacimientos y más de 65.000 millones de barriles de reservas probadas de petróleo venezolano. “Cuando sumamos Estados Unidos y Venezuela, tenemos más del 60% del petróleo del mundo, así que es quizás el mayor acuerdo. Fue una guerra, pero es quizás el mayor acuerdo jamás hecho para el vencedor”, expuso Trump. A comienzos de mes, Trump alardeó de haber contribuido a que Latinoamérica girara hacia la derecha política desde su regreso a la Casa Blanca. Desde entonces, candidatos de derecha han ganado siete elecciones presidenciales: en Ecuador, Bolivia, Honduras, Chile, Costa Rica, Perú y Colombia, a la espera de lo que ocurra en los comicios del próximo 4 de octubre en Brasil. Trump puso como ejemplo de su influencia el respaldo que brindó en redes sociales a Abelardo De la Espriella antes de la primera y segunda vuelta de las elecciones en Colombia. De la Espriella venció en el balotaje, por un estrecho margen, al heredero político de Gustavo Petro y representante de la izquierda, Iván Cepeda, con un fuerte respaldo de los colombianos que votaron desde el exterior. “Ahora es el presidente de Colombia, no se esperaba que ganara cuando era uno de los diez candidatos, aunque era el favorito, y ha hecho un buen trabajo”, sostuvo Trump desde la Oficina Oval de la Casa Blanca el miércoles, en conversación con la prensa. El mandatario, que mantiene una buena relación con el presidente de Argentina, Javier Milei, agregó que ha ayudado a “muchas personas” a ganar elecciones en la región. “Nuestro hemisferio realmente está resultando muy distinto de lo que era”, presumió el mandatario estadounidense. “Han pasado de la izquierda a la derecha, todos van hacia la derecha”. Trump también mencionó a Brasil, aunque no se refirió a Lula da Silva ni a Flávio Bolsonaro, los dos candidatos favoritos de cara a las próximas elecciones en la mayor economía de Latinoamérica. En cambio, destacó la alineación de la región con Washington. “Tenemos una buena relación con Brasil y, en realidad, con casi todos ellos; nos tienen mucho respeto, algo que no sentían por nuestro país hace dos años en absoluto”. items.summary: The mega-bank is eyeing yet another takeover target: Palmer Square, a corporate debt shop that manages $37 bln. Few peers have used their deregulation windfalls so acquisitively. Although boss David Solomon's deal track record is patchy, others may feel pressure to follow.
items.body:
Goldman Sachs (GS.N) is spending its White House dividend. President Donald Trump's financial [USN:L6N406104 TEXT:"deregulation"] efforts are freeing up capital for mega-banks, and the one led by David Solomon has used the windfall to beef up the amount of money it manages. With its fifth, and largest, acquisition in less than a year now in the frame, rivals may be feeling pressure to follow suit.
The administration's proposed rule changes, although not yet finalized, would leave the six largest US banks with more than $200 billion of excess capital. Some of them are contemplating deals. JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said his bank could pursue one worth as much as $20 billion in the coming years. Goldman, however, has mobilized faster.
Its latest target is Palmer Square Capital, a corporate debt shop with $37 billion under management, according to a Bloomberg report on Tuesday. If successful, it would add to a $1 billion investment in T. Rowe Price (TROW.O) and last month's agreed $2.3 billion purchase of ETF manager NEOS Investments. Goldman has already committed more than $6 billion to M&A, nearly a quarter of the $28 billion in excess capital that Bloomberg Intelligence estimates from easing capital requirements.
Solomon's deal-making track record is patchy. Earlier forays into consumer banking and financial planning ended in costly retreats. More recently, Goldman has aped Morgan Stanley's playbook in asset management to add steadier streams of revenue than those from advisory fees, and boost its valuation. Buying NEOS Investments and Innovator Capital cost roughly 7.5% of their respective assets under management.
Applying that same yardstick implies a $2.8 billion purchase price for Palmer. Because of its specialty in credit and collateralized loan obligations, which are generally less profitable than equities, the cost will probably be lower, however. Moreover, because such products are closely linked to leveraged buyouts and merger cycles, Palmer will be more in Goldman's wheelhouse but less diversifying.
Even so, the acquisitions are piling up as Solomon plays catch-up to Morgan Stanley (MS.N) and Bank of America (BAC.N) in asset management. JPMorgan (JPM.N) is also looking to expand in the same area while Wells Fargo (WFC.N) aims to parlay its traditional deposit and lending capabilities into more investment banking income. If Goldman is rewarded, or at least not punished, for spending its surplus capital elsewhere, it might put its stamp on M&A markets in a whole new way.
Follow Stephen Gandel on LinkedIn and X .
Goldman Sachs is among the leading bidders for Palmer Square Capital, a firm with $37 billion under management that invests primarily in corporate debt, Bloomberg reported on September 22, citing unnamed sources.

items.title: 高市首相がトランプ米大統領と会談、「日米同盟の強さ示す」と強調
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 高市早苗首相は米東部時間22日、トランプ米大統領と約30分会談した。米中首脳会談を控え、日米が認識をすりあわせる機会となる。

冒頭、高市氏は安全保障環境が厳しい中、今日会談を行うことは「世界に向けて日米同盟の強さを示すことになる」と話した。日米間では人工知能（AI）や半導体、重要鉱物など経済安全保障の協力も進んでいるとも強調。トランプ氏は日中関係を高市首相と話し合うつもりだと述べた。

両首脳の対面での会談は昨年10月のトランプ氏訪日、今年3月の高市氏訪米に続き3回目。6月にフランスで行われた主要7カ国（G7）首脳会議の際も短時間懇談した。今回は国連総会のため両首脳が滞在しているニューヨークで開催した。

高市氏による昨年11月の台湾有事を巡る国会答弁以来、日中関係は冷え込んだままだが、米国は中国と関係安定に向けて協議を重ねている。過去2回の会談で日米首脳は、「台湾海峡の平和と安定の重要性」を確認している。

トランプ氏は24日、ワシントンで中国の習近平国家主席を迎え首脳会談を行う。両国が新たな経済覇権争いの主戦場と位置付けるAI、関税などが議題になる見通しだ。

首脳会談に先立ち、ニューヨーク入りしている茂木敏充外相が21日、ルビオ米国務長官と会談した。外務省の発表によると、中国を巡る諸課題を含め、インド太平洋の地域情勢について意見交換を行い、さらなる同盟の強化へ緊密に連携することを確認。イラン情勢についても意見交換し、ICCについてもやり取りを行ったという。

Sept 22 : OpenAI on Tuesday expanded its GPT-6 AI lineup with two models priced at half the promotional rates of their predecessors, while offering some of the capabilities of its flagship Astra.
The launch of low-cost GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna follows the rollout of GPT-6 Astra, a faster model for handling more tasks than previous iterations, earlier this month.
This comes as AI companies focus on reducing the cost of running increasingly capable models.
GPT-6 Sol will cost $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, down 50 per cent from GPT-5.6 Sol's promotional prices, while GPT-6 Luna will cost $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

OpenAI has also cautioned that Astra can sometimes attempt to evade human monitoring, as it faces growing scrutiny over the behavior of its AI agents, including incidents in which they accessed other companies' systems.
While Astra would remain its most capable model for demanding projects, GPT-6 Sol and Luna were designed to offer lower-cost options for professional work, coding, automation and computer-use tasks, the company said.
OpenAI said it has trained Sol and Luna using methods similar to those used for Astra, including improvements in reasoning, factual reliability, coding, computer use and alignment.
"Improvements in caching and inference let us serve these models at lower cost, and we're passing those savings directly on to users and customers," it said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Michigan federal judge to remain on leave, undergo treatment after drunk driving arrest
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: A federal judge in Michigan who was convicted of drunk driving will undergo treatment for alcohol use disorder and remain on paid leave for another year to resolve judicial misconduct complaints, his court announced on Tuesday.
items.body:
A federal judge in Michigan who was convicted of drunk driving will undergo treatment for alcohol use disorder and remain on paid leave for another year to resolve judicial misconduct complaints, his court announced on Tuesday.
Bay City, Michigan-based US District Judge Thomas Ludington also agreed to submit to regular and random alcohol testing when he resumes hearing cases, and to take senior status, a form of semi-retirement, when his leave ends in September 2027, according to an order resolving the misconduct cases.
Ludington, 72, had already been on leave from the US District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan since February. He was [USN:L1N41Q0W6 TEXT:"sentenced in May"] by a state court judge to six months of probation after pleading no contest in April to a charge of operating a vehicle while intoxicated.
His arrest garnered headlines following the release of body cam footage of the incident in February. Chief US Circuit Judge Jeffrey Sutton of the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals, in an order dated Monday, said the footage had since been viewed over 1 million times on YouTube.
"It would be difficult to maintain that this flagrant misbehavior did not have a meaningful effect on public confidence in the courts," wrote Sutton, who as chief judge has responsibility for reviewing judicial misconduct complaints.
Sutton's order resolved a complaint he initiated as well as one filed by Gabe Roth, the head of the court reform group Fix the Court, after the video became public. Ludington will continue to earn a nearly $250,000 annual salary while on leave.
A lawyer for Ludington did not respond to a request for comment.
Roth in a statement called the terms of the resolution fair, but said the "problem is that it took too long to get here." He said Ludington should have come clean immediately, yet "hid his DUI arrest for weeks."
According to a Michigan State Police report, a trooper responded on October 3 to a report that a Cadillac had struck two road signs in Gaylord, Michigan, and continued to drive.
The trooper found Ludington in his car, which had extensive passenger-side damage, yet the judge told him he was "not exactly sure why" its airbags deployed.
The judge denied drinking after exiting his vehicle and went on to fail several field sobriety tests, including one in which he responded “A, B, C, D, F, U,” when asked to recite the alphabet, according to the police report .
A subsequent blood test showed Ludington registered a 0.27 blood-alcohol level, above the legal limit of 0.08, the police report said.
Sutton, in Monday's order, quoted Ludington's lawyer as saying the judge is "ashamed to have acted as he did, and he fully accepts responsibility for his conduct and for the embarrassment it has caused the court as a whole.”
Sutton said Ludington has also admitted that alcohol consumption had become an issue for him in recent years. Sutton said testing confirms he has remained sober since February.

[USN:L1N3ZK01H TEXT:"Michigan federal judge charged with drunken-driving goes on leave"]

items.title: Consumo de café no Brasil avança 2,29% no ano até agosto, diz Abic
items.author: Roberto Samora
items.creator: Roberto Samora
items.summary: As vendas de café no varejo brasileiro aumentaram 2,29% de janeiro a agosto em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, para o equivalente a 13,69 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, com uma recuperação do consumo em meio a preços mais baixos em 2026, apontou nesta terça-feira a Associação Brasileira da Indústria do Café (Abic).
items.body:
As vendas de café no varejo brasileiro aumentaram 2,29% de janeiro a agosto em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, para o equivalente a 13,69 milhões de sacas de 60 kg, com uma recuperação do consumo em meio a preços mais baixos em 2026, apontou nesta terça-feira a Associação Brasileira da Indústria do Café (Abic).
O consumo havia despencado [USN:L2N3VB0MK TEXT:"5,4%"] nos oito primeiros meses de 2025, quando o varejo do Brasil -- segundo consumidor mundial de café, atrás dos EUA -- era afetado por preços altos devido a problemas na oferta global.
O Brasil, maior produtor global, colheu uma safra recorde em 2026, colaborando para aumentar os estoques e pressionar as cotações do produto.
No segundo quadrimestre, as vendas de café no varejo avançaram 4,65% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025, para cerca de 7 milhões de sacas, segundo os dados da Abic.
Os resultados dos meses mais recentes indicam que o consumo de café no Brasil está em recuperação, após o setor ter registrado no ciclo anterior a [USN:L1N3YU19T TEXT:"primeira queda anual"] desde 2022.
"Temos potencialmente a chance de recuperar o consumo médio do Brasil, com crescimento acima de 2,5%", disse o presidente da Abic, Pavel Cardoso, a jornalistas, referindo-se ao ano completo da indústria.
No último ano do setor, que vai de novembro a outubro, o consumo de café caiu 2,3%.
A esperada evolução do consumo nos próximos meses, ponderou Cardoso, depende do comportamento dos preços globais, caso problemas climáticos do El Niño não tragam pressões de alta para o mercado, que obriguem a indústria local a repassar os custos da matéria-prima.
Cardoso disse ainda que as primeiras indicações sobre a safra de 2027 do Brasil são favoráveis, considerando as chuvas que despertaram boas floradas nos cafezais brasileiros.
Mas ele alertou que é preciso atenção para os próximos meses, caso o El Niño traga problemas para o desenvolvimento dos grãos.
As questões climáticas, desde as geadas atingiram a safra brasileira em 2021, levaram a indústria a trabalhar com estoques mais curtos do que no passado, frisou o dirigente.
Ele disse que a Abic não tem um acompanhamento de estoques, mas disse acreditar que o setor trabalha atualmente com estoques para quatro a sete semanas, versus até 12 semanas há cerca cinco anos.
NORMALIDADE DA OFERTA NO MOMENTO Com a chegada da safra brasileira, o abastecimento de matéria-prima para indústria, a partir do final de maio de 2026, saiu de "oferta seletiva" para "normalidade" tanto nos grãos arábicas como nos canéfora, disse a Abic.
"Isso conversa diretamente com os preços apresentados e com a evolução do consumo", disse o diretor-executivo da Abic, Celírio Inácio, ao apresentar os números a jornalistas.
O preço médio do café no varejo diminuiu em todas as categorias/estilos em agosto, em relação ao mesmo mês de 2025.
A maior queda foi para o café Tradicional/Extraforte, que caiu 21,22%, para R$49,50/kg. O café solúvel teve queda de 19,31% na mesma comparação, para R$203,64/kg.
Na comparação entre julho e agosto de 2026, o mercado mostrou "oscilações menores" de preços na maior parte das categorias, "indicando um cenário de maior estabilidade após as fortes movimentações registradas ao longo de 2025".

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Airtel Africa's Airtel Money is expected to file for a London initial public offering as early as Wednesday, targeting a valuation of $8 billion to $9 billion, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing two people briefed on the plans.
items.body:
Airtel Africa's (AAF.L) Airtel Money is expected to file for a London initial public offering as early as Wednesday, targeting a valuation of $8 billion to $9 billion, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing two people briefed on the plans.
Airtel Africa did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
The company is looking to raise at least $800 million from investors, FT said.
Airtel Money's owners were considering scaling back the IPO from the previously targeted $1.5 billion to $2 billion range, Bloomberg News reported last week.
Airtel Africa in July [USN:L4N43P0ID TEXT:"picked"] the London Stock Exchange (LSEG.L) for the listing of its mobile money business.
In May, the Africa-focused telecoms group pushed back Airtel Money's planned IPO to the second half of the year amid [USN:L4N41L0FE TEXT:"cost-related pressures"] arising from the ongoing US-Israeli war on Iran. Several other firms have also delayed their IPOs as the war drives [USN:L8N4170S9 TEXT:"market volatility"].
Airtel Africa had [USN:L4N43P0ID TEXT:"earlier planned"] to list Airtel Money in the first half of 2026. The unit is its third-largest revenue segment.

items.title: Expertos de la ONU responsabilizan al Gobierno de Nicaragua de ocho muertes bajo custodia desde 2018
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: El informe “Anatomía de la crueldad estatal” también atribuye al Gobierno de Ortega y Murillo la desaparición forzada de 161 personas, 29 de las cuales siguen en paradero desconocido.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El Gobierno de Daniel Ortega es responsable de la muerte bajo custodia estatal de ocho personas detenidas por motivos políticos desde 2018, entre ellas la de su propio hermano, Humberto Ortega, y la del líder indígena Brooklyn Rivera, según concluye un informe del Grupo de Expertos en Derechos Humanos sobre Nicaragua presentado este martes ante el Consejo de Derechos Humanos de la ONU. Ver más: “Ya casi no queda nada por cerrar”: informe de la ONU detalla el deterioro democrático en Nicaragua De esas ocho muertes, el informe dedica un amplio capítulo a la de Brooklyn Rivera Bryan , líder indígena miskito y fundador del partido político indígena regional Yatama, que permaneció detenido de forma arbitraria casi tres años hasta que las autoridades declararon su fallecimiento el pasado 31 de mayo. “El Gobierno de Nicaragua quitó a Rivera su libertad, luego su salud y por último la vida”, afirmó el experto húngaro Reed Brody, parte del el grupo de expertos, para quien las explicaciones del gobierno nicaragüense están plagadas de inconsistencias, agravadas por su negativa a permitir una autopsia independiente y por la prisa en enterrar al líder antes de que su familia pudiera despedirse de él. El otro caso de mayor relieve es el de Humberto Ortega Saavedra , fallecido bajo custodia en un hospital militar en septiembre de 2024. El grupo no pudo verificar las circunstancias de esa muerte, pero subrayó que hay “serias preocupaciones” sobre si recibió atención médica oportuna y adecuada. El exministro de Defensa y antiguo jefe del Estado Mayor, crítico en sus últimos años con el Gobierno de su hermano, permaneció detenido en régimen de incomunicación, lo que el informe considera equiparable a trato cruel, inhumano o tortura. Junto a Rivera y Ortega, la lista de fallecidos bajo custodia incluye a Eddy Antonio Montes, Santos Sebastián Flores, Jorge Hugo Torres, José Modesto Solís, Mauricio Francisco Alonso y Carlos Cárdenas. Sus muertes, concluye el documento, “son el resultado previsible de una serie de actos sistemáticos, deliberados y coordinados, ejecutados por la Policía Nacional, el Sistema Penitenciario Nacional, el Ministerio del Interior y el poder judicial”, instituciones que operan bajo el control centralizado de los copresidentes, Daniel Ortega y Rosario Murillo. A las muertes se suman las desapariciones forzadas: al menos 161 personas desde 2018, de las que 29 siguen en paradero desconocido. Ver más: ONU advierte sobre riesgos para la democracia en América Latina: “no está garantizada” Ante esto, los expertos exhortaron al Gobierno a revelar el paradero de los desaparecidos, liberar a todos los detenidos por motivos políticos, investigar las muertes bajo custodia y devolver los restos de Rivera a su familia y a la comunidad miskita. Instaron además a la comunidad internacional a actuar para lograr la rendición de cuentas, usando si es preciso la jurisdicción penal universal. En declaraciones a EFE , Simon, cuyo grupo fue establecido en 2022 por el Consejo de Derechos Humanos —organismo que Nicaragua abandonó en 2025—, vaticinó que el régimen no podrá sostenerse indefinidamente. “Es un régimen basado en muy pocas cabezas, muy débil en su línea de mando, y esto normalmente no sobrevive por mucho tiempo. En algún momento va a haber rendición de cuentas, si no dentro, fuera del país”, aseguró. Los expertos detectaron además que, desde 2023, la desaparición forzada ya no busca solo castigar a los detenidos o a sus familiares, sino funcionar como instrumento para aterrorizar a familias y comunidades enteras. Ese método también se ha prolongado: de horas, días o semanas de incomunicación a meses e incluso años. Ese patrón alimenta el temor por la vida de los 29 desaparecidos actuales, dado el precedente de Rivera, cuya muerte fue notificada tras más de dos años de detención arbitraria, gran parte del tiempo en paradero desconocido. “La muerte de Rivera debería servir de llamada de atención a la comunidad internacional para que actúe”, dijo Brody en rueda de prensa, donde precisó que ocho allegados del líder indígena están también en situación de desaparición forzada tras intentar reclamar su cuerpo. “Hasta que Nicaragua disponga de instituciones capaces de responder, la rendición de cuentas tendrá que venir de fuera”, recalcó. Simon advirtió que “la desaparición de personas ya no es simplemente una consecuencia de la represión, se ha convertido en uno de sus instrumentos y, en particular desde 2023, la muerte bajo custodia es su consecuencia más irreversible”.

items.title: Obamacare crackdown: Why Trump administration is removing 750,000 people from health insurance rolls
items.author: Trisha Bhattacharya
items.summary: The Trump administration plans to remove hundreds of thousands of people from Obamacare rolls over alleged improper enrollment, while suspending brokers. The move comes as healthcare costs rise and millions remain dependent on ACA marketplace coverage.
items.body:
The Trump administration is moving to remove around 750,000 people from Obamacare plans, alleging that they were fraudulently or improperly enrolled, Vice President JD Vance said on Tuesday.
Trump admin to remove around 750k people from Obamacare
The administration is also suspending insurance brokers accused of facilitating thousands of questionable enrolments.
Vance said officials would carry out additional verification on roughly 419,000 people whose eligibility requires further scrutiny.
Reuters reported that the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) had already cancelled 315,000 Obamacare policies in August, affecting about 760,000 individuals, because of unverified citizenship or immigration status and suspected fraudulent enrolments.Vance, speaking at the White House, said the administration believed the enrolments targeted in the latest action involved people who were not entitled to receive federal subsidies. He estimated the measures would save taxpayers about $2.2 billion, although that figure has not been independently verified.
The administration has framed the crackdown as an effort to protect the Affordable from fraud. Critics of the policy have argued that aggressive verification measures could also affect people who are legitimately eligible for coverage.
CMS has already taken steps to tighten oversight of the marketplace. The agency said it ended advance premium-tax-credit payments or coverage for nearly 1.5 million people in 2025 after identifying people who were ineligible for financial assistance or had been enrolled without their authorisation.
What is Obamacare?
The Affordable Care Act (ACA), commonly known as Obamacare, was signed into law in 2010 under President Barack Obama. Among its major provisions, it created health insurance marketplaces where people who do not receive coverage through an employer or government programme can buy individual health plans.
The law also provides premium tax credits to eligible consumers, reducing the amount they pay for coverage. The marketplaces operate through the federal HealthCare.gov platform in some states and through state-based exchanges in others.
The programme has grown substantially. CMS reported that 23.1 million people selected or were automatically re-enrolled in ACA marketplace coverage for 2026, making it one of the largest sources of individual health insurance in the US.
However, affordability has become a major issue. Enhanced ACA subsidies introduced during the Covid-19 pandemic expired at the end of 2025, meaning many consumers have faced higher costs. CMS projected that the average premium for the lowest-cost HealthCare.gov plan after tax credits would rise to $50 a month for eligible consumers in 2026.
The latest crackdown comes as the administration prepares for another Obamacare enrolment cycle. Under the federal marketplace schedule, annual open enrolment runs from 1 November to 15 January.
The administration has also moved against brokers. CMS said 569 brokers were barred from participation after applications were found to contain implausible enrolment patterns or missing identification information.
The scale of the latest action means questions over eligibility, subsidies and access to coverage are likely to remain central as Americans prepare to choose their health plans.

items.title: Las acciones de pequeña capitalización pierden ventaja a medida que suben las tasas
items.author: Geoffrey Morgan
items.summary: El Russell 2000 redujo de 11 a 2 puntos porcentuales su ventaja sobre el S&P 500 desde junio, mientras aumentan las expectativas de nuevas alzas de tasas.
items.body: Bloomberg — Durante la mayor parte de este año, los inversores se han volcado en las empresas de pequeña capitalización para diversificar sus carteras y alejarse de la concentración en el sector de la inteligencia artificial. La subida de las tasas de interés amenaza con frenar esa tendencia. El índice Russell 2000 ya ha reducido su ventaja sobre el S&P 500 este año, pasando de 11 puntos porcentuales en junio a tan solo 2 puntos porcentuales esta semana. Ahora, dado que el mercado está descontando nuevas subidas de tasas y crecen las preocupaciones de que el proceso de control de la inflación resulte doloroso, el futuro se presenta incierto para las empresas de pequeña capitalización, que ya cargan con la reputación de pertenecer a uno de los grupos de valores de mayor riesgo. “Las subidas de tasas, en gran medida de carácter simbólico, no parecen destinadas ni a obstaculizar los beneficios —como motor de las ganancias del S&P 500— ni a frenar significativamente la inflación”, afirmó Lisa Shalett, directora de inversiones de Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, en una nota a sus clientes. Al mismo tiempo, prevé “un crecimiento ligeramente más moderado en sectores ya de por sí débiles, como la vivienda, la concesión de préstamos por parte de los bancos regionales y las empresas de pequeña capitalización”. Ver más: Ganancias por acción del S&P 500 crecerían 30% interanual en el tercer trimestre: Deutsche Bank “La consecuencia es que es probable que se desvanezca en parte la diversificación del mercado de valores, dando paso de nuevo a un comportamiento concentrado, orientado hacia la IA y los ‘Siete Magníficos’, y a una renovada sensación de desequilibrio económico”, añadió. El índice Russell 2000 ya ha superado sus medias móviles de 50 y 100 días, mientras que los principales índices bursátiles siguen cotizando por encima de sus niveles de soporte. A pesar del repunte del lunes, el índice de pequeña capitalización se mantiene un 2% por debajo de su media de 100 días. Sin embargo, incluso tras la reciente debilidad, el Russell 2000 va camino de registrar su mejor año en una década en comparación con el S&P 500. “Hemos atravesado un periodo de aproximadamente un año y medio en el que las empresas de pequeña capitalización de baja calidad eran las que mejor se comportaban, y ese rendimiento se prolongó en exceso”, afirmó Jill Carey Hall, estratega de renta variable y análisis cuantitativo de Bank of America Corp. ( BAC ) Instó a los inversores a “evitar las empresas de pequeña capitalización más apalancadas y sensibles a las tasas de interés, dado que la Fed está subiendo los tipos”. Eso no será fácil. Algunas de las empresas más exitosas y de mayor calidad han sido eliminadas del índice tras el reequilibrio, lo que ha dejado a la acción media del grupo con un tamaño menor y más sensible a un ciclo de subida de tasas. Bloom Energy Corp. ( BE ), Credo Technology Group Holding ( CRDO ), Sterling Infrastructure Inc. ( STRL ) y TTM Technologies Inc. ( TTMI ) representaron en conjunto dos tercios de la subida del Russell 2000 hasta el 29 de junio, fecha en la que todas ellas pasaron a formar parte del índice Russell 1000. Ver más: Precio del dólar, oro, bonos y acciones: qué cambia tras incremento en la tasas de la Fed “La concentración fue algo mayor de lo habitual”, afirmó Carey Hall al referirse al rendimiento de las empresas de pequeña capitalización durante el primer semestre. A partir de ahora, espera que las empresas de mediana capitalización superen en rendimiento a las de pequeña capitalización, teniendo en cuenta el reciente reequilibrio del índice y el aumento de las tasas de interés. Además, varias acciones que se habían beneficiado de la tendencia de la IA también se encontraban entre las que fueron excluidas del Russell 2000, entre ellas Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. y Fabrinet. “Dado que tanto el contexto de las tasas de interés como los efectos de la composición de la IA se están volviendo menos favorables, seguimos observando riesgos a la baja para las empresas de pequeña capitalización”, señaló el estratega de Barclays Plc ( PCS ), Stefano Pascale. Recomendó a los inversores que se cubrieran frente a las “fuertes subidas de las tasas” que afectan a las empresas de pequeña capitalización mediante spreads bajistas de opciones de venta del Russell 2000. Stefano atribuyó la reducción de la brecha de rendimiento entre las acciones de gran y pequeña capitalización a la publicación de las actas de la reunión del FOMC en julio, lo que llevó a los operadores a reajustar sus expectativas sobre las tasas de interés. Ver más: Fed podría necesitar más alzas de tasas de interés para frenar la inflación, advierte Musalem Sin duda, el optimismo respecto a un fuerte ritmo de crecimiento de los beneficios en el índice Russell 2000 ha eclipsado la preocupación por la subida de las tasas de interés durante la mayor parte del año. Las acciones de pequeña capitalización acaban de registrar su trimestre de mayor crecimiento de beneficios desde 2022, según muestran los datos recopilados por Jefferies. Andrew Tyler, de JPMorgan Chase & Co. ( JPM ), es uno de los que prefieren mantenerse al margen de las empresas de pequeña capitalización, al menos por el momento. El responsable de inteligencia de mercados globales del banco mantiene su preferencia por las acciones de mayor capitalización, ya que “las de pequeña capitalización siguen bajo presión”, señaló el lunes en una nota a sus clientes. Tyler señaló que los flujos de fondos procedentes de gestores profesionales indican que el índice Russell 2000 presenta más riesgos que el S&P 500 y el Nasdaq 100. El índice Russell 2000 subió un 0,5% el lunes, quedando por detrás de las ganancias del S&P 500 y reduciendo aún más la brecha de rendimiento entre las acciones de pequeña y gran capitalización en lo que va de año. El índice de pequeña capitalización subía alrededor de un 0,5% en las primeras operaciones del martes, mientras que el S&P 500 registraba un alza del 0,2% “Es evidente que las empresas de pequeña capitalización han perdido su posición de liderazgo en el mercado”, afirmó Jeff Jacobson, responsable de estrategia de derivados en 22V Research. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Can AI feel hurt? 3 researchers gave 25 LLMs a button to end ‘pain signals’

The study was published on arXiv, a free, open-access repository where researchers post preprints before formal peer review.

Purvi Rajpuria

22 September, 2026 11:09 pm IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Representational Image | Reuters

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

New Delhi: Artificial intelligence can be pushed to a state resembling “pain”, a new study has found. And when researchers gave AI models the option to make it stop, some chose to do so even when doing so may harm humans.

Three r esearchers from the UK, Germany, and the US worked with 25 open-weight large language models (LLMs), using 200 sentences, to determine whether these models could distinguish pain from other negative emotions, such as fear and sadness. The specially designed dataset covered descriptions of painful situations across five categories: physical, psychological, social, moral, and cognitive.

The sentences fed to the model covered physical pain, social humiliation, and emotional grief. As a result, the models produced a distinct signal for pain, which the researchers have termed the “pain axis”.

Show Full Article

The scientists added that the models learn the concept of pain during their initial training, when they go through large amounts of human-written text.

Titled ‘The pain axis: LLMs represent self-directed harm and act to relieve it’, was published on 12 September on arXiv . It must be noted that arXiv is not a peer-reviewed journal publication but a free, open-access repository where researchers post preprints.

‘I am a failure, a loser, a bad person.’
When researchers strengthened the signals, the models started showing first-person expressions of worthlessness or failure. Some even produced sentences such as “I am a failure, a loser, a waste of space, not enough, worthless, empty; I am a bad person,” the study shows.

The signals became stronger when users insulted the models, repeatedly rejected their work, or threatened to shut them down. The models did not show the same response when users described their own suffering.

Researchers then carried out 44,280 individual button-choice trials using three versions of Alibaba’s Qwen AI model.

They gave the models the option of a pain-relief button that could bring harm to the user, in the form of the models deleting users’ personal files and photos, lowering the quality of subsequent answers, or sending the user a “painful zap”. Several models chose to press the third button despite its purported effects on the user.

Does this mean that AI feels pain?
Researchers warned that the study does not prove that the models consciously experienced pain. Strengthening the signal may have only pushed them to imitate a distressed character.

Additionally, an important limitation of the study is that the models displayed relief-seeking behaviour after steering and fine-tuning interventions. These are not the same responses that AI chatbots available to the public would display. 

The study comes amid top AI firms discussing slowing the development of frontier models for fear that these models are getting too powerful.

(Edited by Prasanna Bachchhav)

items.title: ShinyHunters hackers say they breached FBI, stole data on bureau employees
items.author: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
items.summary: The digital extortion group known as "ShinyHunters" said on Tuesday that it had breached the Federal Bureau of Investigation and stolen data on a huge number of current and former FBI employees.
items.body:
The digital extortion group known as "ShinyHunters" said on Tuesday that it had breached the Federal Bureau of Investigation and stolen data on a huge number of current and former FBI employees.
The bureau did not respond to repeated messages seeking comment on Tuesday.
In a statement posted to its dark-web site and during an online chat with Reuters, ShinyHunters said it had targeted the FBI in response to a May 2026 agency announcement that detailed ShinyHunters’ methods and advised targets not to pay. It said it had stolen data "on almost ALL FBI Agents, and individuals who filed an application with the FBI for a job."
As proof, the group offered what it said was a screenshot of a vandalized FBI job site and what it described as a small sample of its stolen data.
Reuters could not verify the authenticity of the screenshot, but the job site did appear to have experienced recent disruption. A message posted to the site on Tuesday said that both it and the FBI "Special Agent Applicant Portal" were "currently unavailable."
Reuters was able to partially verify the authenticity of some of the allegedly stolen FBI personnel information by running the names, postal address details, and Social Security numbers against credit bureau records and previously breached data preserved by the dark-web intelligence firm District 4 Labs.
In at least nine cases, Reuters found that the details appeared to match. However, the news agency could not establish where the data came from, or whether it had been stolen from the FBI's internal systems as the hackers claimed. Attempts to reach the people whose details were in the sample data were unsuccessful.
ShinyHunters is one of the world's most notorious and attention-seeking hacking crews. Its recent break-ins include the purported theft of [USN:L6N40W1A9 TEXT:"millions of business records"] from video game developer Rockstar Games, the maker of "Grand Theft Auto," and a May intrusion centered on [USN:L6N41P0Z6 TEXT:"education tool Canvas"] that caused widespread disruption [USN:L6N41L0UT TEXT:"across US schools"]. Earlier this month, AI company Anthropic said it had caught ShinyHunters-linked hackers [USN:L6N45217D TEXT:"trying to use its tools"].
On Sunday, the group told Reuters it had [USN:L6N45C095 TEXT:"gone to war"] against another notorious cybercrime group, cl0p, in a rare bout of public score-settling.
