items.title: EEUU, Dinamarca y Groenlandia firman acuerdo para poner fin a disputa por el Ártico
items.author: Gram Slattery, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, y los líderes de Groenlandia y Dinamarca firmaron el martes un acuerdo que permite una mayor presencia militar estadounidense en Groenlandia y que podría resolver la disputa por la isla, de gran importancia estratégica y rica en minerales.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, y los líderes de Groenlandia y Dinamarca firmaron el martes un acuerdo que permite una mayor presencia militar estadounidense en Groenlandia y que podría resolver la disputa por la isla, de gran importancia estratégica y rica en minerales.
El acuerdo, firmado durante la visita de Trump a la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York, no llega a satisfacer la exigencia de Trump de que Estados Unidos incorpore a Groenlandia como territorio estadounidense para contrarrestar la creciente presencia de Rusia y China en el Ártico.
No obstante, el acuerdo sí permite una mayor presencia militar estadounidense en el territorio helado, una opción que surgió cuando los líderes de Groenlandia se opusieron a una toma de control total por parte de Estados Unidos.
El texto del acuerdo, hecho público tras la ceremonia de firma, establece que Estados Unidos puede instalar en Groenlandia un sistema de defensa denominado "Golden Dome" como escudo frente a las amenazas de misiles balísticos. La ruta más corta entre Europa y América del Norte pasa por esta isla ártica, donde se encuentra la base militar estadounidense más septentrional.
En su discurso ante los líderes mundiales reunidos en la ONU antes de la ceremonia de firma, Trump dijo que el acuerdo otorga a Estados Unidos "el control permanente sobre la seguridad y todas las demás necesidades en ese territorio".
"A ningún adversario de Estados Unidos se le permitirá jamás volver a establecer una presencia militar en Groenlandia, ni realizar inversiones sensibles allí sin nuestra aprobación expresa por escrito", agregó Trump.
Trump firmó el acuerdo junto con la primera ministra danesa, Mette Frederiksen, y el primer ministro de Groenlandia, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, en una ceremonia trilateral celebrada tras el discurso de Trump ante la ONU.
Frederiksen describió el acuerdo como un pacto que puede "durar para siempre" y señaló que subraya la importancia de la alianza de la OTAN y respeta el derecho de Groenlandia a la autodeterminación.

Trump willing to meet Iranian delegation in New York "if conditions are right": Report According to CNN, internal discussions surrounding a potential sideline meeting at UNGA have focused on whether a dialogue would meaningfully advance the administration’s efforts to establish a path toward ending the US war with Iran.
ANI | Updated: 22-09-2026 19:40 IST | Created: 22-09-2026 19:40 IST

US President Donald Trump (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US President Donald Trump has expressed interest to his advisers in setting up a meeting with Iranian officials present in New York for the UN General Assembly's 81st session, “if the conditions are right." Citing a US official familiar with the matter, CNN reported that the official noted any potential meeting might instead involve some of the president’s top advisers travelling with him in New York, though no formal encounter has been scheduled yet.
According to CNN, internal discussions surrounding a potential sideline meeting at UNGA have focused on whether a dialogue would meaningfully advance the administration’s efforts to establish a path toward ending the US war with Iran. Furthermore, the official told CNN that there is scepticism over whether the Iranian diplomats in New York possess the backing of Tehran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, who is considered the final authority on such matters.
The official also informed CNN that it remains uncertain whether Iranian officials would even be willing to meet. Iran’s scaled-down delegation currently in the US for the UN General Assembly includes Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and President Masoud Pezeshkian.
Both Secretary of State Marco Rubio and US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz have indicated that the president remains “open” to engaging with the Iranian representatives. Waltz told CNN’s Kaitlan Collins on Wednesday that Trump “is always open” to discussions, adding: “That’s a question I wish you could ask the Iranians is, will they sit down directly with us? And who is speaking for the ayatollah? That’s been a continuous issue.”
Additionally, when questioned regarding whether Trump intended to interface with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in New York, Rubio noted that Washington remains receptive to the concept, though no formal schedule has been established. "We’re open to that. I don’t think anything is scheduled at this point, but we’re certainly open to something like that, especially if it has the prospects of leading to something positive," Rubio said in an interview with US broadcaster NBC.
Rubio additionally reaffirmed Washington’s stance concerning Iran’s nuclear programme, emphasising that the primary aim of any diplomatic engagement focuses on guaranteeing Tehran never obtains a nuclear weapon. "And that is the fact that Iran can never have a nuclear weapon. They just simply can’t," Rubio said.
Nevertheless, neither Washington nor Tehran has verified that a face-to-face meeting between the two presidents has been arranged. The potential for a Trump-Pezeshkian meeting unfolds while the nearly seven-month-old US-Iran conflict persists without resolution, accompanied by continuous warnings from both sides.
In remarks reported on Monday, Trump conveyed that Iran faced choices including "wiping Iran out," allowing its economy to "rot" or reaching a deal. He further remarked that he remained in "deciding mode" regarding Washington's next steps. "My question is, if and when do I blow the entire nation up," Trump said. "They better behave."
Simultaneously, Iranian officials have warned that any fresh US military action could lead to a broader conflict. Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, asserted that Tehran would alter both its weapons and the geographical scope of the conflict if Washington launched another attack.
"If a new aggression takes place, we will definitely change the weapons and geography of the war," Mohebbi said, according to Iran’s semi-official Fars news agency. With both Trump and Pezeshkian expected in New York for the UN General Assembly, the gathering provides a potential setting for direct contact between Washington and Tehran. (ANI)

US open to meeting Iran at UN, says Marco Rubio  The possibility of direct talks between the United States and Iran at the United Nations General Assembly has remained open, with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stating that President Donald Trump remains prepared to meet "anybody" should such an encounter foster constructive outcomes.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The possibility of direct talks between the United States and Iran at the United Nations General Assembly has remained open, with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stating that President Donald Trump remains prepared to meet "anybody" should such an encounter foster constructive outcomes. When questioned regarding whether Trump intended to interface with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in New York, Rubio noted that Washington remains receptive to the concept, though no formal schedule has been established.

Rubio additionally reaffirmed Washington’s stance concerning Iran’s nuclear programme, emphasizing that the primary aim of any diplomatic engagement focuses on guaranteeing Tehran never obtains a nuclear weapon.
"And that is the fact that Iran can never have a nuclear weapon. They just simply can’t," Rubio said. His observations arrive a day after Trump himself indicated he felt "probably open" toward holding discussions with Pezeshkian along the margins of the UN General Assembly. Nevertheless, neither Washington nor Tehran has verified that a face-to-face meeting between the two presidents has been arranged.
The potential for a Trump-Pezeshkian meeting unfolds while the nearly seven-month-old US-Iran conflict persists without resolution, accompanied by continuous warnings from both sides. In remarks reported on Monday, Trump conveyed that Iran faced choices including "wiping Iran out," allowing its economy to "rot" or reaching a deal. He further remarked that he remained in "deciding mode" regarding Washington's next steps.
"My question is, if and when do I blow the entire nation up," Trump said. "They better behave," he added.
Simultaneously, Iranian officials have warned that any fresh US military action could lead to a broader conflict. Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, asserted that Tehran would alter both its weapons and the geographical scope of the conflict if Washington launched another attack.
"If a new aggression takes place, we will definitely change the weapons and geography of the war," Mohebbi said, according to Iran’s semi-official Fars news agency. The diplomatic opening comes against the backdrop of conditions Tehran has set for a possible return to negotiations.
With both Trump and Pezeshkian expected in New York for the UN General Assembly, the gathering provides a potential setting for direct contact between Washington and Tehran. (ANI)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Summer Zhen

[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - ＢｏｆＡ証券によると、香港や米国に上場する多くの中国企業の株主が採用してきた人気の仕組みである海外信託（オフショアトラスト）に対して所得税を課す新たな規則を中国が導入したことで、納税期限が近づく中、一部の銘柄に短期的なリスクが生じる可能性がある。

• ＢｏｆＡ証券の中国株式ストラテジスト、ウィニー・ウー氏は香港での記者会見でロイターに対し、オフショアに上場する民間企業への監視が強まる可能性がある一方、国有企業への影響は比較的小さいとみられると述べた。

• 中国当局は７月、海外信託に置かれた資産とそこから生じる所得に個人所得税を課すと表明した。未納の税金は９０日以内に納付しなければならず、その期限が今、近づいている。

items.title: EXCLUSIVE-習氏、トランプ氏に台湾武器売却停止要請へ　見返りにイラン圧力の用意
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Yimou Lee　Ben Blanchard

［ワシントン　２２日　ロイター］ - 中国の習近平国家主席は今週のワシントン訪問でトランプ米大統領に対し、１９８２年の米中共同声明に基づいて台湾への武器売却を停止するよう迫る見通しだと、複数の関係筋が明らかにした。習氏は、２４日の首脳会談の翌日に予定する
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Yimou Lee　Ben Blanchard

［ワシントン　２２日　ロイター］ - 中国の習近平国家主席は今週のワシントン訪問でトランプ米大統領に対し、１９８２年の米中共同声明に基づいて台湾への武器売却を停止するよう迫る見通しだと、複数の関係筋が明らかにした。習氏は、２４日の首脳会談の翌日に予定する 米国立公文書館訪問の際に要請を行う可能性がある。見返りとして、イランに圧力をかけることに協力する用意があるという。 

習氏の訪米を前にした両国間の協議に詳しい関係筋３人によると、中国は１９８２年に署名された米中の３つの「共同声明」のうち３番目について、自国の解釈を持ち出す可能性が高い。

同声明で米国は、台湾への武器売却を段階的に減らす意向を示し、台湾への長期的な武器売却を追求しないとしている。

ただ、これに付随するメモで当時のレーガン米大統領は、武器売却削減に応じる米国の意思は「台湾との相違点を平和的に解決するという中国の継続的な関与を絶対条件とする」としている。

中国は過去５年間、実弾ミサイル発射を伴う軍事演習の実施を含め、台湾周辺での軍事活動を大幅に強化してきた。中国軍はほぼ毎日、台湾周辺で活動している。

関係筋によると、中国は台湾が既に発注済みの武器についても引き渡し停止を米国に求めている。

習氏はトランプ氏に対し、「台湾こそが挑発者で、米中関係における唯一の不安定要因であり、現状を変えているのは台湾側だ」と強調する可能性がある。

中国は見返りとして、中東紛争を巡りイランに圧力をかけるための協力を申し出ているという。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ氏がこれまでに、新たな台湾向け武器売却について比較的早期に判断を下すと述べている点に言及した。

中国共産党機関紙・人民日報は２２日、台湾問題の扱いを誤れば米中関係を「非常に危険な状況」に向かわせかねないと論じた。

中国外務省は、米国による台湾への武器売却に「断固反対する」と表明。３つの共同コミュニケと、台湾問題を巡る米国の従来の約束を順守することが、両国関係の安定的かつ健全な発展の「必要な前提条件」だとした。

台湾外交部（外務省）は、米国との「緊密な意思疎通」を維持しつつ、米中間のハイレベル交流の動向を引き続き注視していると述べた。

items.title: Trump, Greenland, Denmark sign deal in bid to end Arctic standoff
items.author: Gram Slattery, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
items.summary: US President Donald Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark signed an agreement on Tuesday that permits a larger US military presence on Greenland and may resolve a standoff over the strategically located and mineral-rich island.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark signed an agreement on Tuesday that permits a [USN:L1N45D0X6 TEXT:"larger US military presence"] on Greenland and may resolve [USN:L1N45D06G TEXT:"a standoff"] over the strategically located and mineral-rich island.
The agreement, signed during Trump's visit to the UN General Assembly in New York, stops short of Trump's demand that the US annex Greenland as a US territory to head off the growing Arctic presence of Russia and China.
But the deal does codify a greater US military presence on the icy territory, an option that emerged as Greenland leaders argued against a complete US takeover.
A text of the deal released after the event said the US can establish a "Golden Dome" defense system in Greenland as a shield against ballistic missile threats. The shortest route from Europe to North America runs via the Arctic island, which is the location of the northernmost US military base.
In his speech to the assembled world leaders at the UN before the signing ceremony, Trump said the agreement gives the US "permanent control over security and all other needs on that territory."
"No US adversary will ever be permitted to establish a military presence in Greenland any more, or make sensitive investments there without our express written approval," Trump said.
Trump signed the agreement along with Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen and Greenland Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen in a trilateral ceremony after Trump gave his UN speech.
Frederiksen described the agreement as a deal that can "last forever" and said it underlines the importance of the NATO alliance and respects Greenland's right to self-determination.
A STRONG NATO Nielsen emphasized the importance of NATO in the Arctic region. "We believe that it is vital to keep NATO strong, also in the Arctic, where the alliance has a key role to play," he said.
At a press conference after the signing, Nielsen said Greenlanders must now go through a process of restoring trust with the US. Trump's threats to take the island by force had strained relations with both Greenland and Denmark.
"I believe the crisis is over now, but I don't think the conflict is over in the sense that this agreement could very well be used - if the Americans wish - as a platform to force through further concessions," said Mikkel Vedby Rasmussen, a political science professor at the University of Copenhagen.
Greenland, a former colony and now a semi-autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark, sits between the Arctic and North America and holds vast energy resources.
The US already operates Pituffik Space Base in remote northwestern Greenland. The deal opens [USN:L1N45D0X6 TEXT:"two new military sites"]: Narsarsuaq, a former Cold War airbase whose population has dwindled to just a few dozen, and Mestersvig, currently used by the Sirius Dog Sled Patrol, a Danish special forces unit.
"We will immediately begin the process of developing a large military presence in the appropriate location. We will be building two very major military bases," Trump said in his UN speech.
Trump's refusal to rule out military or economic force to acquire Greenland triggered a diplomatic crisis in January within NATO and forced Denmark and the island's government into months of intensive negotiations.
The text of the agreement says it amends a 1951 defense treaty that had been the legal basis for the US presence.
It adds that Washington may seek further bases in the future, with details decided by mutual agreement. The deal has no end date, grants US aircraft and vessels broad access across Greenland and its territorial waters, and bars non-NATO states from establishing military installations on the island.
It also restricts foreign investment, effectively blocking states and investors from countries outside NATO, NATO partners and the European Union from holding control or significant influence in sectors deemed particularly sensitive, including critical infrastructure and resource extraction.
The deal, which needs approval by the parliaments of Denmark and Greenland, marks a shift from Trump's earlier ambitions for an outright acquisition of Greenland, an island three times the size of Texas with a population of only 57,000 scattered along its rugged coastline.
But it represents the first major increase in US military infrastructure in Greenland since the Cold War, when the US maintained 17 installations and more than 10,000 personnel there.
items.raw_description: US President Donald Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark signed an agreement on Tuesday that permits a larger US military presence on Greenland and may resolve a standoff over the strategically located and mineral-rich island.

items.title: 新たなエネルギーショックでインフレ高止まり-ECBチーフエコノミスト
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）のチーフエコノミストを務めるレーン理事は22日のスイス紙ル・タンとのインタビューで、エネルギー価格の新たな上昇局面を受け、ユーロ圏のインフレ率は当初予想していたより長期間、高止まりするとの見通しを示した。

レーン氏はその中で、「現在、原油だけでなくガスでも第2波の価格上昇が見られる」と指摘。「この第2波のエネルギー価格上昇は一段と高く、一層持続的なインフレにつながると考えられ、その後、2027年半ば以降はわれわれの目標に向けて鈍化すると予想している」と語った。

レーン氏は「現在目の当たりにしている第2波のエネルギー価格上昇は食品価格や、電力を含む広い意味でのエネルギー価格、物品価格全般に上昇圧力を及ぼすだろう」と述べる一方、「サービス価格への圧力は抑制された状態が続くだろう」と話した。

イランでの戦争を受けてエネルギーコストが急騰して以降、2回目の利上げを今月実施したECBでは、当局者がすでに追加利上げに向けた地ならしを始めている。10月にも0.25ポイントの追加の引き上げに踏み切る可能性がある。

ユーロ圏のインフレ率は今後数カ月で約4%に上昇すると予想されている。ECBの最新予測では、今年の平均が3%、来年が2.5%と見込まれており、いずれも2%の目標を大幅に上回る。一方、経済は引き続き底堅さを示している。

レーン氏は「この秋、ショックが一段と強く長期化すれば、経済の重荷になるだろう」としつつも、「ショックがそれほど深刻でなければ、欧州の一部で実施されている大規模な公的支出など、幾つかのプラス要因が成長を支えるだろう」と指摘。特にドイツのインフラ・防衛投資プログラムや、欧州連合（EU）の復興基金（NextGenerationEU）に言及した。

レーン氏はまた、「AI関連の活動の中心は欧州にはないものの、この分野で事業を展開する企業は十分にあり、欧州経済も恩恵を受けることができる」とした上で、「われわれの基本シナリオでは、エネルギーショックが激化しない限り、欧州経済は安定的で、緩やかなペースで成長を続けるとみている」と説明した。

items.title: China’s CXMT advances DRAM with G5 platform; Eyes strategic move into NAND flash
items.summary: China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) commenced commercial output on its fifth-generation platform, consolidating its market position against entrenched global competitors Samsung Electronics, ...
items.body:
China’s CXMT advances DRAM with G5 platform; Eyes strategic move into NAND flash China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) commenced commercial output on its fifth-generation platform, consolidating its market position against entrenched global competitors Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, and Micron, according to a news report by The Korea Herald.
ANI | Updated: 22-09-2026 19:07 IST | Created: 22-09-2026 19:07 IST

China’s CXMT starts small-scale HBM3E production (Photo/CXMT). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

South Korea

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) commenced commercial output on its fifth-generation platform, consolidating its market position against entrenched global competitors Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, and Micron, according to a news report by The Korea Herald. The Chinese semiconductor firm also prepares an experimental research facility in Beijing to evaluate an expansion into NAND flash memory, according to a news report by The Korea Herald.
CXMT confirmed that its G5 architecture entered volume production alongside two 24-gigabit LPDDR5X components intended for portable hardware and smartphones. Dynamic random-access memory provides real-time workspace for processors, serving as an essential building block across personal computers, enterprise servers, and mobile devices. The chipmaker reported that the new platform delivers at least 50 per cent more gross dies per wafer compared to its previous process on an 8-gigabit-equivalent standard. Gross die count reflects the aggregate quantity of potential chips extracted from a single wafer before defect screening, rather than an outright gain in production yields.
The manufacturing rollout follows CXMT’s rise to fourth place globally in the DRAM sector, capturing 9.5 per cent of second-quarter revenue, according to TrendForce data cited in the report. Market leader Samsung held 39.4 per cent, followed by SK hynix at 24.9 per cent and Micron at 23.3 per cent. Through quadruple patterning techniques, CXMT narrowed the active-area half-pitch in its memory array to 11.95 nanometers, a metric specific to internal array layout that does not directly match node designations used by competitors.
Assessing the competitive landscape during an industry webinar in August, TechInsights Vice President and memory-chip analyst Choi Jung-dong noted the gap between CXMT and dominant fabricators. “CXMT is about two generations behind the industry leaders,” the news report quoted Choi.
He added, “but it is steadily advancing its HBM roadmap toward higher-performance memory solutions.” As market leaders allocate manufacturing capacity toward server memory and high-bandwidth memory for artificial intelligence acceleration, standard DRAM availability remains constrained, offering smaller producers openings to secure orders.
CXMT is now assessing the NAND segment, where stored information persists without continuous electric power, powering storage drives and mobile devices. Domestic rival Yangtze Memory Technologies leads China’s current NAND output. Reuters reported that CXMT’s Beijing NAND research line remains in exploratory phases, with the company holding preliminary discussions with prospective buyers while commercial timelines remain undetermined. TrendForce figures place Samsung atop the second-quarter NAND sector with 29.3 per cent revenue share, ahead of SK hynix Group at 18.2 per cent.
Analyzing broader dynamics, an industry official highlighted the pressure building against dominant Korean manufacturers. “Chinese memory makers still have a clear cost disadvantage to their Korean rivals, but tight supply has given them more room to win orders and expand production,” the news report quoted an industry official.
The official added, “If the current upcycle lasts, competition from both Chinese and US suppliers, backed by heavy government support, will become harder for the Korean companies to ignore.” (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.body:
[２１日 ロイター] - 米アルファベット傘下のグーグルは２１日、スマートフォンの基本ソフト（ＯＳ）「アンドロイド」と連動する新たなプレミアムノートパソコン（ＰＣ）「グーグルブック」の予約受け付けを開始した。人工知能（ＡＩ）ツール「ジェミニ」を中核に据えた製品だ。

価格は８９９ドルから。エイサー、エイスース、デル、ＨＰ、レノボの初期モデルは、インテルまたはクアルコムのプロセッサーを搭載し、バッテリー駆動時間は最大１４時間になるという。

今回の製品投入は、アップルが６９９ドルの「ＭａｃＢｏｏｋ　Ｎｅｏ（マックブックネオ） 」で低価格ノートＰＣ市場への進出を強める中で行われた。この市場では、グーグルのＰＣ用ＯＳ「クロームＯＳ」を搭載した「クロームブック」のメーカーが長年、手ごろな価格とシンプルさを武器に学生や節約志向の消費者をターゲットにしてきたが、競争が激化している。

グーグルブックは、より高性能なハードウエア、ＡＩ機能、アンドロイドとのより緊密な統合を通じて、こうした戦略をプレミアムノートＰＣに広げるものだ。

製品群には、文章の作成・整理を支援したり、画面上のコンテンツに関する質問に答えたり、アンドロイドスマートフォンで行っていた作業を引き継いだりできるジェミニのツールが含まれる。

アンドロイドの技術基盤に、クロームＯＳのデスクトップ向け基盤を組み合わせて構築されており、スマートフォンとパソコンの間の切り替えをよりシームレスにすることを目指している。

items.title: Textile stocks rally up to 10%: Raymond, Gokaldas Exports & others rebound after Trump tariff-triggered selloff
items.author: Debaroti Adhikary
items.summary: Textile stocks rebounded on Tuesday, recovering most of the previous session’s losses after US President Donald Trump signed a Russia sanctions bill into law. Raymond led the gains with a 10% rally, while Pearl Global Industries, Gokaldas Exports, Arvind and Vardhman Textiles also advanced.
items.body: Raymond shares rallied 10% and briefly remained locked in the upper circuit, hitting a fresh 52-week high of Rs 1,193.40 apiece. Pearl Global Industries shares jumped 8%, while Gokaldas Exports gained around 3%. Arvind and Vardhman Textiles shares rose around 1% each.Trump's new tariff tantrumsTextile stocks fell up to 5% on Monday after Trump signed the bipartisan Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 into law, paving the way for increased economic pressure on Russia over its invasion of Ukraine.The new law gives the Trump administration the power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas, potentially exposing major buyers such as India and China to higher duties on exports to the US, the single-largest market for India’s textile and apparel exporters.“Any additional tariffs under this Act will be very difficult to absorb for the MSME-dominated Indian textile and apparel sector already under stress due to several factors, including the continuing turmoil in West Asia. It will severely impact our ability to sell in the United States, our most significant market by a distance,” said Ashwin Chandran, Chairman of the Confederation of Indian Textile Industry (CITI).Also read | Trump’s tariff tantrums return? Gokaldas Exports, other textile stocks drop up to 5% after Trump signs Russia sanctions billIndia to cut down Russian oil imports?Indian refiners could now cut back purchases of crude shipments from Russia after the sweeping US sanctions bill, Reuters reported. The government could limit Russian crude imports in the near term to 20% to 30% of India’s total in order to shed its position as the top buyer of Moscow’s seaborne oil, people familiar with the matter told Reuters, adding that the government meanwhile continues to negotiate with the US.Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump is hosting Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Washington this week. Xi Jinping is set to arrive in the US on Wednesday, marking the first time in more than a decade. Markets will closely watch for signs of an extension of a tariff truce announced after a Trump-Xi summit in South Korea last October and set to expire on November 10. That deal paused a trade war in which the world's two largest economies threatened global supply chains with tit-for-tat tariffs that topped 100%.India-New Zealand FTAAt the same time, India and New Zealand finalised the free trade agreement (FTA) on Monday which is set to come into force on October 20. Almost exactly three years ago, I committed that National would secure a free trade deal with India within our first term if elected. And today, we finalised the deal, which comes into force next month, New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said in a post on X. It is exciting to think of how many businesses will grow as a result of this FTA, and then consider what that means for them, for the people who work for them, and for the country as a whole. It means more opportunities for exporters, stronger growth for businesses, and more jobs and higher incomes for New Zealand, Luxon added.Also read | India-New Zealand FTA finalised; 100% of Indian exports to get duty-free access from October 20Disclaimer: This article has been written by Debaroti Adhikary, who is not a SEBI-registered Research Analyst or an Investment Adviser. items.title: 米、アラスカ沖の中国海洋活動を注視＝沿岸警備隊幹部
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ ２１日 ロイター] - 米沿岸警備隊北極管区のリトル司令官は、米国の北極海域における中国の活動を「非常に注意深く」監視していると明らかにした。

同氏は北極圏の安全保障に関する会議で講演するため訪問したオスロでロイターに対し、今年に入り中国の調査船４隻が米国の北極海域で活動しており、２０２５年通年の５隻に匹敵するペースだと指摘した。

中国船はアリューシャン列島を含むアラスカ州沖の海域を航行し、ベーリング海峡を経て、北は北極点にまで達したという。

同氏は「私が責任、関心、懸念を有するのは、米国の主権が及ぶ海域内やその周辺で中国船が活動している場合だ」とし、「排他的経済水域（ＥＥＺ）の内側や延長大陸棚の上空であれば当然、安全保障上の懸念となる。そうした活動をわれわれは非常に注意深く監視している」と述べた。

これらの船舶は国際水域にとどまっていたものの、通常の慣行として求められる外交ルートを通じた事前通告を米国に行っていなかったという。

リトル氏は「われわれが活動の目的を問いただすと、『国際水域で活動を実施している』あるいは『科学調査を行っている』という回答が通常返ってくる」と述べた。

同氏によると、懸念は２つあり、一つは米国に帰属する海域で中国が海底の鉱物資源開発に焦点を当てた科学調査に関与している可能性があることだ。もう一つは、こうした船舶が「中国側に軍事的な優位性を与えたり、米国の安全保障上の脅威となったりする」活動を行っている可能性だという。

items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィリピンの複合企業アヤラ・コーポレーションは２１日、三菱商事が４４５億フィリピンペソ（７億０９４８万ドル）追加出資すると発表した。出資比率は現在の４．７％から３倍超の１５％に、議決権ベースでは２０％に上がり、三菱商事のフィリピン事業基盤が一段と強化される。

１株当たりの株式取得価格は６５０ペソと、直近終値に対して約２２％のプレミアムを乗せた水準。

三菱商事は、消費者向け事業での協力を深めるほか、アヤラの中核事業である不動産とエネルギーの分野で機会を追求する方針を示した。２０２６年度中の取引完了を見込む。

アヤラは、スマートフォン決済アプリ最大手「Ｇキャッシュ」を運営するミントに傘下通信会社を通じて資本参加する。ミントは先週、フィリピン証券取引所への上場申請が承認された。資金調達額は最大１４億７０００万ドル規模と、フィリピン最大の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）になる可能性がある。

items.title: Trump advierte en la ONU de que podría "aniquilar" Irán si no hay un acuerdo de paz
items.author: Gram Slattery, Humeyra Pamuk
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Humeyra Pamuk
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, aprovechó su discurso ante la Asamblea General de la ONU el martes para afirmar que la guerra con Irán había impedido que Teherán obtenga un arma nuclear y advirtió de que podría "aniquilar la República Islámica" si no se alcanzaba un acuerdo para poner fin al conflicto.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, aprovechó su discurso ante la Asamblea General de la ONU el martes para afirmar que la guerra con Irán había impedido que Teherán obtenga un arma nuclear y advirtió de que podría "aniquilar la República Islámica" si no se alcanzaba un acuerdo para poner fin al conflicto.
Aunque pronosticó que su Gobierno alcanzará un acuerdo de paz con Irán tras las elecciones de legislativas estadounidenses del 3 de noviembre, Trump instó a otros países a unirse a Estados Unidos para aislar económicamente a Irán y obligarlo a sentarse a la mesa de negociaciones.
"Tengo que tomar una gran decisión. ¿Se alcanzará un acuerdo con Irán que les permita reconstruirse y crear un país mucho más grande de lo que jamás ha sido?", dijo Trump. "¿O aniquilo la República Islámica y lo hago rápidamente, sin darles nunca la oportunidad de volver a matar y destruir a personas y países?"
"¿Los arrastro al infierno sin posibilidad de supervivencia y sin esperanza de grandeza futura ni de generaciones venideras? Pero creo que llegaremos a un acuerdo justo después de las elecciones", agregó.
El discurso supuso otra justificación de Trump para la guerra con Irán. Antes había citado una serie de razones para los ataques estadounidenses e israelíes de febrero, entre ellas el programa nuclear de Teherán, su apoyo a grupos regionales afines y la perspectiva de un cambio de régimen.
Irán ha negado sistemáticamente que pretenda desarrollar armas nucleares.
Fuera de la sede de la ONU se reunieron decenas de manifestantes contrarios al Gobierno iraní; algunos de ellos sostenían pancartas en las que reclamaban libertad y democracia y condenaban la dictadura.
"Creo que llegaremos a un acuerdo justo después de las elecciones porque no tiene sentido que no lo hagan. Están esperando a ver cómo me va en las elecciones legislativas", dijo Trump durante un discurso ante la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas.
El discurso dio inicio a una jornada de diplomacia de alto nivel en las Naciones Unidas, donde Trump tenía previsto reunirse con más de una docena de líderes mundiales, mientras las guerras en Oriente Medio y Ucrania seguían poniendo a prueba su agenda de política exterior.
Trump tiene previsto de reunirse con nada menos que 11 líderes mundiales, ya sea de forma bilateral o en reuniones de grupo.
Se reunirá con el primer ministro británico, Andy Burnham; el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski; la presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez; la primera ministra danesa, Mette Frederiksen; el primer ministro de Groenlandia, Jens-Frederik Nielsen; y los representantes de los Estados del golfo Pérsico: Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Arabia Saudita, Omán, Baréin, Kuwait y Qatar.
Por la noche, podría reunirse con decenas de líderes más, aunque sea brevemente, durante una recepción de mandatarios. Trump se había reunido el lunes con el presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron. Es posible que se añadan más citas a su agenda del martes.
La extensa lista de reuniones con líderes extranjeros refleja el enfoque del presidente de Estados Unidos en los asuntos exteriores durante su segundo mandato, en el que ha iniciado múltiples guerras, ha cuestionado alianzas de larga data, ha amenazado a aliados con invasiones y ha intentado mediar en más de una decena de conflictos, con resultados dispares.
Tanto aliados como opositores políticos seguirán de cerca la primera reunión de Trump con la presidenta interina venezolana, quien llegó al poder con el beneplácito de Washington, después de que las fuerzas estadounidenses detuvieron al presidente Nicolás Maduro en enero y lo trasladaron a Nueva York para que se enfrentara a cargos de tráfico de drogas.
Los aliados de Trump dicen que Estados Unidos está colaborando con Rodríguez para abrir el sector petrolero venezolano a la inversión estadounidense, pero los demócratas y algunos republicanos sostienen que su Gobierno no ha hecho lo suficiente para presionar a favor de la celebración de nuevas elecciones en el país sudamericana.
Durante la reunión con los líderes de Dinamarca y Groenlandia, territorio de ultramar danés, Trump firmará un acuerdo destinado a aumentar la presencia militar estadounidense en la isla, al tiempo que se limita la de los adversarios geopolíticos.
Las autoridades danesas y groenlandesas esperan que el acuerdo ponga fin a los comentarios anteriores de Trump que apuntaban a que podría tomar Groenlandia por la fuerza.

items.body:
[チューリヒ ２２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるフィリップ・レーン専務理事は、 地政学リスクが再び高まっているとみられ、原油・ガス価格を押し上げているエネルギーショックはＥＣＢが３月時点で想定していたよりも長期化する見通しだという認識を示した。２２日付のスイス紙ルタンが伝えた。

レーン氏は同紙に対し、「その結果、この第２波のエネルギー価格上昇は、より高く、より持続的なインフレをもたらすと考えている。インフレはその後、２０２７年半ばから（ＥＣＢの）目標に向けて低下していくだろう」と述べた。

電力やサービスなど他の物価への波及効果が見られるかとの質問には「これまでのところ、２月から現在に至るまで、そうした影響は見られておらず、朗報だ。しかし、現在見られているエネルギー価格上昇の第２波は、食品価格、電力を含むより広範なエネルギー価格、そして一般的なモノの価格に上昇圧力をかける可能性が高い。対照的に、サービス価格への圧力は比較的抑制された状態が続く見込みだ」と語った。

items.title: What Princess Diana's brother Charles Spencer says in new book
items.author: Sam Tabahriti
items.creator: Sam Tabahriti
items.summary: Charles Spencer's memoir "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" published on Tuesday, nearly 30 years after Princess Diana's death, contains a series of allegations about his sister's former marriage to Britain's King Charles and the aftermath of her death.
items.body:
Charles Spencer's memoir "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" published on Tuesday, nearly 30 years after Princess Diana's death, contains a [USN:L1N45C040 TEXT:"series of allegations"] about his sister's former marriage to Britain's King Charles and the [USN:L8N45A0OG TEXT:"aftermath of her death"].
Below are details from pre-released excerpts from Spencer's book and comments from interviews he has made while promoting it:
CHARLES SAID DIANA WOULD BE FORGOTTEN Spencer [USN:L8N44F0RH TEXT:"writes"] that then-Prince Charles had told him "we'll forget her soon enough" during an angry phone call after Diana's death, following what he said had been a disagreement over whether her sons Princes William and Harry should walk behind their mother's coffin.
Buckingham Palace took the [USN:L8N4581JE TEXT:"unusual step"] to dispute Spencer's account.
Asked about it in a BBC interview, Spencer said: "Those are precisely the words he said."
CHARLES SOUNDED 'GIDDILY ELATED' In the book, Spencer writes that Charles had sounded "giddily elated" and "like a [USN:L8N4591RV TEXT:"lottery winner"]" when he had called him after Diana's death.
Spencer says that he had later suspected Charles may have been thinking about how Diana's death could free him to marry Camilla, now his wife, though he acknowledged in a BBC interview that he could not know for certain what Charles was thinking.
SPENCER OPPOSED WILLIAM AND HARRY WALKING BEHIND COFFIN Spencer says he had argued against plans for William and [USN:L8N4590QP TEXT:"Harry"], then aged 15 and 12, to walk in Diana's funeral procession through London because he then believed she would not have wanted them subjected to the ordeal.
QUEEN ELIZABETH OFFERED TO RESTORE DIANA'S ROYAL TITLE Spencer says that Queen Elizabeth, through her private secretary, had offered to posthumously restore Diana's "Her Royal Highness" title on the day of her funeral.
According to the book, Spencer rejected the offer, saying it had come too late.
DIANA CONSIDERED CALLING OFF HER WEDDING TO CHARLES Spencer writes that his sister had considered ending her engagement to Charles before their 1981 wedding because she feared he did not love her.
He says she had raised her concerns with their father but ultimately proceeded with the marriage.
DIANA HAD THOUGHTS ABOUT SUICIDE Spencer wrote that "in her later years, Diana drove herself more than once to Beachy Head, the highest chalk sea cliff in England, while contemplating ending it all".
"Her love for her sons stopped her from going further," he said in his book.
CHARLES WAS 'IN LOVE WITH HIS VALET' According to his book, Spencer said that he had met Diana for lunch when she told him she was going to get divorced from Charles.
When he warned her that the public might not forgive her, he said she told him: "But, Carlos, my husband is in love with his valet."
Spencer said he did not know who the person was and why she would believe "such an improbable thing". Asked about it in the BBC interview, Spencer said: "I know Diana said that to me and that's why I recorded it ... I can absolutely swear that she said those words to me."
WHY SPENCER WROTE THE BOOK Spencer, 62 and only three years apart from his sister, told the BBC he wrote the memoir because he felt it was his "duty" as an "eyewitness to history" and wanted to record what he believes is a truthful account of Diana's life before the 30th anniversary of her death.
He told the BBC that he knew "lots of things about the king which I chose not to include", saying the book would be his last word on the matter.

items.title: Britain's royals set to emerge from another crisis, bruised but unbowed
items.author: Kate Holton, Michael Holden
items.creator: Kate Holton, Michael Holden
items.summary: Turmoil and uproar are nothing new for the British royals.
items.body:
For decades Buckingham Palace has faced a series of crises from the death of Princess Diana, to her son Prince Harry's memoir and scandals around Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, but each time the British monarchy has bounced back, bruised but unbowed.
As it deals with the latest drama in the form [USN:L8N45A0OG TEXT:"of a book by Charles Spencer,"] the brother of King Charles' first wife Diana, the historic institution, as it has many times before, is seeking to emerge without lasting damage to its standing.
"The 90s were very much worse. I would argue Harry's book 'Spare' was very much worse. It was a huge noise at the time and the opinion polls didn't move one jot and I don't think they will this time either," said veteran royal author Robert Hardman.
"As the late queen (Elizabeth) always used to say, 'this storm, too, shall pass'."
Turmoil and uproar are nothing new for the British royals, whose lives, loves and squabbles continue to enthral people across the world, not least US President Donald Trump .
Be it the abdication of Edward VIII in 1936, the marital woes of the queen's children in the 1990s to the more recent events involving [USN:L8N4500HG TEXT:"Harry and his wife Meghan"], the family has faced perceived potential existential threats and survived.
For decades Diana - the so-called "people's princess" who married Charles in a fairytale wedding in 1981, divorced the then-heir in 1996 and was killed in a car crash the following year - has been the cut that has never fully healed.
Now, [USN:L8N45A0ZT TEXT:"her brother's book"] "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister", has once again reopened the wound, reminding the world of her pointed criticism of both the institution and specifically her ex-husband.
It was notable that, within hours of Spencer's book being serialised in the Daily Mail, Buckingham Palace [USN:L8N4581JE TEXT:"had released a statement"] to say his grief could impact reason, judgment and memory.
Royal commentator Afua Hagan told Reuters the blunt approach was not without risk. "I do think it was quite cold, quite aloof, and that kind of harks back to what people said about the royal family in those days after Princess Diana died," she said.
But Hardman, and those close to the monarch, say it will pass.
"It dents the bonnet but doesn’t crack the chassis," an unnamed friend of the king told the Sunday Times.
NEVER COMPLAIN, NEVER EXPLAIN Diana's death in 1997, and the public opprobrium levelled at a monarchy perceived to be out-of-touch that followed, led the royal family to rethink and professionalise its communications, and adapt its policy of "never complain, never explain".
If there is a danger for the royals now, it is that the book comes on the back of the never-ending drama surrounding the king's younger son, Harry, and the ongoing police investigation into his younger brother, [USN:L8N42C1GE TEXT:"Mountbatten-Windsor"].
The stream of negative publicity drowns out the work they want people to know about and, more importantly, which helps justify the [USN:L1N42Y0EJ TEXT:"millions of taxpayer dollars"] they receive every year.
Last week, Prince William, the king's eldest son and heir, and his wife Kate's trip to Scotland, which might usually feature on newspaper front pages, barely got a look in.
"All they can do is keep calm and carry on. But unfortunately, that's not necessarily the news and what people want to hear about," Hagan said.
"The working royals are being overshadowed, essentially, by all the other things that are happening."
While Spencer's book makes very uncomfortable reading for Charles and some of those around him, it is less critical of the monarchy as an institution, perhaps unsurprising given his nephew William, who has made it clear he will do things differently, will one day be king.
"I find some of the flummery around the monarchy quite jarring," Spencer told the BBC. "I don't think it's healthy for a human being to be seen in such archaic, servile terms. I'm all for a monarchy but I'd like a modern monarchy."

items.title: Memoir by Princess Diana's brother flies off the shelves
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British shoppers snapped up copies of a memoir by the brother of Princess Diana on Tuesday after their interest was piqued by incendiary allegations about her troubled marriage to the now-king, including the claim he was "giddily elated" at her death.
items.body:
British shoppers snapped up copies of a memoir by the brother of Princess Diana on Tuesday after their interest was piqued by incendiary [USN:L8N45D0VU TEXT:"allegations about her"] troubled marriage to the now-king, including the claim he was "giddily elated" at her death.
[USN:L8N45A0ZT TEXT:"Charles Spencer"], who delivered a much-lauded eulogy at the 1997 funeral of his sister, has sparked [USN:L8N45D0O1 TEXT:"global headlines"] with a book that accuses the then-Prince of Wales of sounding like a "lottery winner" in the hours after her death.
[USN:L8N4590QP TEXT:"Buckingham Palace"] hit back immediately, saying the king was "mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, judgment and memory", as it sought to prevent the king from being dragged back into one of the royal family's most damaging periods.
TOP OF THE CHARTS The book, "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister", was released in Britain on Tuesday, where allegations contained in pre-released excerpts have dominated newspaper front pages for almost a week, helping send it straight to the top of the bestseller list on Amazon.
Outside a central London bookshop, Chris Imafidon, 71, said he bought a copy after being intrigued by some of the allegations, which he did not see as credible.
"There's a desire for one to be protective of your sister," he said.
For others, Diana, one of the most photographed women in the world, remains an icon, and the appeal of the "People's Princess" endures 29 years after she died in a car crash.
"I just hope to hear more about her life with her family, growing up, and with her children," said Mary Scheible, 69.
Spencer said he wrote the book to set the record straight and because it was his duty "as an eyewitness to history".
He said in the book that he spoke to Charles shortly after Diana's death was confirmed. "Unlike my other callers, who were stunned, barely able to articulate their condolences and offers of help, he sounded giddily elated – like a lottery winner, I remember thinking at the time," he wrote, according to pre-released excerpts.
"Looking back now, I suspect the prince's first reaction must have been to think more of how this event might free him to marry the woman he loved, rather than appreciating the loss of one he did not."
Diana was just 20 when she married the heir-to-the-throne Prince Charles in 1981, a fairytale wedding watched around the world. They had two children, William and Harry, but the relationship soon soured and, following years of briefing against one another in the media, they finally divorced in 1996.
That was a year after Diana told the BBC that "there were three of us in this marriage, so it was a bit crowded" in reference to Charles' relationship with Camilla Parker Bowles, whom he married in 2005.
Spencer describes his book as an intimate, loving and honest portrait of his sister, who he said became a global icon overnight.

items.title: インフレリスク顕在化の可能性、失業率の上昇必要も＝豪中銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [シドニー ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[シドニー ２２日 ロイター] - オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）のブロック総裁は２２日、エネルギー価格が高止まりし、国内で需要超過が続いていることを踏まえると、インフレの上振れリスクが顕在化しつつある可能性があると述べた。早ければ来週にも利上げが行われるとの市場の見方を裏付けた。

ビジネス関連の昼食会で講演したブロック氏は、失業率が４．５─５．０％の範囲にあればインフレ抑制に寄与し得るとも述べ、現在の４．５％から幾分上昇する必要があるかもしれないとの見方を示唆した。

今月２９日の会合で金利がどうなるかを示唆する意図はなく、あくまでインフレの上振れリスクを強調しているだけだと説明した。

こうしたリスクには、中東紛争とエネルギー価格への影響のほか、国内需要によるインフレ圧力が含まれる。

ブロック氏は「われわれが自問しているのは、こうしたリスクの一部が顕在化したのかどうかだ」とした上で、「中東紛争は当初想定されていたよりもはるかに長引いており、（国内）経済にはなお超過需要が存在するようだ」と述べた。

豪中銀のハンター総裁補はこの日、インフレを確実に抑え込むため、今年４回目となる利上げが必要になる可能性があるとの見解を改めて示した。

items.title: Princess Diana's brother, eyewitness to history, sparks royal ruckus
items.author: Sarah Young
items.creator: Sarah Young
items.summary: Charles Spencer said he wrote a book about his sister because it was his duty "as an eyewitness to history", but his version of events has been rejected by Buckingham Palace in unusually strong terms.
items.body:
Charles Spencer, brother of the late Princess Diana, is no stranger to writing books about British kings.
His previous bestsellers include "Killers of the King" and "To Catch a King" and, while those two works focused on the 17th century, some might say his [USN:L8N45D1MQ TEXT:"latest book"] is along the same lines.
"Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" will be published on Tuesday, and is his take on his sister's life and her unhappy marriage to the now King Charles. In [USN:L8N45D0VU TEXT:"pre-released excerpts"], Spencer claims Charles was "giddily elated" in the aftermath of Diana's death in 1997, reopening a painful episode for the royal family.
Spencer, 62, said he wrote the book because it was his duty "as an eyewitness to history", but his version of events has been rejected by Buckingham Palace in [USN:L8N4581JE TEXT:"unusually strong terms"].
"The pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and colour memory," it said, in a statement that added to the publicity surrounding the book.
GODSON TO QUEEN ELIZABETH Spencer was born into a British aristocratic family, with close links to the royal family. The late Queen Elizabeth was his godmother.
He was 17 when his 20-year-old sister, fast becoming the most photographed woman in the world, married the then-Prince Charles in a fairytale wedding in 1981. Spencer told CNN in an interview some years later how at the time he was more interested in "exams and playing my sports at school" than the global event.
The wider world, however, was fascinated by the young couple, who went on to have two sons, William in 1982 and Harry two years later. But behind the scenes, the relationship unravelled.
"I didn't fully understand actually how very difficult things were for her at times," Spencer told Good Morning America in an interview before the book was released.
"That's one of my regrets. I wish I could have done more to help her."
By the early 1990s, Diana's unhappiness was making headlines across the world, and she and Charles were using the media to brief against each other. They divorced in 1996.
A year later, she was killed, aged 36, in a Paris car accident as she was pursued by photographers. Spencer used a much-lauded eulogy at her funeral to tell an estimated 2 billion people watching around the world that her "particular brand of magic" meant she would "never be extinguished from our minds".
His words were applauded by the tens of thousands of people who listened on loudspeakers in the streets of London, but some of his comments about how Diana's goodness was "threatening" and how her "blood family" would need to protect her sons, made uncomfortable listening for the royal family.
'ASTONISHINGLY PROVOCATIVE' Whatever goodwill between the two families remained after Diana's death will likely have been lost after Spencer's new allegations about King Charles, which have reignited talk about one of the most damaging periods in the [USN:L8N45D0O1 TEXT:"royal family's modern history"].
He writes that Charles said of Diana "we'll forget her soon enough", before shouting at Spencer for suggesting the then 15-year-old William and 12-year-old Harry, should not be expected to walk behind her coffin at the funeral.
Spencer, who has seven children from three different wives and married his fourth wife earlier this year, hit back at Buckingham Palace's questioning of his memory.
"It was astonishingly provocative and below the belt because it was essentially trying to say I'd lied without the King being able to deny what I'd said," he told the Daily Mail.
After studying history at the University of Oxford in the early 1980s, Spencer worked for US broadcaster NBC News for a decade, presenting lifestyle and travel programmes.
He inherited the family's 30-bedroom ancestral mansion in central England in 1992, when his father died, and started writing history books in the late 1990s, one of which was shortlisted for an award and many of which were top sellers.
His publishing career has helped pay for the restoration of the Althorp estate, which has been in his family for five centuries and where Diana is buried.
In 2024, he published a memoir, "A Very Private School", that detailed his experience of sexual abuse, neglect and isolation while at boarding school as a child.
"When looking at the wreckage of my first and second marriages, I learned early in therapy that being sent away to boarding school at eight years of age meant that I had next to no understanding of intimacy," he writes in that book.

items.title: アリババ、パラメーター数5兆─10兆のＡＩモデル計画　新半導体発表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 中国アリババグループは２２日、パラメーター数が５兆から１０兆に上る新たな人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルを訓練する計画を明らかにした。また、ＡＩモデル、半導体、データセンターを網羅する包括的な戦略を打ち出した。

呉泳銘最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は杭州で開かれたアリババ・クラウドの年次イベントで講演し、同社のＡＩモデル「Ｑｗｅｎ（通義千問）」のチームが「より複雑で長期的なタスク」を完遂し「人工超知能（ＡＳＩ）」に向けて前進することを目標に、モデルアーキテクチャーとデータ最適化の研究を継続していると述べた。

同社は別の声明で、次世代モデル「Ｑｗｅｎ４」を現在訓練中で、その後の「Ｑｗｅｎ４．５」および「Ｑｗｅｎ５」シリーズはパラメーター数を５兆から１０兆規模まで拡大する見通しだとした。 

パラメーターはモデルが訓練中に学習する変数で、モデルの規模を大まかに示す指標となる。

アリババの現行主力モデル「Ｑｗｅｎ３．８Ｍａｘ」のパラメーター数は２兆４０００億で、計画中のモデルはこの２─４倍の規模となる。

呉氏はアリババ独自のＡＩスーパーノード「Ｍ８９０」が既に２兆パラメーターを超えるモデルの推論を処理できると述べ、この能力を持つのは「世界でも一握りの企業」だけだとした。

ＡＩ自身がモデルを改善する「再帰的自己改善」においてＱｗｅｎチームが「有意義な進展」を遂げたとも述べた。

アリババはまた、半導体子会社Ｔ－Ｈｅａｄ（平頭哥）が手がける次世代ＡＩ半導体「Ｚｈｅｎｗｕ　Ｖ９００」を発表した。呉氏は同製品が中国で最も強力なＡＩチップだとし、前世代の「Ｍ８９０」の３倍の性能を発揮すると述べた。

Ｖ９００は２０２７年第１・四半期に量産・商用化の予定という。Ｍ８９０は今年５月にリリースされていた。

呉氏は、年間のＡＩ半導体出荷量に「大幅な成長」が見込まれると述べた。

呉氏はアリババ・クラウドの世界データセンター容量を３２年までに２０ギガワット超に拡大する目標も打ち出した。顧客のＡＩ需要は「極めて堅調」で、クラウド事業の収益成長を加速させていると述べた。ただ、ＡＩデータセンターのサプライチェーン全体で世界的な供給不足が生じており、拡大ペースが制約されていることを認めた。

items.title: 仏ソジェン新3カ年計画、ＲＯＴＥ13─14％　ＡＩでコスト削減拡大
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tommy Reggiori Wilkes　Elizabeth Howcroft

［ロンドン／パリ　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tommy Reggiori Wilkes　Elizabeth Howcroft

［ロンドン／パリ　２１日　ロイター］ - フランス金融大手ソシエテ・ジェネラル（ソジェン）は２１日、２０２９年までの新たな３カ年戦略計画を発表した。主要な業績目標を引き上げるとともに、追加のコスト削減を実施するとした。

ソジェンは高コスト体質と低い収益性が長年、業績の重しとなってきた。２３年に就任したスラウォミール・クルパ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は体質改善による立て直しを表明。同年９月に発表した３カ年計画は成果を上げ始めている。

クルパ氏はロンドンで投資家向けに新計画を説明し、「コスト削減は従来から、そして今後も当行の戦略の中核であり続ける」と述べた。

新計画では、２９年の有形株主資本利益率（ＲＯＴＥ）目標を１３─１４％とし、今年の約１１％から引き上げる。３０年以降は１５％到達を目指す。現在の水準は同業他社の大半を下回る。

配当と自社株買いを通じた株主還元方針は変更しない。目標を達成した場合、ソジェンは２０２６─２９年の４年間に最大２１０億ユーロを株主に還元する可能性がある。

＜ＡＩでコスト削減を後押し＞

２９年までに１９億ユーロのコスト削減を目指す。調達・情報技術（ＩＴ）関連の支出削減、人工知能（ＡＩ）による生産性向上、人員削減を通じ、総コストを２６年水準から２％減の１６３億ユーロ（１８７億ドル）未満に抑える。

２９年の経費率を５５％未満とし、従来目標の６０％からさらなる抑制を目指す。

＜プライムブローカレッジとリテールで増収狙う＞

最大部門の投資銀行は、米銀が市場シェアを伸ばす中で、ここ数四半期、業績が振るわない状況となっている。

グローバル・マーケッツ部門の２９年収入は６０億─６５億ユーロと予想。これは前年の６０億ユーロとあまり変わらない。

クルパ氏は、ヘッジファンド向け業務やプライムブローカレッジ、金融スポンサーへの助言業務で収益を増やす大きな機会があるとの見方を示した。

フランス国内のリテール銀行業ではレボリュートなどのデジタル銀行が事業を拡大している。ソジェンはデジタル銀行「ブルソバンク」について、現在９００万人の顧客数を２９年までに１４００万人に増やす計画。

またブルソバンクとリテール部門を単一の経営体制に統合する。ブルソバンクは顧客のあらゆる資産水準に対応し、支店網を多く抱えるリテール部門は「マス富裕層」に重点を置く。

＜金利動向注視＞

ソジェンの業績はこの２年間、金利上昇が欧州の銀行全体の利益を押し上げる中で改善した。ただ金利上昇は最終的に銀行の資金調達コストを押し上げる可能性がある。ソジェンをはじめとするフランス金融各社は、世界的な債券売りとフランスの財政持続可能性への懸念を背景に他の先進国市場より速いペースで上昇しているフランス国債利回りの動向を注視している。

クルパ氏は、ソジェンは向こう２─３年にわたりヘッジをかけており、影響は重大なものにならないと述べた。

アナリストは、新たな目標は予想をやや上回り、特にコスト面で強い内容だったと評価した。

ジェフリーズは年平均３％の増収目標は「やや控えめだ」と指摘した上で、「今回の計画の優れた点は、経営陣がコストの推移を明確に把握し、コスト構造に関して非常に個別性の高い施策を打ち出していることだ」と述べた。

ＪＰモルガンのアナリストは、資金調達・助言業務の売上高見通しが従来を上回っていることから、ソジェンの見通しはより強気だと指摘した。

ジェフリーズは年平均３％の増収目標は「やや控えめだ」と指摘した上で、「今回の計画の優れた点は、経営陣がコストの推移を明確に把握し、コスト構造に関して非常に個別性の高い施策を打ち出していることだ」と述べた。

ＪＰモルガンのアナリストは、資金調達・助言業務の売上高見通しが従来を上回っていることから、ソジェンの見通しはより強気だと指摘した。

items.title: アリババが新型AI半導体投入、中国で｢最も強力｣－エヌビディアに対抗
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のアリババグループは、同国で最も強力だとするAI向け半導体の投入を進めている。米半導体大手エヌビディアに対抗するアクセラレーターで、今後数年にわたるデータセンター能力の大規模な拡張を支える狙いだ。

電子商取引大手からAI企業への転換を目指すアリババは22日、前世代の3倍の性能を持つとする新型アクセラレーター「真武（Zhenwu）V900」の概要を明らかにした。同社の半導体部門Tヘッドが開発したもので、最大50万基を連結して最先端モデルの学習に活用できると呉泳銘（エディー・ウー）最高経営責任者（CEO）は述べた。

アリババは中国の主要企業の中でもAIへの投資額が最大級の企業だ。AI能力の拡充に向け、3年間で530億ドル（約8兆3470億円）超を投じる方針を示しており、8月には香港での追加の新株発行で約102億ドルを調達した。

ウー氏は22日、より時間を要する複雑なタスクに対応するため、5兆－10兆個のパラメーターを持つモデルを開発する計画を明らかにした。これは現時点で一般的なモデルをはるかに上回る。

さらに、アリババ・クラウドについて、世界のデータセンター能力を2032年までに20ギガワットとする目標をウー氏は提示。この大規模な拡張によって、急成長する同部門の外部顧客からの売上高は1600億ドルを超える可能性があるとシティグループは試算している。

ウー氏の発言に先立ち、米メタ・プラットフォームズの新たなパーソナルAIエージェントに初期段階で成功の兆しが見られ、投資家の楽観論が再燃していた。香港市場ではアリババ株が一時5%超上昇し、微信（ウィーチャット）を運営するテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）の株価は7%超急伸した。

ウー氏は「昨年、われわれはAIの能力が高まれば高まるほど、人類もより強力になると論じた」とし、「現在も、その確信は揺るがない」と語った。

items.author: Marc Champion
items.creator: Marc Champion
items.summary: In what must be the world’s least surprising election result, parties loyal to President Vladimir Putin have made a clean sweep in elections to Russia’s parliament, the State Duma. As a democratic exercise, this signified nothing — but it was an important moment nonetheless.

items.title: France Is Living in Denial
items.author: Mihir Sharma
items.creator: Mihir Sharma
items.summary: A lengthy, two-part biopic of a mid-century politician would be an unlikely hit in most countries. But not, apparently, if the politician is Charles de Gaulle and the country is France. The films based on Julian Jackson’s 2018 biography of the general have seized the country’s imagination. items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米スポーツブランド、ナイキ傘下のコンバースは、白人至上主義団体クー・クラックス・クラン（ＫＫＫ）による黒人の私刑・絞首を想起させると批判されていた広告写真を撤回した。ＡＢＣニュースが２１日に報じた。

この広告写真は、コンバースの全ての交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）アカウントで閲覧できなくなっている。

問題の写真は、コンバースのスニーカー「チャック７０ Ｘ」の販促で、ＫポップグループａｅｓｐａのＫＡＲＩＮＡをモデルに起用し制作された。写真でＫＡＲＩＮＡは、白いスカートを着て、黒いスニーカーを手にしている。スカートがＫＫＫのローブを連想させ、照明の影響で黒いスニーカーが宙に浮いているように見える。ローブを着た人物の隣で誰かがつるされているかのようだとの指摘が出た。白い衣服に落ちた影は三角形を形作り、ＫＫＫの頭巾の先端に似ているとの声も上がった。

コンバースはＡＢＣニュースへの声明で「申し訳ない。この画像がなぜ深く傷つけるものなのかを理解しており、われわれの判断が誤りだったと認識している」と表明。「自社のチャンネルから削除し、掲載された全ての場所から取り除く作業を進めている。あってはならないことであり、改善する」とした。

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has urged the United States to ease sanctions on North Korea in exchange for an agreement under which Pyongyang would freeze its nuclear weapons programme, the New York Times reported.
"I believe there is significant value in a trade-off between sanctions - which are not particularly effective anyway - and a stop to the development of additional nuclear weapons and intercontinental ballistic missile technology," the newspaper quoted Lee as saying in an interview.
Lee also said that pursuing denuclearisation under the current circumstances meant that nothing would be accomplished. 
Once a nuclear weapons freeze was secured, trust could be built through reciprocal incentives and concessions to eventually convince North Korea to reduce its nuclear arsenal, he said.

The current stalemate was simply too risky to be allowed to continue, Lee said, citing South Korean assessments that North Korea was now capable of producing, or may already be producing, an additional 10 to 20 nuclear weapons each year.
"Once it believes it has accumulated enough nuclear weapons and missiles to guarantee its survival, it will be tempted to export them to make money," he said. "That will be a truly dangerous moment."

Related:

North Korea fires unidentified projectile into East Sea: Seoul

South Korean officials have said that they are moving away from a "denuclearisation first" policy in favour of a "peace first" approach towards North Korea, with Lee pledging last year to respect North Korea's system and seek peaceful coexistence with Pyongyang.
Relations between the Koreas remain frozen, however. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has abandoned Pyongyang's reunification policy, describing the South as its most hostile state and ordering stronger frontline defences.
United States President Donald Trump is seeking to hold a new meeting with Kim, and the South Korean president has said that he is keen to see the talks happen.
Lee intends to present his vision for peace and coexistence on the Korean Peninsula to the United Nations this week during the UN General Assembly.

Joyce Lee　Heejin Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は、米国との３５００億ドル規模の投...
items.body:
韓国、対米投資第1弾はテキサス州ガス火力発電所　原発なども検討
9/22 11:44 配信

写真は韓国平沢市の港に並ぶ輸送コンテナ。昨年４月撮影。REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

Joyce Lee　Heejin Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は、米国との３５００億ドル規模の投資合意に基づき最初に進める事業として、テキサス州のガス火力発電所を選定した。他の２事業についても検討している。議員が２２日に明らかにした。 

金正官・産業通商資源相はこの日の非公開会合で議員らに計画について説明し、検討中の他の２事業についても詳細を共有した。

説明を受けた与党の議員は会合の合間に記者団に対し、テキサス州の発電所が最初に確定した事業だと述べた。韓国はこれと併せて、より広範な原子力投資事業の一環として、韓国が設計した「ＡＰＲ１４００」型原子炉２基への投資についても協議しているという。

同議員によると、米原子力技術企業ウエスチングハウスの株式５─１０％取得についても協議が行われている。一方、長らく延期されているアラスカの液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）プロジェクトへの参加については、まだ決定されていないという。 

今回の説明は、韓国製品に対する米国の関税を１５％に引き下げる貿易協定の履行に向けた最終調整を両国が進める中、重要な一歩となる。

議員らはこの説明を、両国が条件で合意して正式発表を行う前の最終段階の一つと位置づけている。 

韓国は昨年の貿易合意の一環として、韓国からの輸入品に対する関税引き下げと引き換えに、米国の製造業に投資することを約束した。

３５００億ドルのうち１５００億ドルは造船分野に充てられる。残る２０００億ドルの戦略投資の詳細はまだ確定していない。

メディアの報道と別の議員によると、テキサス州エンシナルの６．３ギガワットのガス火力発電所事業は２００億ドルを超える規模で、ＡＩ（人工知能）データセンターや半導体工場に電力を供給することを目的としている。

交渉に詳しい関係者によると、韓国と米国は米国内で最大８基の大型原子炉を建設することについても協議しており、うち２基は韓国のＡＰＲ１４００型、残る６基はウエスチングハウスのＡＰ１０００設計を採用する見通しという。 

また別の関係者によると、韓国は国内為替市場への影響を抑えるため、年間投資額に２００億ドルの上限を設けることを求めている。

SEOUL, Sept 22 (Reuters) – South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has urged the United States to ease sanctions on North Korea in exchange for an agreement under which Pyongyang would freeze its nuclear weapons programs, the New York Times reported.

“I believe there is significant value in a trade-off between sanctions — which are not particularly effective anyway — and a stop to the development of additional nuclear weapons and intercontinental ballistic missile technology,” the newspaper quoted Lee as saying in an interview.

Lee also said that pursuing denuclearization under the current circumstances meant that nothing would be accomplished. Once a nuclear weapons freeze was secured, trust could be built through reciprocal incentives and concessions to eventually convince North Korea to reduce its nuclear arsenal, he said.

Show Full Article

The current stalemate was simply too risky to be allowed to continue, Lee said, citing South Korean assessments that North Korea was now capable of producing, or may already be producing, an additional 10 to 20 nuclear weapons each year.

“Once it believes it has accumulated enough nuclear weapons and missiles to guarantee its survival, it will be tempted to export them to make money,” he said. “That will be a truly dangerous moment.”

South Korean officials have said that they are moving away from a “denuclearization first” policy in favour of a “peace first” approach towards North Korea, with Lee pledging last year to respect North Korea’s system and seek peaceful coexistence with Pyongyang.

Relations between the Koreas remain frozen, however. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has abandoned Pyongyang’s reunification policy, describing the South as its most hostile state and ordering stronger frontline defences.

U.S. President Donald Trump is seeking to hold a new meeting with Kim and the South Korean president has said that he is keen to see the talks happen.

Lee intends to present his vision for peace and coexistence on the Korean Peninsula to the United Nations this week during the UN General Assembly.

(Reporting by Jack Kim and Brenda GohEditing by Ed Davies)

items.body:
フランス　高さおよそ100mでの綱渡り　逆さまで開脚も

TBSテレビ

2026年9月22日(火) 11:17

国際

数千人を釘付けにしたのは、世界遺産…ではなく、空中を歩く、人でした。

地面のはるか上、細いワイヤーを進む女性。

命綱は着けていません。

一歩ずつ慎重に進み、途中で逆さまになると、そのまま開脚や足を使ったぶら下がりも披露します。

ロイター通信によりますと、フランス北部で20日、綱渡り師の女性が地上からの高さおよそ100メートルでのパフォーマンスに挑戦しました。

そしてなんと、ワイヤーの長さはおよそ400メートル。

ここは、世界遺産にも登録されている歴史的な炭田地帯で、石炭を掘り出す際に出る残がいを積み上げてできた2つの山の間を繋いでいるといいます。

数千人の見物客が見守る中、女性はおよそ37分かけて無事に渡り切ったということです。

items.title: 米メタ発のAI株高が失速－投資家の慎重姿勢なお根強く
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米メタ・プラットフォームズのパーソナルAIエージェント「Muse（ミューズ）」の成功の兆しに端を発したAI関連株の大幅上昇は、22日に入り一服している。投資家は再び慎重姿勢に転じており、最近の相場変動により、上昇相場を追うことになお消極的であることが示された。

欧州や米国の時間外取引では半導体株の上昇が一服し、アジアでもサムスン電子やSKハイニックスなどが上げ幅を縮小した。21日には、フィラデルフィア証券取引所半導体株指数が4.3%急伸し、メタも11%高と、昨年10月以来の大幅な上昇となっていた。

パリのラ・フィナンシエール・ド・レシキエでトレーディング責任者を務めるデービッド・クルック氏は、「市場が昨日の上昇分を受けてやや調整するのは理にかなっているが、上昇基調は崩れていないとみている」と述べた。

欧州では、UBSグループの半導体銘柄のバスケットが、小幅な上昇と下落の間で推移している。米国の時間外取引ではエヌビディアが1%未満の下落となっている。アジアでは、韓国の半導体メーカー、サムスン電子とSKハイニックスが一時約3.5%高から上げ幅を縮小し、韓国総合株価指数（KOSPI）は0.2%高で取引を終えた。

相場が失速する中でも、中国のインターネット株はおおむね上昇を維持した。中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、同社が微信（ウィーチャット）で同様のAI主導の事業機会を生み出せるとの期待から上昇した。同社はまた、最新かつ最高性能の画像生成モデルを投入したと発表した。

アリババグループも、中国で最も高性能だとするAI向け半導体を発表し、こうした楽観的なムードを一段と強めた。

ユニオンバンケールプリヴェ（UBP）のマネジングディレクター、ベイサーン・リン氏は「中国ハイテク株に注目が集まり、投資家の関心が北アジアの半導体株から離れつつある可能性がある」との見方を示した。また、「テンセントはMuseをきっかけとした上昇の恩恵を受けている一方、アリババは新たなAI半導体と大胆なデータセンター計画が支援材料となっている」と語った。

items.title: シルバーウィークの日経平均先物急伸、「Muse」人気で米テック株高騰
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 大型連休（シルバーウイーク）中の22日の日本市場では、祝日取引が行われている株式先物が急伸した。米メタ・プラットフォームズの新しいAIエージェントが好調な滑り出しとなり、前日の米国株市場でテクノロジー株が高騰したことでAI関連企業の業績の先行きに楽観的な見方が広がった格好だ。

大阪取引所の日経平均先物12月限は、一時前営業日比2.9%高の6万6980円まで上げ幅を拡大した。午前11時時点では6万6600円台で推移。

メタの新AIエージェント「Muse（ミューズ）」が米国のモバイルアプリランキングで首位となり、競争が激しさを増す消費者向けAIアシスタント市場で同社が存在感を高めていることを示した。

これを受け、21日の米国株市場ではAIを支える半導体株が急伸。10%高と大きく上げたアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）の時価総額は、初めて1兆ドル（約157兆4000億円）を突破した。インテルなども買われ、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）は4.3%高で5営業日続伸となった。

キャピタル・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、カイル・ロッダ氏はメタがリリースした新AIチャットボットが強い需要を集めており、AI関連銘柄の成長見通しに対する楽観的な見方が再び高まっていると指摘。AI需要の堅調は「AIエコシステム、特に半導体分野の市場心理を改善させ、影響はアジアのハイテクセクターの一部にも波及するだろう」と述べた。

日経平均先物以外にも22日のアジア株式市場ではテック株の影響を受けやすい韓国総合株価指数（KOSPI）が一時2.3%高まで買われ、台湾の加権指数は一時1.8%高と日中ベースの最高値を更新した。

この他、米国とイランの戦争終結に向けた外交努力への期待で、国際原油市況が下落したことも金利高への不安を後退させた点で投資家心理にプラスに働いている。21日の北海ブレント先物は4営業日続落し、1バレル＝100ドル付近で終了した。

NEW YORK: The United States on Monday (Sep 21) reiterated its commitment to the defence of key Asian allies Japan and South Korea, and the three nations expressed support for Taiwan ahead of a summit this week between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
Analysts say the US allies are anxious that Trump may offer concessions to Xi, including over Taiwan and trade, in return for an economic win with Beijing when he hosts Xi at the White House in Washington on Thursday.
Officials say both Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and South Korean President Lee Jae Myung are keen to see the US president during the UN General Assembly in New York, where all three are scheduled to speak on Tuesday.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with his South Korean counterpart Cho Hyun and Japan's Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi in New York on Monday.

They issued a joint statement vowing, in apparent reference to China, to stand firm "against economic coercion and non-market policies and practices" and "arbitrary export restrictions that disrupt supply chains".
They also welcomed the launch of a new trilateral consultation mechanism on economic security, part of broader efforts to strengthen supply chains and cooperation on critical technologies.
The statement said the US "reiterated its ironclad commitments to the defence of Japan and the ROK, backed by America’s unmatched military strength, including its nuclear capabilities, and reaffirmed its extended deterrence commitments to Japan and the ROK", using the initials for the Republic of Korea, South Korea's official name.
The statement said the ministers emphasised their commitment to robust security cooperation and the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. 
It also "expressed support for Taiwan’s meaningful participation in appropriate international organisations".
Taiwan's government welcomed the comments.
In a statement, its foreign ministry said the renewed joint public support for maintaining peace and stability shows that security in the strait has become a "strong consensus of the international community".
Referring to North Korea, the ministers "reaffirmed their resolute commitment to the complete denuclearisation of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea" and called on it to resume dialogue.
In addition to concerns about Taiwan, a democratically governed island China claims as its own, analysts said allies will be scrutinising any trade announcements from the Trump-Xi summit for their impact on competitiveness relative to China. Even a modest reduction in trade barriers for Beijing could erode their positions.
Takaichi angered Beijing last year by saying Tokyo could be drawn into a conflict over Taiwan, and Seoul and Washington have been negotiating details of South Korea's US$350 billion investment package in the US under a trade deal struck by the allies last year.
On Monday, a South Korean opposition lawmaker called for parliamentary scrutiny of the investment package, warning that negotiations over energy projects could leave South Korea carrying disproportionate financial risks.

items.title: 米中、首脳会議を前にAIや投資を議論－NYでの2日目の協議終える
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国と中国の当局者は21日、ニューヨークで2日目の協議を終えた。今週予定されている習近平国家主席の訪米を前に交渉を進展させることを目指し、AIや投資、貿易について協議した。

中国財政省の廖岷次官は、協議が行われたニューヨークのJPモルガン・チェース本社前で短く発言し、21日の話し合いでは米中双方の首席交渉官が合意した内容の履行にフォーカスしたと述べた。貿易休戦の延長を巡る協議について質問されたのに対し、廖氏はコメントしなかった。会場では、両国の他の高官の姿は確認されなかった。

ベッセント米財務長官、中国の何立峰副首相、李成鋼商務次官（国際貿易交渉代表）らは、20日に終日協議した。

李氏は20日の協議後、「良い雰囲気」で議論が行われたと述べ、ベッセント氏は「非常に成功した」と評価した。ベッセント氏は、米中両国がAI技術の恩恵と脅威について共通認識を形成することを目的とする「米中AI対話」と呼ぶ枠組みを設けることで合意したと話した。

貿易休戦が11月に期限を迎える中、焦点は米中が延長で合意できるか、合意した場合にどの程度の期間となるかだ。グリア米通商代表部（USTR）代表は21日、ブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで3－6カ月の延長は可能だと述べ、条件を協議する時間はまだあると語った。

トランプ米大統領と習氏は、貿易、レアアース（希土類）、AIなどの問題について協議すると予想されている。中国の税関統計によると、8月の中国から米国へのレアアース磁石の輸出は前月比21%減の512トンとなった。昨年の貿易休戦にもかかわらず、中国が重要鉱物の供給を引き続き絞っているとの懸念を浮き彫りにしている。

原題：China, US Discuss AI, Investment on Second Day of Trade Talks（抜粋）

items.author: CNA Lifestyle

items.body:

Taylor Swift to receive MTV’s first artist-director award

MTV created the artist-director award to recognise musicians who shape music videos behind the camera. Taylor Swift will become its first recipient during Sunday's awards ceremony.

FILE PHOTO: Taylor Swift attends the 55th annual Songwriters Hall of Fame Induction and Awards Gala in New York City, U.S., June 11, 2026. REUTERS/Kylie Cooper/File Photo

22 Sep 2026 09:00AM

FAST

Taylor Swift will be the first recipient of the MTV Video Music Awards artist-director honours at this year's awards ceremony, a newly created award recognising musicians whose work behind the camera has contributed to music video production and visual storytelling, CBS and MTV said on Monday (Sep 21).
The television networks said the honor for the 14-time Grammy winner "celebrates a sustained and influential body of work from artists who have pushed creative boundaries and developed a clear directorial voice."
The MTV Video Music Awards, hosted by Snoop Dogg, will air live from Los Angeles on Sunday on CBS and MTV and stream on Paramount+ in the United States. The ceremony will be available internationally on Paramount+ and MTV the following day.
The singer-songwriter, a seven-time VMA Best Director nominee and four-time winner, has earned recognition for videos and films including The Fate Of Ophelia, Opalite and Anti-Hero.
Beyond her directing work, the Bad Blood singer has won four Grammy album of the year awards. Her latest release, The Life Of A Showgirl, sold more copies than any other album in the modern era during its first week of release, according to Billboard, citing data from Luminate, a firm that tracks music sales.

Source: Reuters/mm

items.title: Dollar rises in choppy trading as investors weigh inflation prospects
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.summary: The dollar rose in uneven trading on Tuesday, oscillating between gains and losses after hitting a two-month high earlier in the day as volatile oil prices clouded the inflation picture.
items.body:
The dollar rose in uneven trading on Tuesday, oscillating between gains and losses after hitting a two-month high earlier in the day as volatile oil prices clouded the inflation picture.
[USN:L1N45E01S TEXT:"Oil prices settled down"] about 1%, pulling back from earlier highs, after US President Donald [USN:SPN45000K TEXT:"Trump told reporters"] at the United Nations that US officials had had a "very good" three-hour meeting on Tuesday with the Iranian delegation.
Crude prices earlier fell to a two-week low following Iran's [USN:L1N45E09Q TEXT:"proposal to reopen"] the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the US eases military pressure and after Iran and the United States [USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"hinted at"] the prospect of reviving negotiations to end their conflict.
But the early optimism was dented after [USN:L1N45E0JY TEXT:"Trump said"] during a speech to the United Nations General Assembly that he thought the US would reach a deal with Iran after the midterm elections are held in early November, which pushed oil and the dollar higher.
"Obviously, the big bogeyman for everybody is inflation, but it's all been about why is there so much inflation?" said Juan Perez, senior director of trading at Monex USA in Washington. "It's all due to the Iranian conflict going on so long, the escalation. So this is where markets are right now, and this is why you're seeing the dollar not really have any clear direction."
DOLLAR INDEX HITS TWO-MONTH HIGH The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.17% to 100.59, with the euro down 0.18% at $1.1441. The dollar index had risen as much as 0.29% on the day to 100.70, its highest since July 30, while also falling as much as 0.11%.
The ongoing US-Israeli war on Iran had sent oil prices higher and fanned inflation worries, prompting rate hikes from several central banks in recent days, including the Federal Reserve, but recent optimism over a potential deal has pushed oil prices back below the $100 per barrel mark.
[USN:L6N45D0L7 TEXT:"Comments from"] Fed officials in the wake of its policy decision have also [USN:S0N4490DL TEXT:"flagged the possibility"] of more rate increases if inflation does not cool.
Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President [USN:S0N43V06P TEXT:"Susan Collins wrote"] on Tuesday in a LinkedIn post that she supported last week’s central bank interest rate increase amid the risks that future inflation will be above its 2% target.
Separately, Richmond Fed President Tom [USN:S0N4490DQ TEXT:"Barkin said"] economic conditions in the US may be firming, and inflation pressures are coming from more than just higher energy costs and tariff effects.
Analysts at Morgan Stanley said in a note that options pricing data in the week ending September 18 indicated that investors increased long positions in the dollar index and increased short positions in the euro.
Markets are roughly split on whether the Fed will raise rates at its October meeting, pricing in a 55.4% chance for a hike of at least 25 basis points, down from 57.6% in the prior session, according to CME FedWatch .
JAPANESE CURRENCY UNDER PRESSURE Against the Japanese yen , the dollar strengthened 0.03% to 157.41 and was on pace for its third straight daily gain.
Traders were also weighing whether the Bank of Japan would raise rates quickly enough to narrow the gap with its global peers.
Despite the BOJ's [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"rate hike"] last week, the Japanese currency has been under pressure. Investors view the dissent from two policymakers, who pushed for a more cautious pace, as a warning that additional hikes may be harder to implement.
Sterling weakened 0.23% to $1.3332 and was on track for a second straight daily decline, and sixth in the past seven.

items.title: Oil prices settle lower as crude flows from Middle East improve
items.author: Erwin Seba
items.creator: Erwin Seba
items.summary: Oil prices fell on Tuesday on increasing flows of Saudi crude with the restart of the East-West pipeline and ship movements through the Strait of Hormuz, through which 20% of global supply moved before the US-Israeli war on Iran began in late February.
items.body:
Oil prices fell on Tuesday on increasing flows of Saudi crude with the restart of the East-West pipeline and ship movements through the Strait of Hormuz, through which 20% of global supply moved before the US-Israeli war on Iran began in late February.
Brent and US crude pared their steepest losses of the day after US President Donald Trump dashed hopes that an agreement would come soon, when he said a peace deal would come after the US midterm elections in early November.
Trump also said that without a peace deal he could "annihilate" Iran. Trump was expected to meet with world leaders at the [USN:L1N45D0Z2 TEXT:"UN"] in New York this week, feeding hopes for stability in the Middle East and perhaps even progress in ending Russia's 4-1/2-year-old war in Ukraine.
The Brent crude futures for the November contract settled at $99.25 a barrel, down $1.09, or 1.09%.
The WTI October contract, which expires on Tuesday, finished at $94.99 a barrel, down $1.19, or 1.24%.
At their session lows, both benchmarks were down more than $2 a barrel. Then Trump's comments burst mounting hopes that a deal could come during this week's UN General Assembly meeting in New York.
Feeding the optimism, flows through the Strait of Hormuz were seen increasing in recent days.
"Saudi Arabia is acting, not waiting," said Phil Flynn, senior analyst at Price Futures Group. "After Houthi hits on the East-West pipeline forced a shutdown of Yanbu loadings, Aramco loaded about 14 million barrels of crude onto seven VLCCs inside the Gulf. Satellite and tracker data showed Saudi oil moving through Hormuz averaging about 2.9 million barrels a day over the last six days, up from roughly 700,000 barrels a day in August."
Saudi Arabia has [USN:L1N45E09V TEXT:"restarted operations"] at its East-West Pipeline and could resume exports from Yanbu port later on Tuesday, three sources briefed on the matter said.
Iran can reopen the [USN:L1N45E09Q TEXT:"Strait of Hormuz"] within seven days if the US eases military pressure and lifts its blockade on Iranian ports, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Tuesday.
The official said the Iranian delegation to the UN General Assembly in New York has full authority to revive diplomacy with the US.
Hamad Hussain, senior climate and commodities economist at Capital Economics, said the Iranian comments were a sign that diplomacy efforts could be working.
Before US-Israeli attacks on Iran began in late February, the Strait of Hormuz handled about one-fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas supplies.
"There may also be other obstacles, such as the issue of tolls and fees, to overcome before a lasting solution can be achieved," Hussain added.
Drone attacks forced Saudi Arabia to shut the pipeline on September 13, halting crude loadings at Yanbu.
Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, said he does not see much further downside to oil prices until supplies increase through the Strait of Hormuz, particularly of refined products where shortages are most acute.
Diesel prices have rallied in Europe and the US to [USN:L6N4580TA TEXT:"record highs"] as wars in Iran and Ukraine sharply cut exports from some of the biggest producers such as Russia, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.

items.title: OpenAI、米国に取り組みの主導求める－AIの国際基準策定で
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米OpenAIは、最先端のAIの国際基準策定に向け、米国が他国・地域と連携して取り組みを主導するよう求めている。AIがもたらす可能性のある弊害への懸念の高まりに対応する。

OpenAIは21日のブログ投稿で、AIを安全に開発するには国際的な技術基準が必要だと指摘。特に、AIモデルに関連するどのような事案を報告対象とすべきかを定義し、AIの進歩に向けて各国・地域がどう協力できるかを定め、こうした技術の開発に必要なコンピューティング能力へのアクセスを改善する上で重要だとした。

OpenAIは「AIの継続的な進歩を安全で有益なものにするには、アラインメント（人間の意図や価値観に沿わせる）研究の進展と、研究機関や国をまたいだ開発の指針となる共通基準の両方が必要になる」としている。

同社によると、サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）は23日、国連安全保障理事会でAIと国際安全保障について演説する予定で、24日には中国の習近平国家主席を迎えてホワイトハウスで開かれる国賓夕食会に出席する。

OpenAIはブログ投稿で、こうした取り組みには各国が協力し、最も高性能なAIモデルの開発に向けて相互に補完し合う国内基準と国際基準を策定することを含むべきだと強調。同社は、米商務省内の組織で、AIモデルの試験や指針策定を支援するAI標準・イノベーションセンター（CAISI）など、各国に既に設置されているAI安全機関を通じて実現できるとの考えを示した。

ブログではまた、AIが自律的に作業を遂行する能力が高まっていることに対応するための基準も必要だと訴えた。人間の介入なしにAIが最終的に自らのコードを変更したり、その他の方法で能力を向上させたりできるようになるという理論を指す「完全自律型」の「再帰的自己改善（RSI）」について、「安全に実行できるようになるまでは」追求すべきではないとした。

US to open two new military bases in Greenland: Sources

Washington on Monday also stressed the need for military and economic investment in the Arctic to safeguard the region. 

The Greenland flag flutters in front of a house in Nuuk, Greenland, on Sep 19, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Tim Barsoe)

COPENHAGEN: The US plans to reopen a former Cold War-era military base in southern Greenland and set up a military presence at an east coast base now used by the Danish dog sled patrol under an agreement to be signed by the US, Denmark and Greenland on Tuesday (Sep 22), according to three people familiar with the matter.
Those sites are Narsarsuaq, whose population has dwindled to a few dozen people since the US closed its Bluie West One military base in the 1950s, and Mestersvig, a military outpost currently used by the Sirius Dog Sled Patrol, a Danish special forces unit, said two of the people.
Denmark, Greenland and the United States are expected to sign their new agreement at the United Nations General Assembly in New York City at 2.30pm GMT (10.30pm, Singapore time) on Tuesday.
The text of the agreement has not been made public and the three people familiar with the deal, speaking on condition of anonymity, said its details are not finalised until it is signed.
